tei:titleStmt.tei:title: pod 9 gsung 'bum/_tA ra nA tha/ （dpe bsdur ma/）

tei:div.tei:p: spyi khyab bsdu sgrig 'gan 'khur ba gtso bo/ gzan dkar thub bstan nyi ma/bsdu sgrig 'gan 'khur ga smo pa dang / gtso sgrig pa/ karma bde legs/gtso sgrig gzhon pa/ 'gro 'dul rdo rje/bsdu sgrig pa/ mun sel/ thub bstan nyi ma/ bstan 'dzin blo gros/zla ba bstan 'dzin/ shes rab bzang po/zhu dag dang dkar chag sgrig mkhan/ dpal ldan rgya mtsho/ phur pa phrin las/dkon mchog bsam gtan/ thub bstan nyi ma/ bstan pa dar rgyas/par sgrig lag rtsal pa/ tshe ring chos sgron/ shes rab dpal g.yang /bsod nams 'brug rgyas/

//༵༵~ rdobyetsho / tho 4pa rtso hūṃ be rta/sgyu / ste ste spya / rnyi / skyi / ji rdo /

〈mes po'i shul ba theg〉ces pa'i dpe tshogs 'di ni dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis bsgrigs shing 'di ga dpe skrun khang dang mnyam 'brel gyis bskrun pa'i dpe rnying dpe tshogs shig yin la/de yang mkhas dbang gzan dkar rin po che thub bstan nyi ma mchog gis spyi'i gtso skyong gnang ste/dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rting zhib 'jug khang gis nye ba'i lo bcu tsam gyi ring la 'bad brtson chen pos bod kyi sa gnas gang sar bzhugs pa'i bod yig dpe rnying po ti khrir longs pa rang byung dang mi'i gnod 'tshes 'jig la nye ba'i nyen kha las bskyabs te legs par bsgrigs shing dkar chag tu btab/dpe thum gsol/dpe sgrom bzhengs te srung skyob mdzad gnang ba dang gnang mus su yod pa ni/rang re'i mes po'i shul nor srung skyob rgyun 'dzin dang bod rig pa'i gal che'i dpyad gzhi mkho 'don gyi dgos pa che ba ma zad/rang rgyal mi rigs rig gnas nor mdzod dar rgyas dang srung skyob bgyi ba'i 'phrin las gal chen zhig red/nye char dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang dang 'di ga dpe skrun khang gnyis zhib gros byas mthar/srol rgyun rig gnas srung skyob dang bod rig pa'i dpyad yig myur skyob dang cha tshang du gtong ba'i dmigs yul ngos 'dzin gcig gyur thog〈bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus〉zhes pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gyi dpe tshogs chen mo zhig mu mthud nas legs sgrig dang dpe skrun byed bzhin yod pa dang /da char yang dmigs yul dgos pa gcig gyur thog 〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉ces pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gal chen gyi dpe tshogs chen mo 'di nyid par skrun bya rgyu yin la/de yang sngon byon mes po mkhas dbang dam pa du mas shul du bzhag pa'i gsung 'bum dpe dkon gal chen rnams dang /'thar 'thor du bzhugs pa'i dpe dkon gal chen dag phyogs gcig tu bsdus te bsgrigs pa 'di'i nang don thad la/nang don rig pa dang /gso ba rig pa/tshad ma rig pa/sgra rig pa/bzo rig pa/lo rgyus/rtsis rig ༵//sa bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kun 'dus pa'i dpe dkon nor bu dgos 'dod kun 'byung lta bu zhig —1

'ad 'dra' dpe skrun mnyam las kya go skabs legs po nged cag dpe skrun khang la thob pa na shan tu skal ba bzang zhing gzi brjid kyi 'os 'gan zhig tu brtsis te lo 'ga'i dpe skrun 'char gzhi gtso bo'i nang du bkod zin cing / las gzhi 'di la krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi dbu khrid dang rgyal khab phyi nang gi bod rig pa'i mkhas dbang du mas gdeng 'jog dang mthong chen gyis skul ma yang thob/〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 gi ma phyi phal cher ni dbu med bris rnying sha stag yin pas/ ma dpe gsal mi gsal dang skung yig mang zhing bris tshugs 'dra min gyi dbang gis klog dka' ba'ang shin tu mang po 'dug 'on kyang dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis lo mang ring nyams myong bsdu len dang mkhas dbang du mar bka' 'dri zhus par brten yig gzugs gsar rgyag dang phyogs sgrig thub pa byung / par shing du 'khod yod pa rnams kyang dpe rnying g.yin pa dang bsdur te gtan la phab yod pa bcas te zhib cha deb so so'i bsdu sgrig gsal bshad du gzigs par zhu/dpe rnying srung skyob dang phyogs sgrig dpe skrun gyi las ka 'di la rgyab skyor dang thugs khur gnang mkhan gyi mkhas dbang rnams dang / lhag par du krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi dbu khrid lhan rgyas dang / mkhas dbang thub bstan nyi ma rin po che mchog sogs kyis rgyab skyor dang mdzub ston gyi bka' drin bskyangs pa la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang / dpal brtsegs zhib 'jug khang gi 'gan 'dzin pa lhan rgyas dang / zhu dag pa/ yig rgyag pa sogs mdor na las gzhi 'di la lhag bsam dang 'bad brtson chen pos zhabs phyi zhu mkhan rnams la snying thag pa nas bka' drin che zhes zhu rgyu dang /dpe tshogs 'di'i dpe sgrig dang zhu dag thad la ha cang nan tan dang zhib tshags bgyi khul byas mod/'on kyang nga tshor shes tshad dman pa'i dbang gis nor 'byug mi nyung ba yod srid pas dpyod ldan dag gis nor bcos yo bsrang gi dgongs 'char lhug stsol gnang bar zhu zhu/zhes krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas/spyi lo 2007lo'i zla ba dang po'i tshes 10la/—2—

de la 'dir rang cag kha ba can gyi zhing 'dir chos rgyal lo paṇa rnams dang / sa dge bka' rnying sogs kyi mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i dam pa'i skyes bu rnams kyis/ bshad sgrub kyi shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i chos brgyud dang bka' srol mtha' dag dang / de dang rjes su 'brel ba'i thun mong gi rig gnas sum rtags snyan ngag mngon brjod sdeb sbyor/ skar rtsis 'gyung rtsis / sgra tshad bzo gso sogs mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i gzhung lugs zab cing rgya che ba tshang la ma nor ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig 'chad nyan 'gyur gsum dang / bshad sgrub las gsum gyi sgo nas thog mar srol gtod/bar du gtan la phab/ rim bzhin dar rgyas btang ba sogs 'dzin skyong spel bar mdzad pa'i bka' drin bdag rkyen la brten nas/ dbus gtsang khams gsum du bzhugs so cog gi glegs bam thams cad gcig tu sbungs na ri rab lhun po'i gtos dang mnyam zhing / chos tshan gyi rnam dbye ji snyed yod pa grangs su bgrangs na nam mkha'i gza' skar tshogs kyang skyengs par byed pa zhig mchis pa tsam du ma zad / rgya bal hor sogs kyi yul gru kun tu'ang dar khyab che/da lta'i char bod rig pa'am bod kyi shes rig ces su grags pa 'di nyid 'dzam gling shar nub kyi yul gru dag tu'ang mgo de/ dper na/ o ka si phor dhi dang / to wid lta bu yo rob dang / a— rdo digs su grags wo gyi slob grwa wo mo

rnams su bod yig gi dpe mdzod chen po yod par ma zad/ bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed sa'i sde tshan dang slob ma yang mi nyung ba yod/da ni gong du smras pa'i 4nad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad ces pa de gang dang gang yin pa'i ngo sprod mdo tsam zhu na/ de yang ji skad du/ 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po che'i zhal nas/ chos blon thon mi be+e ro ska cog zhang / /gzhubs chen rin bzang rngog lo sa skya pa/ /bu ston bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu// zhes dang / bod yul sgrub brgyud shing rta chen po brgyad/ /rnying ma bka' gdams lam 'bras bka' brgyud pa/ khangs pa zhi byed sbyor drug bsnyen sgrub bo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ shes bya'i gzhung lugs sna tshogs kyi 'gyur khyad dang 'chad tshul gyi dbye bas bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu dang / sgrub pa nyams su len tshul la brgyud pa'i khyad par dang man ngag gi dbye bas sgrub brgyud 'dren pa'i shing rta brgyad de/ bshad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i gsung rab rgya mtsho lta bu zhig bdag cag gi yab mes gong ma rnams kyis gces pa'i lus srog longs spyod thams cad phangs pa med par btang ste/ phyi rabs rang re'i brgyud 'dzin rnams la 'phran yun phan bde'i dpal la dmigs nas bzhag pa'i nor bu rin po che yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po mtha' yas pa zhig mchis/de dag las mang che ba rig gsar lo bcu'i god chag chen po sogs dus kyi rgud pa'i dbang gis sems med 'byung bzhi'i 'jig pa dang / sems ldan mi dang mi min gyi gnod pas nyams nyes chen por gyur pa ni rgya bod yongs grags ltar lags/ —2—

rig gnas gsar brje'i mjug sgril ba dang myongs cig tang gi yang dag pa'i srid jus kyi nyi 'od slar yang 'phros te/ tang dang rgyal khab kyis 'go khrid dang rtsa 'dzugs gnang nas/ dpe rnying 'thor bsdu dang / legs sgrig dpe skrun/ sgyur spel sogs kyi sgo nas rang rigs kyi rig gnas nyams pa sor chud dang / mi nyams gong 'phel gyi bya bar so so'i 'khos bstun gyi sri zhu sgrub pa'i skal ba bzang po'i dpal la longs su spyad du yod pa'i skabs 'dir/ rang re'i yab mes rnams kyis bzhag pa'i pha nor mang po zhig da dung yang nged cag gi bsod nams kyi bgo skal du lhag yod pa rnams la gces spras chen pos srung skyob dang dar spel byed rgyu ni mes rgyal gyis gnang ba'i las 'gan yin par ma zad/ 'u cag bod kyi rig gnas slob gso'i bya bar legs skyes 'bul mkhan gyi rgan dar 'bring gsum gyi shes yon can la mtshon na/ rang re'i phrag par bab pa'i gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i gzi 'od bla na 'bar ba'i 'os 'gan mchog tu gyur pa zhig kyang yin par sems/der brten/ phyogs dang ris su ma chad pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis ljags rtsom gnang ba'i gsung rab/ bshad sgrub shing rta bco brgyad las grub pa'i mdo sngags kyi gzhung bshad dang / chos 'byung dang gdan rabs/ rnam thar dang gsan yig brda sprod dang snyan ngag /rtsis dang gso rig sogs dpe dkon 'thor ba rnams bsdus/ chad pa rnams bsab/ nyams pa rnams gsos/ 'khru/gas pa rnams bsgrigs te dpe tshogs 'ga' rim pa bstar chags su par du bskrun pa dang bskrun rtsis las/—3—

da lan 'dir jo nang rje bcun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dpe bsdur ma 'di rgya che'i gzigs pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/'byung char nga tsho'i dpe tshogs dpar skrun zhu rgyu'i skor la lhag bsam ldan zhing mkhyen spyan yangs pa'i mkhas dbang rnams kyis dgongs 'char gyi bka' slob stsol gnang dang / dpe dkon gyi ma phyi g.yar gnang gi skyabs 'jug yong ba mkhye/na mkhye/na/ /zhor 'phros gsal 'debs zhu ba/ lhag par du da lta lus kyi lang tsho rgyas shing / sems kyi blo gros bkra ba'i gzhon skyes rnams la mtshon na/ snying pos dben pa'i kha pho 'don pa las/ zol med kyi lhag bsam dkar po snying la 'chang / don ldan gyi rnam dkar bya ba dang du len/ lhad med kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed/ 'khos bstun gyi sri zhu'i las ka cung zad re sgrub nus na/mes rgyal la zhabs togo 'grub/ rang rigs la legs skyes 'bul/ rang nyid kyi la rgya mngon thub pa zhig kyang 'ong ba ni mthong chos mngon gyur lags pas/ de bzhin dgongs dbyings su chub par zhu'o/ /phran 'brog rgan 'khyams po thub bstan nyi mas/spyi lo 2007pa'i zla tshes la gus phul/—4—

bsdu sgrig gsal ba ro/da/da lam nga tsho'i jo nang rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs te par skrun zhus pa 'di ni/ gzan dkar mchog sprul thub bstan nyi ma'i bka' slob dang bdag rkyen 'og byung ba zhig yin/de yang spyir khong la gsung 'bum pod bzhi bcu tsam zhig yod tshul phyis su bris pa'i rnam thar 'ga' las gsal yang / dngos su pod bzhi bcu'i dkar chag kha gsal zhig da sngon nga tsho'i mjal rgyu ma byung / da lam dngos su mjal rgyu byung ba'i pod bco lnga ni/ deng sang yongs grags su rtag brtan par ma zhes 'bod pa 'di ni/ bod rab byung bcu pa'i me 'brug (spyi lo1616) la/ mnga' ris smad kyi gung thang gi rgyal rabs nyi shu rtsa gsum pa'am/ yang lugs gcig la dmar po sde bsgrangs na nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa bsod nams dbang phyug sdes yon bdag byas/ tā ra nā tha'i dngos slob gnya' yi ban+di dkon mchog legs pas/ thog ma'i mtshams sbyor dang par byang 'bri ba sogs byas te/ dus 'khor sngags phreng dang skad gnyis shan sbyar sogs chos tshan bcu bzhi shing par du bkos pa/ rtag brtan dam chos gling du spyan drangs te bzhugs su gsol/ de'i steng du rtag brtan rang nas brkos pa bcas pod — 1 —

bco lnga tsam zhig yod pa de'i bu dpe par ma tshar gcig /rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos 'bras skrungs dpe mdzod khang du gdan drangs ba/ phyis dus 'gyur skabs su pe cing mi rigs pho brang du bzhugs kyang / deng seng bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du spyan drangs te bzhugs pa de yin/yang gangs can mkhas grub rim byon gyi ming mdzod las/ khong la gsung rtsom shin tu mang po yod par grags kyang rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos/gsung 'bum shing par rnams bka' rgya btab ste par mi chog pa mdzad pas da lta khong gi gsung rtsom rnams kha tshang ba ha cang dka'/ rgyal dbang lnga pa zhing du gshegs rjes/ blo gros brtan pas khong gi gsung 'bum la dkar chag bsdus pa zhig mdzad 'dug /de'i rjes zha lu ri phug sprul skus mdzad pa'i tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa'i nang du/ pod ka nas tsa bar bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don gnyis dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong brgyad brgya lnga bcu bzhugs/da lta pe cing mi rigs pho brang du pod bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don brgyad dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong dgu brgya lnga bcu rtsa brgyad bzhugs zhes gsal yang nga tsho'i gong gi dkar chag gnyis po da sngon mjal rgyu ma rnyed/ de yang zha lu ri phug sprul skus dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa ljags rtsom gnang ste/ sngar rtag brtan gyi shing par dus zing dbang —2—

gis nyams chag shor ba rnams/ kha gso mdzad tshul thos kyang zhib phra'i lo rgyus kha gsal mjal rgyu ma byung / da lta dgen 'jam dbyangs rnams rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa'i par rnying pod bcu bdun 'di/ zha lu ri phug sprul skus nyams gso mdzad pa de yin nam snyams ste/ da lta rtag brtan gyi par rnying bod ljongs dpe ma sgo khang du bzhugs pa pod bco lnga dang / pod grangs dang chos tshan mang nyung tshig mtshams sogs cung mi 'dra ba yod pa'i phyir/da lam nga tshos khong gi gsung 'bum glog klad nang du bcug skabs kyi thog ma'i ma dpe ni/ nye char bla ma yon tan bzang pos 'dzam thang du shing par la brkos pa'i glegs bam nyer bzhi can de la byas te zhu dag thengs gsum byas/ de rjes sngar jo nang rtag brtan du bzhugs pa rtsom pa po tā ra nā tha rang nyid kyi phyag dpe skabs 'gar phyag mchan yod pa/ da lta 'bras skrungs gnas bcu lha khang nang bzhugs bris ma pod chung bcu la chos tshan43la bsdur gzhi dang / jo nang rtag brtan gyi par rnying pod bco lnga bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa dang / a ri ba dgen 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa par rnying pod bcu bdun yod pa gnyis phyogs bsdoms kyis/ par rnying pod nyi shu tsam la chos tshan 314byung ba la sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur thengs dang po zhus/—3—

de nas rtag brtan gyi par pod nyi shu la bsdur gzhi dang / 'dzam thang gi par mas sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur theng gnyis pa zhus pa yin/ 'on kyang par ma snga phyi gnyis dang bris ma gcig bcas dpe gsum po rtsa ba'i cha nas gcig mtshungs su bzhugs pa las khyad par chen po mi 'dug /cho ga'i skor la mi 'dra ba cung zad yod pa ni mchan dkyus su shor ba yin 'dug pa rnams kyang / gug rtags nang du bcug te gsal po byas yod/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras sbungs bris ma gnyis su dpe ma bzhugs pa/ 'dzam thang par ma'i nang bzhugs gsung thor bu'i skor wa rtags can dang / zha rtags can gnyis dang / za rtags can dbu ma theg mchog gi zin bris rab byed drug pa yan chad/ tā ra nā tha'i zhal gsung slob ma ye shes rgya mtshos zin bris su bkod pa dang / rab byed bdun pa brgyad pa gnyis dza 'go'i dge bshes mchog grub rgya mtshos gsar du bsnan pa/ 'a rtags can nyang yul gyi lo rgyus tā ra nā thas zhabs btags mdzad par grags pa bcas chos tshan121la 'dzam thang gi par ma'i dpe gcig pu las/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras sbungs bris ma gnyis kyi bsdur gzhi ma rnyed/ rtag brtan par rnying gcig pu las gzhan gnyis la med pa chos tshan4/ yang rtag brtan dang 'dzam thang par ma gnyis char med pa/ 'bras sbungs gnas bcu lha khang du bzhugs pa'i gral nas chos tshan bco brgyad la ldeb193gsar rnyed byung —4—

ba bcas la/ zhu dag byas te kha skong gi tshul du bzhag yod pa bcas khyon bsdoms deb bzhi bcu zhe lnga la chos tshan900yod/ da lta nga tsho'i ma dpe g.yar rgyu ma rnyed pa sngon rtsom pa po'i phyag dpe'i gral nas yin pa/ 'bras sbungs gnas bcu lha khang / dpe rtags phyi298nang bzhugs gtam du bya ba nor bu'i 'byung gnas ldeb6/ yang phyi508nang bzhugs 'khor lo gsum gyi rnam bzhag chos dbyings rgya mtsho'i rgyan rnam par bkod pa ldeb92/ ste lag bris kyi chos tshan gnyis po ma 'ongs par dpe g.yar thabs bya dgos/da lta nga tshos dpe bsdur dang zhu dag gi skabs su ma dpe rtsa 'dzin byas te/ dpe gsum mi 'dra ba'i tshe rtag brtan la〈〈rta〉〉rtags 'di dang /'dzam thang la rtags〈〈rja 〉〉'di/ dag cha nor bcos la gug rtag 'di( 1dang / mchan rnams gug rtag〈 〉'di'i nang du blug yod/gsal bshad zhu rgyu zhig la deb bzhi pa'i nang du/ kun mkhyen dol po pa'i gsung chos tshan bzhi/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang kun khyab kyi gsung lho sgo'i cho ga zhes pa'i chos tshan gcig bcas 'dzam thang par mar bzhag yod pa dang / yang sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen gyi gsung dus 'khor phyag rgya'i skor chos tshan gcig rtag brtan par rnying du yod pa rnams rang 'jag bzhag yod pa dang / khong gi rang rnam gtso bor gyur pa'i lo rgyus zhal gdams rnams su/gtsang gi yul skad yin nam snyam pa'i tha snyad go dka' ba mang po zhig —5—

bed spyad gnang ba dag kyang rang sor bzhag yod/da lam bka' 'bum 'di rtsis 'khor nang du blugs pa'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas zhus shing / par skrun tshar lnga brgya'i 'gro song bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas bgyis/ tshar brgyad brgya'i 'gro song hrin krin sogs kyi rgya'i sbyin bdag rnams kyis gnang zhing / tshar nyis brgya'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas bgyis pa bcas kyi mthun rkyen las/ da lam dngos su par du bskrun thub pa byung ste rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/las gzhi 'dir bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang nas ma dpe pod bco lnga g.yar gnang byung ba dang / 'dzam thang bla ma mun sel mchog nas kyang ma dpe btsal rogs dang / go rim sgrig rgyu/ zhu dag bcas la rogs ram gang mang gnang ba dang / khams sprul bsod nams don grub mchog nas nyang yul chos 'byung zhu dag gi rogs ram gnang ba dang / bla ma dpal ldan rgya mtshos zhu dag gi las ka spyi'i thugs 'gan che bzhes gnang ba bcas la thugs rje che zhu rgyu ba'o/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas karma bde legs kyis/—6—

khong ni slob dpon chen tshu du 7 5 pa / se ba 1 6 3 'a / spying gnas dang / paṇ+ḍi ta gha ya dha ra/gnyos lo tsā ba/ kha rag sgom chung sogs skyes chen mang pos byin gyis brlabs shing / bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan kha rag khyung btsun gyi gnas jo mo kha rag ces pa'i 'dabs/ chu bo chen po lo hi ta'i nye 'gram du rwa lo tsā ba chen po'i brgyud pa bar ma chad par byon pa la/ shar nub gnyis su gyes pa las shar ba kun dga' seng ge'i gdung brgyud/ sngags 'chang tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i sras rnam rgyal phun tshogs dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe dgu pa rje 'di'i yab dang /yum rdo rje bu dga' dgung lo bcu dgu pa gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung bcu pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1575) la/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas sku 'khrungs te mes pos pad+ma sri gcod rdo rje zhes mtshan gsol/ —sku bltams te zla ba brgyad song rjes bzhengs nas gom pa spo thub pa dang / dgung lo gcig tsam nas gsung byon te nga bla ma kun dga' grol mchog yin zhes zhal gyis bzhes pa dang / gzhan yang sku gong ma'i rten gsum dang spyin bdag / nye gnas sogs kyi lo rgyus gsal bar gsungs pa sogs kyis/dzo nang bla ma kun dga' grol mchog gi yang srid 'khrul med du shes te/ dgung lo bzhi par jo nang mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho dang / zhabs drung bkra shis — 1 —

stobs rgyas dbang po sogs rta pa brgya dang drug cu rtsa lnga tsam gdan 'dren du byung nas/ gtsang phyogs su gdan drangs te sku gong ma'i slob ma rdo ring kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ lha dbang grags pa/ mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang sogs kyis chos lung byang rtser khri ston mdzad/ rdo ring pa chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi drung du/ thog ma'i rten 'brel du sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang dang / gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang / lam 'bras gtso bor gyur pa'i dbang dang gdams pa mang po gsan/de nas dgung lo drug pa nas yi ge sbyor klog phul du phyin pa mkhyen te/dbang dang rjes gnang sogs yig thog nas gnang ba la dka' tshegs med pa byung /dgung lo brgyad par rje gong ma'i dngos slob mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub yongs 'dzin du bsten nas/ tshad ma rigs gter sbyangs pas gzhung don la go ba rnyed rung blo 'dzin la zla ba lnga tsam 'gor/ gzhan yang mdo rgyud kyi gzhung lugs mang por gsan bsam mdzad pas mkhyen rtogs rgyas/dgung lo brgyad la phebs skabs stag lung kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan gdan drangs te thog mar bka' gdams glegs bam gyi lung zhus te/ de nas bod rab byung bcu pa'i chu rta khrums stod zla ba'i tshes lnga (spyi lo1582)la/ chos lung byang rtse'i mchod khang gi yang thog tu/ dpal stag lung pa chen po rje btsun kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyi —2dzo

mkhan po dang / 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos slob dpon dang / rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang pos dus go ba/chos rje mchod gnas pas grogs dan bgyis te yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen dang bar ma rab byung sngon du 'gro bas dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes te/ mtshan kun dga' snying po bkra shis rgyal mtshan zhes gsol/ dag pa'i gzigs snang du rgya gar gyi paṇa chen dz+wa la nā thas tā ra nā tha zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/chos rje brag stod pa lha dbang grags pa'i drung nas chos drug dang phyag chen sogs/ zab chos mang po gsan pas nang zab lam gyi rtogs pa mngon du gyur/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang las dus 'khor gtso bor gyur pa'i zab chos mang po gsan/ mkhan po lung rigs rgya mtsho'i mdun dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang dang rgyud bshad/ dpal rgyal ba jo nang pa'i lugs kyi sbyor drug gi zab khrid mtha' dag gsan te nyams len mdzad/ bu lugs kyi sbyor drug gi khrid kyang rdzogs par gsan/ gzhan yang jo zhal bla ma mang po'i gdams khrid dang bka' bstan sogs rgya gzhung gi man ngag mang po dang / kun mkhyen dol bo pa'i gsung 'bum sogs lung mang po gsan/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes/rdo rje 'dzin pa ye shes dbang po sogs las/ sa skya jo nang shangs pa zhwa lu 'brug pa kaX tshang / stag lung sogs kyi chos skor bcas rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang khrid man ngag mtha' dag ma lus par gsan/ gzhan yang rgya gar gyi grub chen gu ru lho phyogs pa sangs rgyas sbas pa'i mgon po/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan can sogs bshes gnyen mang po'i zhabs la gshugs te/ zhang tshal pa'i chos —3—

skor dang / yang dgon pa'i bka' 'bum/ dwags po lha rje'i bka' 'bum/ ri chos ma drug gi khrid/ mai tri bcu gsum ma'i dbang / sangs rgyas thod pa'i dbang /o rgyan bsnyen sgrub skor gyi khrid lung yongs rdzogs/ mar pa nas brgyud rngog pa'i bka' babs dgyes rdor yab yum/ gur rigs bsdus/ gdan bzhi yab yum/ ma hā mā ya ste drug smri ti nas brgyud pa 'jam dpal gsang ldan bcas rngog dkyil bdun/ rngog ṭīka rin chen rgyan 'dra'i mdzub khrid/brtag gnyis sa rngog gnyis ka'i bshad srol/ stag lung thang pa'i bka' 'bum/sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang /ni gu chos drug 'jam dkar gyi rjes gnang /'grel chen dri med 'od dang /rdo rje snying 'grel dang / dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgya gzhung / dgyes rdor skor la gtso che'i chos sna sum cu so dgu dang / gdan bzhi'i khrid tshul rgyas pa/ ār+ya de wa'i chos lnga sogs rgya gzhung bcu/ sa ra he'i chos lnga/ nag po'i gzhung drug pū hi smad lnga/dril bu skor gsum/ gshed dmar bi rū pa'i gzhung brgyad/ ku ku ri pa'i chos bdun/ sgrub thabs mtsho skyes sogs dgyes rdor gyi gzhung shin tu mang po dang / dpe med 'tsho'i sbyor drug rtsa 'grel/dza lan+ta ri'i do ha/ sems kyi phyag rgya sogs mdo sngags spyi dang / khyad par du gsang sngags rgyud sde'i dbang bskyed rdzogs mtha' yas pa gsan/de nas dgung lo bcu bdun pa rab byung bcu pa'i lcags yos hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu bdun (spyi lo1591)la/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis mkhan po/ bla ma byams pa lhun grub kyis las kyi slob dpon/dge ba'i bshes gnyen blo bzang pa dang / rje drung kun dga' bsod nams —4—

sogs kyis kha skong gnang ste bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes te/ phyi ltar ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan 'chang ba'i dge slong 'dul ba 'dzin pa/nang ltar gzhan phan snying rje chen pos thugs rgyud yongs su brlan pa'i rgyal sras sems pa chen po/ gsang ba bskyed rdzogs kyi zab gnad la mnga' brnyes pa'i sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin pa zhig tu gyur/de nas bsam sdings su dpal ldan bla ma dam pa byams pa'i mtshan can gyi drung du rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang yongs rdzogs dang / dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang bcas zhus/ bla ma dpal ldan chos kyi bzang po'i zhal snga nas/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang yongs su rdzogs pa bdag po chen po'i mthar thug pa dang / gsang bdag 'khor lo chen po/dril bu lha lnga/ gzungs grwa lnga/ dril bu lus dkyil sogs dbang mang po gsan/ gzhan yang dge ba'i bzhes gnyen rnams las/ gsang 'dus 'phags lugs dang / zhabs lugs/ skyon rje gshed dgra gdong 'jigs gsum/gshed dmar bram ze dpal 'dzin gyi lugs/ gdan bzhi'i gzhung bdun/sangs rgyas thod pa phyogs kyi rgya gzhung mang po dang / rgyud sde 'og ma ci rigs pa dang / grub pa sde bdun/ snying po skor drug yid la mi byed pa'i chos skor rnams dang / phreng ba skor gsum/ rgyud 'grel grags can phal che ba dang /bslab btus dang / byang sa sogs gzhung mang por thos bsam gnang bas blo gros kyi lus stobs ches cher rgyas te gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba'i mkhas pa chen por gyur/—5—

de nas bla ma kun dga'i mtshan can dang slob dpon rin po ches bka' bzhin/ rje 'di nyid dgung lo nyer gcig pa rab byung bcu pa'i shing lug hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes lnga(spyi lo1595)la/ ri khrod chen po jo mo nang gi gdan sa par bskos pa bzhin bla brang gi rtsis sprod rtsis len gnang rjes/ skyid phug tu zla gcig lhag tsam bcad mtshams la bzhugs te phag mo'i ljags bsnyen gnang skabs/ rmi lam du ngo bo slob dpon pad+ma yin pa'i rnal 'byor pa gzi brjid che ba zhig gi drung du/ dwags po rnyi ba rin po che dge bshes bgres song gi rnam par bzhugs 'dug pa las/ rnal 'byor pa'i zhal nas nga dang dol po pa ngo bo gcig yin gsung pa dang / bod kyi dge bshes bgres song des kyang nga yang ngo bo gcig yin gsung pa rmis pas/ dang po pad 'byung gi rten 'brel de sad de sgom gyi sa bon thebs/ bar skabs su dwags po rin po ches chos kyis rtogs pa brnyes/ phyis kun mkhyen chen po'i bzhed dgongs ltar nyams su myong ba'i brda ru go /de nas rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta pu rje nan+da dang pra yā mā nan+da gnyis dang mjal 'phrad mdzad de gsung gleng gnang bas/ khong gnyis grub mtha' nang par 'dug kyang pha mes kyi chos rig byed la yang zhen che bas/ phyi rol pa'i lha gcig gnyis bsten gyin 'dug pas dbang chos sogs ni ma zhus/ rig pa'i gnas thams cad la shin tu mkhas par 'dug pas dogs gcod mang du bgyis shing bstan bcos kyang than thun bsgyur/ bha ra ta dang rā ma ya ṇa la sogs pa'i lo rgyus kyang mang du thos/ de skabs rā ma ya ṇa'i srung ma ha nu ma tha'i cho 'phrul lus —6—

byang chen gyi ri dang mnyam pa'i spre'u dang / bha ra ta'i srung ma rgyal po sgyi ma dngos su mthong bas paṇ+ḍi ta na re/ khyod la 'go bar 'dug mthu dang snyan grags longs spyod chen po yong gsungs na yang / chos la mi dad pa'i lha 'dre bsten pas ci bya snyam nas yal bar dor ba yin zhes gsungs/lo dus chag med jo nang du sbyor drug gi khrid gsungs pas ngo ma 'phrod pa gcig kyang ma byung / rgya gar gyi slob dpon su ni khyu ṇa shrī dang puṇ+ḍa badz+ra sogs las zab khrid kyi gdams pa mang po gsan/ jo nang du sgrub mchod la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te/ 'dus pa bdun brgya tsam la dbang bcu gcig pa rdzogs par gnang / dgung grangs nyer drug skor rwa sgreng du phebs te tshogs su chos 'brel tsam dang / rje tsong kha pa'i bzhugs khri'i steng nas lam rim gsungs/dgung lo nyer dgu par jo nang du bzhugs skabs tho rengs shig la rje btsun byams pas zhal gzigs te/ khong rang la thim pa'i gzigs snang byung bas gzhan stong dbu ma'i grub mtha' la nges shes gting nas rnyed/ kun mkhyen dol po pas zhal yang yang gzigs nas lung bstan gnang ba dang /gzim lam du sham+bha lar phyin nas rigs ldan sprul pa'i sku dang mjal te chos gsan pa'i snang ba sogs gzigs snang mang po byung /dgung lo so dgu par chos 'khor lha sar phebs nas dar chen mang po bslangs te jo bo'i mdun thugs smon zab rgyas gnang / de nas kun mkhyen dol po pa'i sku brnyan gsung byon ma dang / thugs rje chen po/ tshe dpag med bcas —7—

byin rlabs can gyi rten gsum po'i mdun du mchod 'bul dang thugs smon rgya chen da ri / ༵ / zhe ga cig ༵ snro ༵ dzi ༵༵ /snra sna/nga yos sto zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gcig (spyi lo1615)la/ gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyis chos gzhis dang / lha 'bangs sogs rgya cher phul nas mthun rkyen sbyar ba las/dzhai rlo gas kau/kau sna tsug lag khang dang dag 'arnga grwa / bang ༵ tsha spre ༵ ga sdu lca gas ri dang bca sa pa/ nang gi rten sangs rgyas rabs bdun dang / tshe dpag med/ sgrol ma/dhi tā~X rnyi/ma ༵ rdo dhi ༵ ༵lha ༵shā zangs rdzob / sa gser zanga~X ༵ sa ༵ba /pa dngal da slong / bde g.ye/gas mchod rten cha brgyad sogs rten gsum dpag tu med pa bzhengs/jo nang du yang lha khang gsar bzhengs dang nang rten byams chen thog tshad gnyis tsam gser zangs las grub pa sogs mang po bzhengs/ gzhan yang lha bzo sogs lag rtsal pa rnams dang po rgya bal sogs nas gdan drangs/ de nas bris pa dang / spar brko shing bzo sogs lag rtsal pa gso skyong gnang bas/༵dho/ kū/ rjo ༵ ma / tsha ༵ mang ༵ dhi ga/bka ༵ 'a ༵ ༈tā dho rjo sna ba/༵ shing par du ༵sdu /shig sna smo kau/ ༵rdo rdo rjo kā ༵ dzī sna/ wo/ ra byung ba'i nang / yar klung lo tsā ba'i phyag dpe ngo ma dus 'khodzo ra 'grel chen pod gnyis —8—

'dug dus 'khor rgyud kyi dpe de dbus phyogs nas snga mo zhig tu lag son byung ba dang / 'grel pa 'di skabs su rnyed pa la ya mtshan chen po byung ste thengs mang bklags pas zung sbyor la yang blo skyed chen po byung / gzhan yang dbang mdor bstan gyi 'grel pa don dam bsdus pa'i mdzad byang la nā ro pa'i mtshan yod pa dang / kyai rdo rje'i 'grel pa rdo rje'i tshig bsdus kyi mdzad byang du byang chub bzang po'i skad dod bo dhi bha dra zhes yod pa sogs mang po byung /yang skabs shig gtsang pa sde srid kyis sog po'i steng du dmag dpung chas rtsis la srung 'khor dang sku rim gnang ba'i tshe/ khong ni rje tsong kha pa chen por lhag tu dad pa che ba dang / khyad par du chos sde chen po 'bras sbungs la nye sems kyi bag chags shin tu che ba zhig yod pas/ chos sde chen po de nyid dar zhing rgyas pa dang rtsod pa 'jam po'i sgo nas zhi ba'i smon lam btab kyang / nus pa ma thon pa ni phyogs gnyis ka las ngan gyi dbang gis ded pa la g.yol thabs bral zhes gsungs/ de nas dpal 'khordo ra bde chen/ rtse chen chos sde/'jag bsam gnyis/ thar pa gling / rtag brtan chos 'phel sogs dbus gtsang gi chos sde mang por chos dang longs spyod kyi bsnyen bkur rgya chen gnang ste bskyangs/de nas dgung grangs re gcig bzhes pa rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1635)la/ rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gdan sa 'jam dbyangs sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho la gtad de/ chos lung rtse dang jo mo nang du dus khrid phyag len rgyas pa gnang nas/ da res ma gtogs —9—

'dir chos mi 'chad gsungs te bu slob rnams la zhal ta mang po gnang ste/ lo de'i nag pa zla ba'i tshes nyer brgyad la zhi bar gshegs so//slob ma/ sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang ye shes rgya mtsho/mkhan chen rin chen rgya mtsho/ mkhas grub blo gros rnam rgyal rnams dang / sgam po sprul sku/ chos rje ngag dbang pa/ bla ma chu bo chung ba'i sku skye/ mkhan po kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ sprul sku ngag gi dbang po/ tre bo sprul sku/chos rje rin stengs pa/ dus lubor shar chen pa/ chos rje lha bo pa/ dge slong snying po mtha' yas/ byams pa yon tan mgon po/ ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ mi pham dkon mchog legs pa/ kun dga' 'phrin las dbang mo/gtsang gi rgyal sras kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sogs mang po byung /gzhan yang bstan pa'i sbyin bdag gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal/ byang bdag bkra shis stobs rgyal/ yar 'brog bstan 'dzin mi 'gyur dbang gi rgyal po sogs mang ngo/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas karma bde legs kyis/— 10—

dpal gsang 'dus pa'i sgrub thabs 'bar ba'i 'od gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 1gsang ba 'dus pa'i sgrub dkyil 'bar ba'i 'od gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 34dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i mngon par rtogs pa ye shes snang byed ces bya ba bzhugs/ 75dpal gsang ba 'dus pa ye shes zhabs lugs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ye shes snang byed ces bya ba bzhugs/ 105dpal gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod rdo rje'i bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dngos grub 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 154gsang 'dus 'phags skor las rim lnga 'gos lugs kyi khrid yig rgyud don gsal ba bzhugs/ 156gsang 'dus 'phags lugs rim lnga smar khrid gdan rdzogs kyi khrid yig 'khrul ba'i dri bral zhes bya ba mar pa'i dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhugs/ 194gsang 'dus ye shes zhabs lugs kyi man ngag las/ zab gsal dbyer med kyi khrid yig bzhugs/ 223
thas

'od gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs/oX khyu sti/ mdor byas kyi rjes su 'brangs pa/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i sgrub thabs 'bar ba'i 'od gsal zhes bya ba bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde chen rdo rje 'dzin zhabs la/ /gus pa'i yid kyi btud byas nas/ /de nyid bzhi bcu rtsa dgu dang / /yan lag drug ldan rim pa bshad/ /de la 'dir ngag 'don tsam brjod par bya ste /de yang skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas rnams sngon du btang ste/ nang mchod byin gyis brlabs nas 'bru gsum gyis myang ngo / /oX swa bhā wa shu rdzaX sarba dharmā swa bhā wa shudhe ྅haX/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang chen po sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas/ rang dang 'dra ba'i yum rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma la 'phyud pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad yongs su rdzogs shing / dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o/ /thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs/ spyi gtsug nas zhugs byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+ma ra babs pa huX du gyur/ huX las rdo rje hūX gis mtshan pa las/ mi bskyod par gyur pa thugs kar drangs/ badz+ra lha ka thugs ka nas phyir phyung phyogs bcur spros sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa thams cad mdzad/ slar 'dus ye shes pa dang 'dres/ rang la thim pas bdag rdi/ zhe sdang rdo rje nag po rtsa ba'i zhal rab

tu khros pa/ nag dkar dmar pa'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas rdo rje 'khor lo pad+ma/ g.yon dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis pad nyi'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ phyogs bcu'i nam mkha' la pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan re re/ rang gi snying ga nas hūX yig bcu spros/ gdan de rnams kyi steng du 'khod/ huX de rnams las 'od 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i bgegs dang gnod byed thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus te thim/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ shar du gshin rje mthar byed/ lhor shes rab mthar byed/ nub tu rta mgrin/ byang du bdud rtsi 'khyil pa/ shar lhor mi g.yo ba/ lho nub tu 'dod rgyal/ nub byang du dbyug sngon can/ byang shar du stobs po che/ steng du gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba/ 'og tu gnod mdzes rgyal po rnams 'khod par gyur/ 'og gi gnod mdzes las gnod mdzes gnyis pa 'ongs te mdun du 'dug nas/bdag gis ci bgyi zhes bka' nod pa la/ 8kho sum+bha ni sum+bha huX/ gro sna gro sna huX/ grot+na pā ya gro sna pā ya huX/ ā na ya ho bha ga wan bi du rā dza hūX phaṭa/ ces bka' bsgos pas/ gnod mdzes de nyid gnod mdzes bcur gyur te/ g.yas dang po lcags kyu thogs pa rnams kyis/ phyogs bcu'i bgegs rnams/ phyogs skyong bcu'i rnam par gyur pa rnams zhags pas bcings/ lcags kyus btab/ lhag ma mtshon cha sna tshogs pas sdigs te bkug nas phyi rol tu hūṃ las byung ba'i 'khrub khung zab mo rnams su bcug par gyur/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba las bdud rtsi 'khyil ba lte ba man chad phur bu'i dbyibs can 'bar ba'i 'phreng ba 'khrug pa bcu spros te/ bgegs rnams kyi spyi bor zug glu( gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ sarba sdo ྅ ༷ phaṭa phaṭa/ gī la ya gī la ya/ sarba pā paX phaṭa phaṭa huX huX huX/ badz+ra ki la badz+ra dha ro ā dz+nya pa ya ti sarba bigha nan/ kā ya lha ka —2—

tsit+ta badz+ra/ gī la ya hū hu hu phaṭa phaṭa/ ces gnod mdzes la bka' bsgos pas/ de nyid rdo rje tho ba thogs par gyur te/ phur bu'i spyi bo nas brdungs/ bgegs rnams kyi spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar du phug lus ngag yid gsum gyi g.yo ba chad de 'od gsal gyi ngang du thim/ gnod mdzes rnams 'og gi gnod mdzes la thim/ khro bo dang phur bu rnams las rdo rje'i me lce phyogs bcur sprod pas/ bgegs kyi lhag ma thams cad tshig cing bros/ me lce slar 'dus nas/ me'i ra gur du gyur/o badz+ra dz+wa la a na lwarka hu hu hu/ ṭak+ki hu dza rdo rje'i ra bar gyur/ 'og tu hū gi 'od zer 'phro 'du las/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang / steng du hū las rdo rje'i gur du gyur/ rang gi spyi bor zla ba la o dkar po/ mgrin par pad+ma la ā dmar po/snying gar nyi ma la hu sngon po/ o ā hū lan mang du bzla/ de dag ni bsrung ba'i 'khor le'o/ /dngos po med la sgom pa med/ /bsgom par bya ba sgom pa min/ /de ltar dngos po dngos med pas/ /sgom pa dmigs su med pa'o/ /gang yang mi dmigs te stong pa la cung zad mnyam par gzhag ye shes kyis bskyed pa'o/ /stong pa'i ngang las chos kyi 'byung gnas dkar po zur gsum pa gdeng ka gyen du phyogs pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su/ sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar/ ya las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zla gam de'i steng du ra las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum/ de'i steng du ba las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po/ de'i stong du la las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi/ de ltar dkyil 'khor bzhi po re re zhing / steng 'og gi logs gnyis su/ hū gnyis las byung ba'i rdo rje rang mdog dang mtshungs pa gnyis gnyis kyis mtshan par gyur/ dkyil 'khor bzhi po gcig tu 'dres pa las/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi rdo rje'i sa gzhir gyur/ de dang dus mnyam —3—

du rwa gur me lce'i 'phreng ba dang bcas pa'i bsrung pa'i 'khor lo sngon bzhin du grub par gyur/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i steng du bhu las thar pa chen po'i khang bzang gzhal yas khang rin po che sna lnga las rdzogs par grub pa/ thub pa'i dbang po'i 'od zer gyis mtha' yas pa'i phyogs kun du khyab pa/ gru bzhi sgo bzhi/ phyi nas rim pa bzhin du/ dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i rtsigs pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du rin po che'i pha gu dmar pos bskor ba'i steng na gser gyi ska rags bzhi'i phyi ngos su chu srin gyi kha nas 'phyang ba'i dra ba dra phyed/ de'i steng du bya 'dab las 'phyang ba'i shar bu/ steng du mda' yab mchod rten gyi dbyibs can gyis yongs su bskor ba la/ rgyal mtshan dang ba dan la sogs pa rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan pa/ rtsig pa'i phyi 'gram 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar pos bskor ba la/ bzhugs stangs dang kha dog sna tshogs pa'i gzugs ma rnams kyis mchod rdzas sna tshogs pa thogs nas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa/sgo bzhi'i mdun du stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i steng du bum pa la gnas pa'i ka ba bzhi bzhis btegs pa'i rta babs snam bu bcu gcig gi rtse mor/ pad+ma la gnas pa'i 'khor lo dang/ g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mos brgyan pa/ sgo dang sgo khyud kyi phyi mtshams dang / grwa bzhir zla phyed la gnas pa'i/ rin po che dmar po la rdo rjes mtshan pa'i brgyan pa/ rta babs kyi g.yas g.yon du bum pa bzang po dang dpag bsam gyi shing dang / rgyal srid sna bdun dang / sprin gyi gseb nas byung ba'i lha mo me tog gi 'phreng ba thogs pa rnams kyis brgyan pa/ gzhal yas khang gi nang dkyil 'khor gyi phyed kyi tshad kyi phyi ngos su 'od zer rnam pa lnga'i —4—

'phreng bas bskor ba'i nang du rdo rje rtse gsum pas zlum por bskor ba la brten pa'i ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa ste/ shar du 'khor lo/ lhor rin po che/ nub du pad+ma/ byang du ral gris mtshan pa'i ka ba gnyis gnyis kyis bteg pa'i steng rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mangs ris su bris shing mdzes par phub pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mo rdo rje rin po che'i tog gi spras pa/ rim pa gnyis pa'i grwa bzhi'i g.yas g.yon du bkra shis kyi bum pa brgyad dang bcas pa/ mchod pa'i sprin thams cad kyis mngon par brgyan pa'i khang bzang dam pa/ nang gi steng 'og gi gzhi rnams/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / dbus sngo ba'i nang le tshe dgur gyur pa/ lha'i gnas thams cad du sna tshogs pad+ma'i gdan re re/ gtso bo'i gnas dang / khro bo bcu'i gnas su nyi ma/ gzhan shar phyogs pa rnams la zla ba/ mā ma gī la rdo rje/ gzhan lho phyogs pa rnams la rin po che/nub phyogs pa rnams la chu skyes dmar po/ byang phyogs pa rnams la sna tshogs rdo rje'i gdan rnams su gyur/ de nas lhag mos kyi dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ni/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang sngon po/ sngo dkar dmar pa'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas rdo rje 'khor lo/ pad+ma/ g.yon dril bu/ rin chen/ral gri 'dzin pa/ rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ rang dang mtshungs pa'i yum reg bya rdo rje mas 'khyud pa thugs dkar mi bskyod pa/ le tshe brgyad la shar du rnam par snang mdzad/ ltor rin chen 'byung ldan/ nub tu 'od dpag med/ byang du don yod grub pa rnams mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ shar lhor spyan ma/ lho nub tu mā ma ki/ nub byang du gos dkar —5—

mo/ byang shar du sgrol ma rnams rim pa bzhin du/ rtag pa/ mi bskyod pa/ rdo rje chos/ gdon mi za ba rnams kyi cod pan can/ rim pa gnyis pa'i shar lhor gzugs rdo rje ma/ lho nub tu sgra rdo rje ma/ nub byang du dri rdo rje ma/ byang shar du ro rdo rje ma rnams kyang rim pa bzhin/ rtag pa la sogs pa'i cod pan can no/ /rim pa gsum pa'i lha rnams la shar gyi g.yas su byams pa/ g.yon du sa'i snying po gnyis/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi cod pan can/ lho'i g.yas su phyag na rdo rje dang / g.yon du nam mkha'i snying po gnyis/ dkon mchog dpal gyi cod pan can/ nub kyi g.yas su 'jig rten dbang phyug dang / g.yon du 'jam dpal gnyis/ tshe dpag med kyi cod pan can/ byang gi g.yas su sgrib pa rnam sel dang / g.yon du kun tu bzang po gnyis/ don yod grub pa'i cod pan can/shar sgor gshin rje gshed rnam snang gi lho sgor gzhan gyi mi thub pa rin 'byung ginub sgor rta mgrin 'od dpag med kyi/ byang sgor bgegs mthar byed don grub kyi/ shar lhor mi g.yo ba rtag pa'i/ lho nub tu 'dod rgyal rin chen tog gi nub byang du dbyug sngon can 'od dpag med kyi/ byang shar du stobs po che don yod rgyal po'i steng du gtsug tor 'khor los skyur ba dang / 'og tu gnod mdzes gnyis/ zhe sdang rdo rje'i cod pan can rnams 'khod par gyur/ rang gi snying ka nas 'od zer 'phros sems can thams cad bkug nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs bzhi nas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i 'jug pas thogs pa med par zhugs pa la/ rjes chags las byung ba'i byang chub sems kyi 'od zer gyis dbang bskur bas/ sdig sgrib thams cad dag de bzhin gshe/gas pa thams cad kyi bde ba —6—

dang yid bde ba thob nas/ rdo rje sems dpar gyur te/ rang rang gi zhing du gshegs par gyur to/ /de yan chad ni rnal 'byor gyi sngon du 'gro ba'i to nge 'dzin no/ /de nas lhag mos de/ rang lus la bsdu ba ni/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ dkyil 'khore gyi lha tshogs thams cad rang lus la zhugs/ spyi bor rnam snang dang sgrol ma/ mgrin par 'od dpag med dang gos dkar mo/snying gar mi bskyod pa dang mā ma gī dang 'jam dpal/ lte bar rin 'gyung dang spyan ma/ 'doms par du don grub/ mig tu sa snying dang gzugs rdo rje ma/ rna bar phyag rdor dang sgra rdo rje ma/ snar nam snying dang dri rdo rje ma/ lce la spyan ras gzigs dang ro rdo rje ma/ gsang sgor sgrib sel dang reg rdo rje ma/ tshigs rnams la kun bzang / spyi gtsug tu byams pa/ phyag g.yas la ya mun ta ka g.yon la prarnyo na ta ka zhal la rta mgrin/ gsang bar bdud rtsi 'khyil ba/ dpung ba g.yas par mig g.yo ba/ g.yon par 'dod rgyal/ pus mo g.yas par dbyug sngon can/ g.yon par stobs po che/ spyi bor gtsug tor/ rkang mthil gnyis su gnod mdzes rnams 'khod par gyur/ lhag mos don dam du bsdu ba ni/ rnam snang spyan ma gzugs dang byams pa dang / /sa snying gzhin dgra mi g.yo 'od gsal thim/ /rin 'byung bdag ma sgra dang phyag rdor dang / /gzhan gyis mi thub 'dod rgyal 'od gsal thim/ /dpag med gos dkar dri dang nam mkha'i snying / /rta mgrin dbyug sngon 'od gsal ngang du thim/ /don grub sgrol ma ro dang 'jig rten mgon/ /sgrib sel kun bzang bdud rtsi 'khyil ba dang / /stobs po che rnams 'od gsal dbyings su thim/ /gtsug tor gnod mdzes reg bya 'jam dbyangs —7—

la/ /'jam dpal mi bskyod pa la thim pa dang / /mi bskyod pa ni gzhi lus rdor sems la/ /de yang 'od gsal ngang du zhugs par gyur/ /de nas thams cad stong pa bde ba chen po rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag par mos/ oṃ hūṃ n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ de ni byang chub rnam pa lnga las de bzhin nyid las byang chub pa'o/ /stong pa'i ngang las dbus kyi gdan gyi steng gi nam mkha' la/ hūX nag po las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/de'i steng du lkoX dkar po las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du āXdamar po las 'dam skyes 'char ka'i mdog can 'dab ma brgyad pa/ de'i steng du oX dkar po/ āXdamar po/ hūX sngon po rnams steng nas steng du brtsegs par gyur/huX āXl thim/ āX.oṃ la thim/ oX pad+ma la thim/ pad+ma dang nyi ma zla ba la thim/snod bcud thams cad kyang de la rab tu zhugs te/ sems tsam zla bar snang ba'o/ /oX dharmā bhā tu swa bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ zla ba las byang chub pa'o/ /lhag mos lus la bsdu ba nas/ de'i bar ni rnal 'byor dang po'o/ /zla ba'i steng du oX āXhuX brtsegs pa'o/ /sa bon las byang chub pa'o/ /de las 'od 'phros sangs rgyas sras bcas thams cad rigs lnga'i rnam par spyan drangs te thim pa las/ rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa lte ba la/ oX āXhuX dkar dmar mthing kas mtshan pa/ badz+ra ut+pa ko3haX/phyag mtshan las byang chub pa'o/ /de yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid dang po'i mgon po sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gi pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad yongs su rdzogs shing / dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o/ /sku rdzogs pa las byang chub pa'o/ /de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mkha' dbyings —8—

gang ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rjes chags kyis byang chub sems su zhu ba las byung ba'i rgyal ba mi bskyod pa dpag tu med pa rnams kyis/ sems can thams cad byin gyis brlabs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bde ba dang yid bde ba thob par gyur/ de dag ni rjes su rnal 'byor ro/ /tshur 'dus gzhal yas khang gi nang du gcig tu 'dres nas/ bdag nyid dang gnyis su med par gyur pa las/ rdo rje sems dpa' sprul pa'i sku sngon po sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum nas/ rin po ches brgyan par gyur/ de nas lus dkyil bsgom pa ni/lus ni gzhal yas khang du gyur/ sangs rgyas kun gyis yang dag brten/ / zur bzhi po ni mdun rgyab dang / /g.yas dang g.yon gyi dbye bas so/ /steng 'og sgo yi dbye ba yis/ /sgo bzhi zhes ni bshad pa yin/ lte gsang snying ga gdong ste bzhi/ /sna yi rtse mo'i dbyibs kyis ni/ /rta babs bzhir ni brjod par bya/ /dra ba rgyu mar yang dag bshad/ /rgyus par gyur pa dra ba phyed/ /cha ni zla ba phyed pa dang / /bum pa lto bar yang dag bshad/ /rje ngar brla dpung lag ngar ni/ /ka pa brgyad du rnam par bshad/ /mig gi rnam shes me long sogs/ sgra yi rnam shes ba dan dang / sna yi rnam shes me tog 'phreng / /rin chen pha gu lce rnam shes/ /lus kyi rnam shes dar 'phan dang / /yid kyi rnam shes ri dwags so/ /mig ni 'khor lo'i mtshan ma dang / /rna ba kun nas rdo rje rnams/ /sna ni ba dan du ni bshad/ /lce ni dril bu ru ni gsungs/ /rnga yab la sogs rnam dag pa/ /lus kyi tshogs shes bya bar bshad/ /yid kyi dbus kyi pad+ma ra gsungs/ /rnam rtog rlung ni yang dag bstan/ /ye shes lnga ni rnam dag pa/ /re kha lngar ni yang dag brjod/ /phung —9—

po lnga ni yang dag lnga/ /rnam dag kha dog lnga ni byed/ /de dag gzhal yas khang du bsgom/ /spyi bor gzugs phung oṃ las rnam par snang mdzad/ mgrin par 'du shes āXlas 'od dpag med/ snying gar rnam shes huX las mi bskyod pa/ lte bar tshor ba snyu las rin chen 'byung ldan/ 'dom par du 'du byed hā las don yod grub pa/ slar yang lte bar sa khams laX las spyan ma/ snying khar chu khams maX las mā ma gī/ mgrin par me khams paX la gos dkar mo/ spyi bor rlung khams tāX las sgrol ma rnams/ de bru zhin gshegs pa rnams kyi mdun du bzhugs par gyur/ mig gi dbang po zla las sa'i snying po/ rna ba'i dbang po oX las phyag na rdo rje/ sna'i dbang po oX las nam mkha' snying po/ lce'i dbang po oX las 'jig rten dbang phyug snying gar yid dbang huX las 'jam dpal/ gsang sgor lus dbang oX las sgrib sel/ lus kyi tshigs mtshams rnams saX las kun tu bzang po/ spyi gtsug tu rtsa rgyus mai las byams pa/ sa'i snying po sogs drug la shes rab mas 'khyud pa ni/ mig gi sgor yul gzugs dzaXlas gzugs rdo rje ma/ rna ba'i sgor yul sgra huX las sgra rdo rje ma/ sna'i sgor yul dri baX las dri rdo rje ma/lce rtser yul ro hoXlas ro rdo rje ma/ rtags kyi sgor yul reg bya khaX las reg bya rdo rje ma/ lag pa g.yas par hūX las gshin rje gshed/ g.yon par hūṃ las/gzhan gyi mi thub pa/ khar huX las rta mgrin/ gsang bar huX las bdud rtsi 'khyil ba/ dpung pa g.yas par huX las mi g.yo ba/ g.yon par huX las 'dod rgyal/ pus mo g.yas par huX las dbyug sngon can/ g.yon par huX las stobs po che/ spyi gtsug tu huX las 'khor los sgyur ba/ rkang mthil du hūX las gnod —10—

mdzes rgyal po rnams bzhugs par gyur/ de dag ni rjes su rnal 'byor ro/ /de nas rdo rje gsum byin gyis brlab pa ni/ rang gi spyi bor oX las zla ba'i steng du oX dkar po 'od lnga 'phro ba/ de las spyan ma nam mkha' gang ba spros/ sku rdo rje rnam snang gi lha tshogs nam mkha' gang ba spyan drangs/ de'i gtso bo spyan ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i mdun du bdag nyid 'dug dpal ldan sangs rgyas sku 'chang ba/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /rdo rje skus ni mdzad du gsol/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /rdo rje sku yis mdzad du gsol/ /sku rdo rje yab yum 'khor bcas bdag gi spyi gtsug nas thim/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gang yin/ /phung po lnga yis rab tu rgyas/ /sangs rgyas sku yi rang bzhin gyis/ /bdag kyang de dang 'dra bar shog /oX sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra swa bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ 'dis 'og ma gnyis la'ang rigs 'gre bar bya ste/ lce'i dbus su āXlas pad+ma'i steng du ā dmar po 'od lnga 'phro ba/ de las gos dkar mo/ gsung rdo rje 'od dpag med kyi lha tshogs/ gos dkar mo dang sbyor ba'i/ chos kyi gsung lam dpal dang ldan/ /rdo rje: /deng bdag: /rdo rje gsung gis: /phyogs /rdo rje: /deng bdag /rdo rje gsung gis: /gsung rdo rje yab yum/ lce'i dbus su thim/ rdo rje chos kyi gsung gang yin/ /gsung de nges tshig phun sum tshogs/ /bdag gi tshig kyang de 'dra ste/ /chos 'dzin pa dang 'dra bar tro(ga /oX sarba ta thā ga ta lha ka badz+ra swa bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ snying gar hūX las nyi ma'i steng du hūX sngon po 'od lnga 'phro ba/ thugs rdo rje mi bskyod pa mā ma ki dang /—11—

dpal ldan rdo rje thugs 'chang ba/ /rdo rje: /deng bdag : /rdo rje thugs kyis: /phyogs : /rdo rje: /deng bdag: /rdo rje thugs kyis: /thugs rdo rje yab yum/snying gar thim/ gsang ba'i dbang po blo ldan pa/ /kun tu bzang po thugs gang yin/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa lta bur ni/ /bdag gi sems kyang de 'drar shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ de ltar bdag nyid rgyal ba kun gyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje dbyer mi phyed pa khyab bdag chen po'i ngo bor gyur/ oX sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya lha ka tsit+ta ut+pa ko3haX/ rang gi thugs kar sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba la/ ye shes sems dpa' sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas/ rang snang ba'i yum la 'khyud pa/ de gnyis kha sbyor gyi sbyor bas dam tshig sems dpa'i lus rgyas par byed par gyur/ de'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du rdo rje sngon po'i lte bar/ ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' huX nag po/mar me chen po lta bu/ mi shes pa'i mun pa 'joms pa'i 'od snang gi phung po rtag tu 'char ba'o/ /rang nyid dam tshig sems dpa' ral pa'i cod pan la/ rigs bdag rdo rje 'chang wo po sku mdog dkar po/ rang 'dra ba'i rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma la 'khyud pa/ yab yum snyoms par 'jug pa'i sbyor bas/ byang chub kyi sems kyi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun zla ba zhun ma lta bu babs te bdag la thim pas tshim zhing bde ba chen po'i ngo bor gyur/ de dag ni rnal wor r+ṣa i kho nge 'dzin no/ /de nas rig ma 'du bya ba ni/ rang gi snying ga nas/ rang gi rigs dang mthun pa'i ye shes kyi rig ma phyung / stong pa'i ngang las khaX dang rdo rje las rig ma de nyid reg bya rdo rje ma/ kha dog dang mtshon cha gtso bo dang mtshungs pa las/ sgeg cing —12—

lang tsho la bab pa/ nu 'bur lhag par rgyas pa bud med sgyu ma'i nga rgyal gyis 'gying ba/ rig pa'i yum gyi masno nyid yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ de'i spyi bor oṃ las rnam par snang mdzad/ mgrin par āXlas 'od dpag med nas/ spyi bor tāX las sgrol ma rnams de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi mdun du bzhugs par gyur gyi bar gong bzhi las/ phung khams kyi ming dor/ de bzhin du mig gi sgor dzaXlas gzugs rdo rje ma nas/ reg bya rdo rje ma'i bar la'ang yul lnga'i ming dor/ de lnga char rang rang gi thabs la 'khyud pa'o/ /lag pa g.yas par huX las ro langs ma/ g.yon par huX las gzhan gyi mi thub ma/ khar huX las khro gnyer can ma/ bha gar huX las ral gcig ma/ dpung pa g.yas par huX las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yum rdo rje ma/ g.yon par hūX las sna tshogs rin chen ma/ pus mo g.yas par huX las sna tshogs pad+ma ma/ g.yon par hūX las sna tshogs las ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūX las nam mkha'i rdo rje ma/ rkang mthil du hūX las sa 'dzin lha mo rnams so/ khro mo 'di rnams kyi sku mdog phyag mashaṃ ni/ rang rang gi khro bo dang 'dra bar shes par bya'o/ /yab kyi gsang gnas hūX las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa/ nor bu la oṃ dkar pos mtshan pa yum gyi gsang gnas āXlas pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa/ rang nyid rin chen 'byung ldan gyi ngo bor gyur/ 'byud pa la sogs pa rjes chags kyi spyod pa brtsam/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ rang nyid rdo rje 'chang chen po'i ngo bor gyur/ rdo rje dang pad+ma'i nang 'od zer sna lngas gang / hūX hūX huX snyoms par zhugs/ phaṭa rang don yod grub pa'i ngo bor gyur/ sku'i cha thams cad nas zla ba byang chub kyi sems zhu zhing 'phel pas/ lus dkyil gyi lha thams cad bde bas —13—

tshim/ byang chub kyi sems shes rab ma'i chu skyes kyi dbus su sbrang rtsi ltar babs pas/ bde gshegs 'khor bcas thams cad mchodi par gyur/ lkoX sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra su bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ slar yang yab yum snyoms par zhugs/thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs/ spyi gtsug nas zhugs/ lus dkyil gyi lha rnams dang lhan cig thig ler zhu te/ rdo rje'i lam nas pad+ma ra babs pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi thig le cha gnyis su gyur/ cha gcig bhuX las byung ba'i gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas par gyur/ cha gcig cha so gnyis su gyur nas so so'i gdan gyi steng du 'khod/skabs 'dir lha re re bzhin bskyed pa la/ sngags dang phyag mtshan sku gzugs bskyed/ /phyi rol spro zhing 'phrin las mdzad/ /gcig bsdus ye shes pa dang bsre/ /gnas su bkod de don tshan bdun//zhes pa ltar yin pas/ dbus kyi thig le oX āXhuX huX du gyur/ de las rdo rje rtse lnga pa/de las lha bas bgos pa ni/ mi bskyod nag po nag dkar dmar/ /dang po rdo rje dril bu 'dzin/ /'khor lo pad ma g.yas pas te/ /dril bu nor bu g.yon na'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i cod pan can/ /rang gi thugs kar drangs/ badz+ra dhika thugs ka nas phyir phyung / nam mkha'i khams thams cad khyad par spros/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba la sogs pa/ sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa thams cad mdzad/ khyad par du sems can thams cad kyi zhe sdang sbyangs te/ mi bskyod pa'i go 'phang la bkod/ sprul pa rnams gcig tu 'dus pa la/ gdod nas grub pa'i mi bskyod pa ye shes sems dpa'i tshul du thim/ rang gi rigs bdag yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub sems kyis dbang bskur/ rang gi snying ga nas zhugs te —14—

thim pas/ bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang zhi ba de/ slar zhe sdang rdo rjer gyur pa ni/ sku mdog sngon po in+d+ra ni la ltar 'bar ba'i 'od zer 'phro ba/ rtsa zhal mthing ka khro ba dang 'dod chags chen po 'dres pa'i nyams can/ mche ba'i myu gu rnon po gtsigs pa/ khro gnyer bsdus shing spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ g.yas zhal dkar po zhi ba'i nyams can/ g.yon zhal dmar po chags pa'i nyams can/ zhal gsum kar yang rab tu mdzes pa'i smin tshugs kyis brgyan pa/ rin po che'i sor gdub kyis spras pa'i phyag drug gi dang po gnyis rdo rje nag po rtse dgu pa dang /dril bu 'dzin pas yum reg bya rdo rje ma rang dang mtshungs pa la 'khyud pa/g.yas gnyis pa na 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa/ gsum pa na pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa/ g.yon gnyis pa na rin po che ljang khu rtse mo dgu pa/gsum pa na ral gri sngo sangs 'od zer 'bar pa 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / dpe byad brgyad cus brgyan pa/ dbu skra ral ba'i thor tshugs spyi bor bcings pa/ nyi zla'i 'od zer rab tu 'bar zhing sil sil gyi sgra sgrog pa'i rin po che'i thor tshugs dbu rgyan/snyan rgyan mgul rgyan/ do shal/ dpung rgyan/ gdu bu/ so mo do/ ska rags te rin po che'i rgyan brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ snyan gong du utrula'i gdengs ka dang dar dpyangs kyis mdzes par byas pa/ dbang po'i gzhu ltar bkra ba'i lha'i dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' gsol zhing srid zhi'i mtha' las 'das pa/ sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan thams cad dang ldan par gyur/ le tshe brgyad la shar gyi thig le oṃ ā oṃ hu dang 'khor lor gyur pa las/ rnam snang dkar po dkar nag —15—

dmar/ dang po 'khor lo dril bu 'dzin/ rdo rje pad dkar g.yas pas ste rin chen ral gri g.yon na'o/ /mi bskyod rdo rje'i dbu rgyan can/ thugs kar drangs/dzi na ji ka thugs ka nas phyir phyung / nam mkha'i khams: chos kyi 'khor lor:khyad par du sems can thams cad kyi gti mug sbyangs te/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi go 'phang / sprul pa rnams/ gdod nas grub pa'i/ rang gi rigs bdag nas/dbang bskur/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i shar gyi re mig tu pad zla'i gdan la 'khod par gyur/ de bzhi du 'og ma rnams la sbyar te/ lho'i/ o ā snyu hu dang rin po cher/ rin 'byung ser po ser nag dkar/ /dang po nor bu dril bu 'dzin/ /rdo rje 'khor lo g.yas pas te/ /pad ser ral gri g.yon na'o/ /mi bskyod rdo rje'i dbu rgyan can/ /rat+na dhika nga rgyal dang ser sna sbyangs te rin 'byung gi gdod nas grub pa'i rin 'gyung / lho'i re mig tu/ pad+ma dang rin po che'i gdan la 'khod/nub kyi o ā ā hu dang pad mar/ 'od dpag med dmar dmar nag dkar/g.yon gyi dang po pad rtsa dang / dril bu lhan cig dkur brten 'dzin/ g.yas pas pad+ma dmar po ni/ 'dab brgyad thugs kar kha 'byed pa'o/ /rdo rje 'khor lo g.yas pa te/ /rin chen ral gri g.yon na'o/ /mi bskyod rdo rje'i dbu rgyan can//a ro lika 'dod chags sbyangs te/ gdod nas grub pa'i 'od dpag med/ nub kyi re mig tu pad+ma brtsegs pa'i gdan la/ byang gi o ā hā hu dang ral grir/don grub ljang khu ljang nag dkar/ /dang po ral gri dril bu 'dzin/ /sna tshogs rdo rje 'khor lo g.yas/ /pad+ma ljang khu nor bu g.yon/ /mi bskyod rdo rje'i dbu rgyan can/ /pradz+nyā lha ka brdzun dang phrag dog sbyangs te don grub kyi/ gdod nas grub —16—

pa'i don grub/ byang gi re mig tu/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i gdan la zhes pa ni khyad par ro/ /'di man chad la chos kyi 'khor lo zhes pa nas thams cad mdzad/ khyad par du zhes pa'i tshig rnams dor bar bya'o/ /de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi yang / rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /de bzhin du sbyar te/ shar lho'i o ā la hu dang /ut+pal dkar po/ spyan ma dkar mo dkar nag dmar/ /dang po 'khor lo dril bu 'dzin/ /rdo rje ut+pal dkar po g.yas/ /rin chen ral gri g.yon na'o/ / rnam snang mdzad kyi cod pan can/ /mo ha ra tī/ sems can gyi khams na gdon dang nad kyis gdungs pa thams cad zhi bar mdzad/ gdod nas grub pa'i sangs rgyas spyan ma/ shar lho'i re mig tu zla ba'i gdan la/ lho nub kyi oṃ ā ma hū dang ut+pal sngo dmar du/ mā ma gī sngo sngo dkar dmar/ dang po rdo rje dril bu 'dzin//'khor lo ut+pal sngo dmar g.yas/ /dril bu nor bu g.yon na'o/ /mi bskyod rgyal po'i cod pan can/ /dī ṣa ra tī/ sems can gyi khams na bgegs kyis gzir ba rnams las bsrungs te rgyas par mdzad/ grub pa'i mā ma gī/ lho nub kyi re mig tu rdo rje'i gdan/ nub byang gi oṃ ā pa hū dang / ut+pal dmar po/ gos dkar mo dmar dmar nag dkar/ ut+pal rtsa ba g.yon dang pos/ / dril bu lhan cig dkur brten zhing / /g.yas pas ut+pal dmar po ni/ /'dab brgyad thugs kar kha 'byed pa/ /rdo rje 'khor lo g.yas pas te/ /rin chen ral gri g.yon na'o/ /'od dpag med pa'i cod pan can/ /rā ga ra tī/ sems can gyi khams na gdon gyis nyen pa thams cad la bsrungs ba mdzad/ grub pa'i gos dkar mo/ nub byang gi re mig tu pad+ma rtsegs pa'i gdan la/ byang shar gyi oṃ —17—

ā tā hu dang / ut+pal ljang khur/ sgrol ma ljang khu ljang nag dkar/ /dang po sna tshogs rdor dril 'dzin/ /'khor lo ut+pal rdo rjes mtshan/ /rin chen ral gri g.yas g.yon na'o/ /don yod grub pa'i dbu rgyan can/ /badz+ra ra tī/ sems can thams cad dbang du 'du bar mdzad/ grub pa'i sgrol ma/ byang shar gyi re mig tu/sna tshogs rdo rje'i gdan la 'khod/ /rim pa gnyis pa'i shar lho'i/ oṃ ā dza : / me long dmar por/ dkar mo gzugs kyi rdo rje ma/ /rtsa phyag me long dmar po 'dzin/ /lhag ma sangs rgyas spyan ma bzhin/ /rnam par snang mdzad kyi dbu rgyan can/ rū pa badz+ra/ gzugs kyi skye mched sbyangs/ ye shes don dam pa'i gzugs kyi bde ba mchod/ grub pa'i gzugs rdo rje ma/ rim pa gnyis pa'i shar lhor zla ba la 'khod/ lho nub kyi oṃ ā hu hu dang pi wa du/ ser mo sgra yi rdo rje ma/ /ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum ste/ /rtsa phyag pi wa sngon po sgreng / /lhag ma mā ma ki dang mtshungs/ /mi bskyod rgyal pos dbu la brgyan/ kha snya badz+ra/ sgra'i skye mched sbyangs/ ye shes don dam pa'i sgra'i bde bas mchod/ grub pa'i sgra rdo rje ma/ lho nub tu rin po che'i gdan la 'khod/ nub byang gi oṃ ā ba hu dang / dri bzang gis gang ba'i dung phor du/dmar mo dri yi rdo rje ma/ /rtsa phyag dri bzang dung chos 'dzin/ /lhag ma gos dkar mo dang mtshungs/ /'od dpag med kyi dbu rgyan can/ /gan khyu badz+ra/ dri'i skyed mched sbyangs/ dri'i bde bas mchod/ nub byang du pad+ma dmar po'i gdan la 'khod/ byang shar gyi oṃ u ho ཿ dang / ro mchog gi snod du/ ljang khu ro yi rdo rje ma/ /rtsa phyag ro mchog gis gang snod/ khyad par gzhan rnams sgrol ma bzhin//—18—

rgyal ba rnga sgra'i cod pan can/ /rā sa badz+ra/ ro yi skye mched sbyangs/ ro'i bde bas grub pa'i ro rdo rje/ byang shar du sna tshogs rdo rje'i gdan la/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng gi oX āXkhaX hūX dang rdo rjer/ reg ma sngon mo sngo dkar dmar/ /dang po rdo rje dril bu 'dzin/ /'khor lo pad+ma g.yas pas te/ /dril bu nor bu g.yon na'o/ /mi bskyod rgyal po'i cod pan can/ /spar sha badz+ra/ reg bya'i skye mched sbyangs/ reg bya'i bde bas/ grub pa'i reg bya rdo rje ma/ 'khor lo'i dbang phyug gi pad mar 'khod pa'i reg bya rdo rje ma la thim par gyur/ lha mo dgu po thams cad ni/ sgeg cing lang tsho la bab pa/ /nu 'bur lhag par rgyas pa bud med sgyu ma'i nga rgyal gyis 'gying ba/ rig pa'i yum gyi mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'o//rim pa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi shar gyi g.yas kyi lkoX āXglo huX dang / klu shing gi yal ga 'khor los mtshan pa'i me tog dang bcas par/ byams pa rnam snang dang mtshungs pa las/ rnam snang gi cod pan can/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po na klu shing gi yal ga 'khor los mtshan pa'i me tog dang bcas pa'o/ /mi tri/ rtsa rgyus dang nyon mongs pa can gyi yid sbyangs/ rdo rje'i rtsa dang zag zad kyi mngon shes la bkod/ grub pa'i byams pa/ lha snam gyi shar gyi g.yas su pad zla'i gdan la/ shar gyi g.yon gyi oṃ āXnywa huX dang 'khor lo/ sa'i snying po rnam snang dang mtshungs pa/ slo ti gar+bha/ mig dbang rnam shes dang bcas pa sbyangs/ rdo rje'i mig dang mig gi mngon shes la bkod/ lha snam gyi shar gyi g.yon du zla ba la/lho'i g.yas kyi oṃ āX.oṃ huX dang rin po cher/ phyag na rdo rje rin chen 'byung ldan/rin 'gyung gi dbu rgyan can/ badz+ra pā ṇi/ rna ba'i dbang po rnam shes dang bcas —19—

pa sbyangs/ rdo rje'i rna ba dang rna ba'i mngon shes la/ grub pa'i phyag na rdo rje/ lho'i g.yas su rin po che'i gdan la lho'i g.yon gyi/ oṃ ā oṃ hū dang rin po cher/nam mkha'i snying po rin chen 'byung ldan/ rin 'byung gi dbu rgyan can/ kha gar+bha/sna'i dbang po rnam shes dang bcas pa sbyangs/ rdo rje'i sna dang / sna'i mngon shes la bkod/ grub pa'i nam mkha'i snying po/ lho'i g.yon du zla ba la/ nub kyi g.yas kyi o ā oṃ hū dang pad+ma ra/ 'jig rten dbang phyug 'od dpag med/ /'od dpag med kyi dbu rgyan can/ /lo ke shwa ra/ lce'i dbang po rnam shes dang bcas pa sbyangs/ rdo rje'i lce dang lce'i mngon shes la bkod/ grub pa'i 'jig rten dbang phyug /nub kyi g.yas su pad+ma dmar po'i la/ nub kyi g.yon gyi oṃ ā hū hū dang pad+ma ra/ 'jam dpal 'od dpag med/ 'og dpag med kyi dbu rgyan can/mañju shrī/ yid dbang dang yid kyi rnam shes sbyangs/ rdo rje'i yid dang pha rol sems shes la bkod/ grub pa'i 'jam dpal/ nub kyi g.yon du pad+ma dmar po'i gdan la byang gi g.yas kyi/ oṃ ā3sau hu dang ral grir/ sgrib pa rnam par sel ba/ don yod grub pa/ don grub gyi cod pan can/ sarba ni wa ra ṇa bi ska bhi ni/ lus dbang rnam shes dang bcas pa sbyangs/ rdo rje'i lus dang rdzu 'phrul kyi mngon shes la/ grub pa'i sgrib pa rnam sel/ byang gi g.yas su sna tshogs rdo rje la/ byang gi g.yon gyi/ o ā sa hū dang ral grir/ kun tu bzang po don yod grub pa/ don grub kyi dbu rgyan can/ sa man+ta bha dra/ tshigs rnams dang kun gzhi rnam shes sbyangs/ rdorje stobs dang sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa la bkod/grub pa'i kun tu bzang po/ byang gi g.yon du sna tshogs rdo rje'i gdan la/ de —20—

ltar lha mo rnams dang sems dpa' brgyad ni sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ zhi ba'i lha tshogs de thams cad kyang 'dza/ma zhing sgeg pa'i nyams can/ 'dod pa'i yon to lnga'i dga' bas rol pa dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ 'od kyi dkyil 'khor 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ lgar sgo'i/ oX āXhūX hūX dang dbyug par/ gshin rje gshed nag nag dkar dmar/ dbyug pa 'khor lo rdo rje g.yas/ /thugs kar sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i/ /zhags pa dril bu dgra sta g.yon/ /rnam snang mdzad kyi cod pan can/ /ya mun ta krita/ dbang po la sogs pa'i bgegs thams cad bcom/grub pa'i gzhin rje gshed/ shar sgor pad nyi'i gdan/ lho sgo'i/ oṃ āXhūX huX dang / rdo rje mtshan pa'i dbyug pa dkar por/ shes rab mthar byed dkar po ni//dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum pa/ /rdo rje dbyug pa ral gri g.yas/ /g.yon ni gzhan rje gshed dang mtshungs/ /rin chen 'byung ba'i cod pan can/ /pratswan+ta krita/ gshin rje dang ma mo la sogs pa'i bgegs/ grub pa'i shes rab mthar byed/ lho sgor pad nyi'i gdan la/ nub sgo'i/ oX āXhuX hūX dang pad+ma ra/ rta mgrin dmar po dmar nag dkar/ /pad+ma ral gri gtun shing g.yas/ /dril bu snyems pas dkur brten dang / /dgra sta zhags pa g.yon na'o/ /snang mtha' yas kyi cod pan can/ /pa dhan+ta krita/ klu dang sa bdag gi bgegs/ grub pa'i pad+ma mthar byed/ nub sgor pad nyi'i gdan la/ byang sgo'i/ oṃ āXhūX huX dang sna tshogs rdo rjer/ bgegs mthar byed pa sngo sangs ni/ /sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum pa/ /rgya gram 'khor lo gshun shing g.yas/ /g.yon pa gshin rje gshed dang —21—

mtshungs/ rgyal ba rnga sgra'i cod pan can/ /bisnrun+ta gro ta/ gnod spyin dang log 'dren la sogs pa'i bgegs/ grub pa'i bgegs mthar byed/ byang sgor pad nyi la/ shar lho'i grwa'i/ oṃ āXhūX huX dang ral grir/ mi g.yo nag po nag dkar dmar/ /ral gri rdo rje 'khor lo g.yas/ g.yon pa thugs kar sdig 'dzub dang / /dgra sta zhags pa rim pa bzhin/ /sangs rgyas snang mdzad cod pan can//a tsa la/ yams nad gtong ba dang me lha'i gdon rnams bcom grub pa'i mi g.yo ba/ shar lho'i grwar pad nyi la/ lho nub kyi grwa'i/ oX āXhuX hūX dang rdo rjer/'dod rgyal sngon po sngo dkar dmar/ /rtsa phyag hūX mdzad phyag rgya 'ching / /rdo rje ral gri g.yas pas te/ /zhags pa lcags kyu g.yon na'o/ /dkon mchog dpal gyi cod pan can/ /ṭak+ki rā dza/ srin po'i gdon sogs nye bar 'tsho ba rnams bcom/ grub pa'i 'dod rgyal/ bden bral gyi grwar pad nyi'i gdan la/ nub byang gi grwa'i/ oṃ āXhūX huX dang / rdo rjes mtshan pa'i be con sngon por/ dbyug sngon sngon po sngo dkar dmar/ /be con ral gri 'khor lo g.yas/ /sdigs mdzub bcas pa'i zhags pa ni/ /thugs kar gtod cing pad+ma dang / /dgra sta g.yon la rim pas so/ /rdo rje chos kyi cod pan can/ /ni la daṇ+ḍa/ yams nad dang rlung lha'i gdon rnams bcom/ grub pa'i dbyug sngon can/ nub byang gi grwar pad nyi la/ byang shar gyi grwa'i/ oX āXhuX huX dang / rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa nag por/stobs chen nag po nag dkar dmar/ /dbyug pa rdo rje 'khor lo g.yas/ /sdigs mdzub bcas pa'i zhags pa ni/ /thugs kar gtod cing rtse gsum dang //dgra sta g.yon gsum rim pas so/ /don yod grub pa'i cod pan can/ /ma hā ba —22—

la/ dbang ldan mkha' 'gro ma'i gdon dang bcas pa bcom/ grub pa'i stobs po che/ byang shar gyi grwar pad nyi'i gdan la/ steng gi ya phubs kyi nang gi /oṃ ā hū hu dang rdo rje/ gtsug tor 'khor los gyur ba sngo/ /zhal gsum sngo dkar dmar ba ste/ /rtsa phyag gtsug tor phyag rgya bcings/ spyi bor 'jog cing lhag ma yi/ /g.yas pas rdo rje pad+ma ste/ /g.yon pa sdig mdzub ral gri'o/ mi bskyod rgyal bo'i cod pan can/ /spun ṣa tsakra warti/ tshang pa lha'i gdon dang bcas pa bcom grub pa'i gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba/ gzhal yas khang gi ya phubs kyi nang du pad nyi la/ 'og gi sa gzhi'i nang gi thig le/ lko ā hu hū dang rdo rjer gyur pa las/ gnod mdzes nag po nag dkar dmar/ /rdo rje 'khor lo nor bu g.yas/ /thugs kar sdigs mdzub zhags pa dang / /pad+ma ral gri g.yon pas so/ /mi bskyod mgon po'i cod pan can/ rang gi thugs kar drangs/ sum bha rā dza/ thugs ka nas phyir phyung nam mkha'i khams thams cad khyab par spros/ kā la ku ṭa la sogs pa brtan g.yo'i dug thams cad dang / gdon gyi bdag po thams cad bcom/ /sprul pa rnams gcig tu 'dus pa la/ gdod nas grub pa'i gnod mdzes rgyal po ye shes sems dpa'i tshul du thim/ rang gi rigs bdag yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub sems kyis dbang bskur/ gtso bo'i gnas kyi 'og rdo rje'i sa bzhi'i nang du pad nyi la 'khod par gyur/ khro bo bcu po thams cad kyang sbom zhing thung la mi sdug pa'i nyams can/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes shing / smin ma dang sma ra dmar ser rab tu 'bar ba/ zhal re re yang dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing / sprul chen po brgyad —23—

kyis brgyan pa ni/ klu'i rgyal po mtha' yas sngon pos dbu skra bcings shing /'jog po dmar pos rna rgyan byas pa rigs ldan khra bos dpung pa la brgyan cing /pad+ma dkar pos mgul rgyan byas pa/ dung skyong ser pos lag gdub byas shing /stobs rgyu ljang khus mchod phyir thogs byas pa/ nor rgyas kyi bu bdud rtsi'i kha dog lta bus ska rags byas shing / pad+ma chen po dkar pos rkang gdub byas pa/stobs chen pha rol gnon pa/ sku las skyes pa'i ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar pa'i dbus na/ gdug pa can thams cad tshar gcod pa'i 'phrin las la brtson pa/g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /'dod rgyal gyi phyag rgya dang po hu mdzad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa ni/ hū mdzad kyi phyag rgya dang phal cher 'dra ba las der brtags pa yin te/ hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya las mdzub mo gnyis kyang sbrel ba ste/ 'dod rgyal nyid kyi phyag rgya yin no/ /gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya ni/ thal mo sbyar ba kha phye ba las mthe chung gnyis khab ltar gzhabs/ srin lag gnyis mthe bong gis mnan/ gung mo gnyis brkyang ste rtse sprad/ mdzub mo gnyis de la btsugs te/g.yas g.yon du rwa'i tshul gyis byas pa'o/ /gsang 'dus 'phags bskor gyi skabs 'dir/ khro bo stso la rol pa'i khro bo mi bzhed de/ thams cad cher khros pa'o/ /yum gyi pad+ma'i nang gi gzhal yas khang / rang gi thugs kar drangs/ oṃ ā hū thugs ka nas phyir phyung /nam mkha'i khams thams cad khyab par spros/ snod kyi 'jig rten gyi dri ma thams cad sbyangs/ ye shes kyi snang ba'i gzhal med khang la bkod/ sprul pa rnams gcig tu 'dus pa la/ gdod nas grub pa'i gzhal yas khang ye shes sems dpa'i tshul du thim/ de nyid dkyil 'khor chen po'i gzhal yas khang la thim par gyur/ de ltar na dkyil 'khor chen po dngas shing sgrib pa med pa/ zung —24—

du 'jug pa'i rang bzhin la mnyam par 'jog ste/ dkyil 'khor rgyal po mchog gi ting nge 'dzin no/ /de nas phra tsho rnal wor ni/ steng gi sna rtse 'am/rdo rje'i lte bar thig le sogs la sems 'dzin pa ste/ gzhan du shes par bya'o/ bskyed rim gyi rdo rje'i bzlas pa ni/ tha mal pa gang la'ang ma chags shing / lha'i rnal 'byor dang mi phyed pa'i yid bzlas so/ /tshig tu brjod pa'i bzlas pa ni/ dam tshig gi bzlas pa spro bsdu'i dmigs pa gtso bor gsal gdab/ bzlas bya'i sngags/ oX āXhuX ni de kho na nyid kyi snying po'o/ /oṃ āXbadz+ra lha ka huX skyoX/ oṃ āXdzi na dzo ka oX huX/ oX āXrat+na dhika snya hūX/ oṃ āX.a ro le ka āXhūX/ oX āXprarnyo lha ka hā hūX/ oX āXmo ha ra tī laX huX/ oX āXdre ṣa ra tī maX huX/ oṃ āXrā ga ra tī paX huX/ oX āXbadz+ra ra tī taX huX/ oṃ āXrū pa badzā dzaXhūX/ oṃ āXtshan sta badz+ra huX huX/ oṃ āX gan+ta badz+ra baX hūX/ oX muXr sa badzā hoXhūX/ oX āXspar+sha badzā khaX huX/ oṃ āXmai tri mo huX/ oṃ āXspu ti gar+bha zla huX/ lkoX āXbadz+ra pā ṇi oṃ hūX/ oṃ āXkha gar+bha oṃ hūX/ oX āXlo ke shwa ra huX skyoX/oX āXmañju shrī huX huX/ oṃ āXsarba ni wa ra ṇa bi skaX bi ni oṃ hūX/ oṃ āXs man+ta bha dra saX hūX/ tseX( āXya murnya krita huX huX/ lkoX āXpra rnyen+ta krita huX hūX/ oṃ āXpa dhan+ta krita huX huX/tseX( āXrwa krita huX hūX/ tseX( āX.a tsa la huX hūX/ tso'o āXṭak+ki rā dzā huX huX/ tseX( āXnī la daṇ+ḍahuX huX/ oṃ āXmahā ba la hūX hūX/ oṃ āXsprurnyu ṣa tsakra warti huX hūX/ oṃ āXng rā dza hūX huX/ yum bzhi dang khro bo dgu'i 'phreng sngags ni/ rtsa ba'i rgyud nyid du gsal bar gsungs pa'o//gtso bo don dam la bzhugs pa ni/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba chen pos/sems dpa' gsum ka 'od gsal du zhugs par gyur/ de nas glus bskul ba ni/spyan mas/ sems can khams na gnas kyi dbang phyug khyod ni rdo rje'i thugs/ /dga' ba yid 'ong don chen 'dod pas bdag la bskyab tu gsol/ /mgon po —25—

gal te bdag ni de ring gson par mchis bzhed na/ /sems can yab chen gnyen mchog bdag la dges par mdzad du gsol/ /mā ma kis/ rdo rje'i sku khyod bka' yi 'khor lo sems can kun la phan/ /sangs rgyas don du byang chub don dam rjes su phan ston pa/ /mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchis bzhed na/ /'dod chags dam tshig chags pas bdag la dges par mdzad du gsol/ /gos dkar mos/ khyod ni rdo rje'i gsung te kun la phan zhing thugs brtse ba/ /'jig rten dag gi dgos pa'i don mdzad pa la rtag tu brtson/ /mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchis bzhed na/ /rab dga'i spyod pa kun tu bzang pos bdag la dges par mdzod/ /sgrol mas/ khyod ni rdo rje 'dod pa dam tshig mchog gi phan don che/ /yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi gdung mchog mnyam pa nyid gzigs pa/ /mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchis bzhed na/ /yon tan rin chen mang po'i gter gyur bdag la dges par mdzode/ /ces bskul pas/ gtso bo sems dpa' gsum yongs su rdzogs pa sngon bzhin du grub par gyur/ de nas bstod cing ma rdzo pa ni/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkhas pa che/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /gsang ba'i dbyings la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che/ /rdo rje zhi ba dga' chen po/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal mchog gi mchog /ston pa rdo rje phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /rdo rje mkha' 'dra dri ma med/ /rang bzhin dag pa gos pa med/ /rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che/ /mi rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa —26—

brnyes/ rdo rje gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /don yod rdo rje rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /dag pa ngo bo nyid las byung / /rdo rje sems dpa' phyag 'tshal shwe1/ /oX sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaX pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī āXhūX/ ar+ghaX gyi gnas su pu duX/ purdze/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke ga rnye/ ni wi te/sha lta/ rū pa/ sha lta/ gan+ta/ ra sa/ ྅zhi/ dharma dha tu zhes pa rnams sbyar ro/ /lha rnams kyi ljags huX las byung ba'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ de'i 'od zer gyi sbu gus drangs te bdud rtsi gsol bar gyur/ rdo rje 'chang chen phyag na rdo rje in+t+ra bhu ti dang / /klu yi rnal 'byor ma dang bi su kalpa sa ra ha/ /klu sgrub yab sras bzhi dang zla grags slob pa'i rdo rje dang / /nag po sa 'dres de bā ka ra 'gos lo khug pa dang / /mngar seng rgyal ye shes seng ge nyi seng nyi ma lcam/ /rngog ston 'phags lha thang spe ba dang gser sdengs gzhon nu 'ong / chos sku 'od zer 'phags 'od bu ston rin chen rnam rgyal dang / /dpal mchog don grub tsan+d+ra shrī 'khrul zhig tshul rgyal ba/ /mkhyen rab mchog grub dkon mchog dpal bzang bkra shis rgyal mtshan dang / /dpal ldan chos bzang la sogs rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la mchod/ /lkoX āXskyoX/ lugs 'di la spyir brgyud pa bdun ldan gyi bka' srol tshang bas/ brgyud pa de dag gang nas drangs kyang 'dra'o/ /yang na/ bu ston khyung po lhas pa dang/ shar ngor paṇa chen chos rje rab gsal zla ba mgon po dang / grol mchog zhabs dang byams pa'i mtshan can rnams la mchod par 'bul/ zhes so/ /yang na/ bu ston bla ma dam pa dang /theg chen pa dang bsod nams bzang po rdo rje gdan pa dang / byang dbang shākya kun dga' ye shes dbang po rnams la 'bul/ zhes bya zhing / phyi ma 'di la 'gos lo tsā —27—

ba nas/ dbus pa dge ser sogs dang / sa skya gong ma lnga char la ded kyang chog pa yod do/ /de nas 'phreng sngags kyi mthar/ re re bzhin 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod 'bul/ bdud rtsi myang rjes chags kyi mchod pa sngon bzhin yid kyis dran pa tsam bya/ de nas nyer bsdu ni/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis/ 'khor gyi lha rnams spyan drangs te rang gi lus la thim/ gzhal yas khang 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ yab yub snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas byang chub kyi sems kyi 'od zer spros te/ sems can thams cad la dbang bskur/ sdig sgrib sbyangs te hū yig gi rnam pa nam mkha' gang bar gyur/ thams cad kyang rdo rje 'chang gi phyag rgya chen por gyur te/ de thams cad rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis drangs nas/ rang nyid la thim par gyur zhes brjod la dbyings der cung zad mnyam par bzhag go /de dag ni las rgyal mchog gi ting nge 'dzin no/ /slar yang bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang phyag gnyis pa'i rnam pa can du gyur/dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par ā thugs kar hu/ cho se thams cad rdo rje gsum mnyam pa nyid kyi rang bzhin du lhag par mos pas thun mtshams kyi spyod pa la 'jug ste/dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /sangs rgyas kun gyi kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje 'chang ba thob gyur cig /'gro bas kyang ni de thob shog /byang chub phyir ni spyod gang dang / /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyil gang yin pa/ /byang chub rdo rje gang gsungs pa'i/ /spyod de gnyis ka'ang bdag spyod shog /ces so/ /skabs 'dir gtor ma 'bul wo sngon swa zla rge/༷//rnyo ྅ ha do'i ste 1 ste stong nga dur/ ༷/ ghā two/kau las sgyu ltor rluda~X/ / bye ༵ phy-i / ljang de'i —28—

steng du u las byung ba'i thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar pa'i nang du a las byung ba'i pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa ā ring pos mtshan pa/ de'i dbus su hū las mi'i sha dang / dri chu hu gis mtshan pa/ shar du o las so ldan gyi sha dang dri chu o gyis mtshan pa/ ltor snyu las mgyogs 'gro'i sha dang rak+ta snyu yis mtshan pa/ nub tu a las khyu mchog gi sha dang / byang sems as mtshan pa/ byang du ha las shwa na'i sha dang / sha chen gyi dwangs ma hā yis mtshan pa/ de thams cad kyi thun mong gi steng du o yig gis mtshan pa/ de'i steng gi bar snang la/ zla ba'i steng du hū las byung ba'i rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa hu gis mtshan pa/ hu las 'od 'phros rlung g.yos me spar rdzas rnams skol ba'i nang du/ rdo rje zla ba dang bcas pa lhung nas dkrugs pas/ thams cad zhu nas ro mnyam du gyur pa/ dri ma sbyangs te dag pa'i shel ltar gyur/ pad+ma a dang bcas pa zhu bas nyi ma ltar 'bar ba'i 'od kyi ye shes kyi bdud rtsir rtogs par byas/ oṃ las 'od zer 'phros/phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs shing / 'khor 'das kyi bdud rtsi thams cad bkug ste thim pas/ spar zhing spel ba las/ bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ u hu lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlab bo/ /mchod pa'ang dngos su bshams yod na byin gyis rlabs dgos la/dngos sham med na mi dgos so/ khyu n+ya tus stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hu las byung ba'i bsrung 'khor gyi nang du bhu las byung ba'i gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa grub par gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas rdo rje sems dpa' zhe sdang rdo rje'i rnam pa can la sogs pa/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa lha sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi —29—

dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo sprul/ mdun gyi gzhal med khang gi nang so so'i gdan gyi steng du bzhugs par gyur/ yang rang gi snying ga'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' las 'od zer 'phros/ khams gsum dang / skye gnas bzhi dang rigs drug srid pa bar ma dang bcas pas bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ rdo rje 'chang chen po'i skur gyur/ tshur 'dus gcig tu 'dres pa/gzhal yas khang gi nang du phyin pa tsam gyis lha sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi lha tshogs su gyur nas/ lha tshogs snga ma dang gnyis su med par 'dres/ rang gi thugs ka nas gnod mdzes rgyal po spros/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas byang sems 'phags pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad ye shes kyi 'khor lo rdo rje sems dpa' lha sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ oX badz+ra sa mā dzaX dzaXhūX baX hoXlan mang du brjod/ lha thams cad kyi dpral bar oX/ mgrin par āX thugs kar hūX/ oX sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaX pū dza sogs kyis mchod/ lha rnams kyi ljags huX las byung ba'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa rtse mor oṃ dang nor bus mtshan pa de'i 'od zer gyi sbu gus drangs te gtor ma gsol bar gyur/ gtor ma dbul ba'i sngags ni/shan+ta de ba na re/ oṃ āXbadz+ra lha ka pañca a mṛ ta hūX zhes pa nas/ oṃ āXsuX bha rā dza pañca a mṛ ta hūX zhes pa'i bar gyi 'bul bar 'dod/ de ltar byas kyang rung la lag len nag po dam tshig rdo rje'i gtor chog bzhin mdzad de/ oṃ āXhuX oṃ snya āXhā laX maX paX taX/ dzaXhuX baX hoXkhaX d+ma ra oṃ oṃ oX huX oṃ oṃ/ hūX huX huX huX huX huX huX hūṃ huX huX/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaX sarba dharmā/ ṇaX a du ṭa d+ma sno twata/ skye( āXhuX phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa lan gsum mam lngas phul/ rgyas pa byed na lha re re bzhin snying po'i mthar a kā ro btanas pas 'bul/ chu gnyis dang nyer spyod sngar —30—
