yas khang gi nang / dkyil 'khor gyi phyed kyi tshad kyi phyi ngos su/ 'od zer rnam pa lnga'i 'phreng bas bskor ba'i nang du/ rdo rje rtse gsum pas zlum por bskor ba la rten pa'i ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa te/ shar du 'khor lo/ lho ru rin po che/ nub tu pad+ma/ byang du ral gris mtshan pa'i ka ba gnyis gnyis kyis bteg pa'i steng rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mangs ris su bris shing mdzes par phub pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis spras pa/ rim pa gnyis pa'i grwa bzhi'i g.yas g.yon du bkra shis kyi bum pa brgyad dang bcas pa/mchod pa'i sprin thams cad kyis mngon par brgyan pa'i khang bzang dam pa/ de'i nang gi steng 'og gi gzhi dang lha snam/ shar dkar lho ser nub dmar ljang dbus sngo ba'i nang le tshe dgu dang / rim pa gnyis pa'i grwa bzhi dang shar sgo'i g.yas g.yon gnyis dang / sgo bzhi rnams su sna tshogs pad+ma'i gdan re re nang gi shar las gzhan pa'i phyogs gsum dang / sgo bzhi rnams su nyi ma'i gdan/ gzhan rnams su gdan re re ste/ ye shes kyi gzhal med khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur/gnyis pa rten pa bskyed pa la/ bsnyen sgrub chung ngu dang / bar ma gnyis so/ /dang po la/bsnyen pa/ nyer sgrub/ sgrub pa/ sgrub chen bzhi las/ dang po ni/ dbus kyi zla ba'i gdan la bar snang gi yi ge las 'phros pa'i rang gi sgo gsum gyi rang bzhin yi ge 'bru gsum gzugs brnyan ltar gsal bas/ de bzhin gde/gas pa thams cad bskul/ de rnams kyis rang la byin gyis brlabs shing 'od du zhu nas 'og tu babs/ dbus kyi gdan la gnas pa cha gnyis su gyur pa'i 'og ma/ a ā/ i —80—

yī/ u mū/ ṛ grwa/ '-i lī/ e mai/ o au/ a ā/ rnams g.yas bskor dang /g.yon bskor te mtshan bzang po so gnyis kyi rang bzhin dbyangs so gnyis yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbyangs dkar po so gnyis kyis mtshan pa'i steng du/ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa rte ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa/ ya ra la wa ḍa khyu rnams g.yas bskor dang g.yon bskor te/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i rang bzhin gsal byed brgyad cu yongs su gyur pa las/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gsal byed dmar po brgyad cus mtshan pa/ de ltar zla ba gnyis ni me long lta bu'i ye shes las byang chub pa'o/ /zla ba de gnyis gcig tu gyur pa ni/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes las byang chub pa'o/ /zla ba'i steng du hu dmar po las byung ba'i rdo rje dmar po rtse lnga pa'i nye bar/ zla ba la gnas pa'i hu yig dkar po 'od zer 'bar bas mtshan pa ni/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes las byang chub pa'o/ /hū gi 'od zer gyis 'gro ba thams cad rnam par sbyangs shing rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phangs la bkod de slar 'dus nas hu la thim pa ni bya ba grub pa'i ye shes las byang chub pa'o/ /oṃ badz+ra ut+pa ko3ha/ slar yang hū gi 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bde ba chen pos mnyes par byas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i rnam par spyan drangs pa rnams hu la thim/ zla ba hu dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/rang nyid rgyu rdo rje 'chang rdo rje sems dpa' kun tu bzang po dkar nag dmar pa'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma'i ngo bo rang snang gi rig ma la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis kyis rdo rje dang ral —81—

gri/ g.yon gnyis kyis rin po che dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ zla ba'i 'od can rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /de ltar sku yongs su rdzogs pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes las byang chub pa'o/ /oṃ ya thā sarba ta thā ga ta a ha/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i shin tu dga' ba'i sgra dbyangs kyis rgyal ba yab yum thams cad spyan drangs/ rang gi lus la zhugs pa'i rkyen gyis rang nyid bde ba chen po lhag par rgyas pas/ yum mnyes par gyur zhing / rang gi lus las spyan sogs yum bzhi dang / gzugs sogs lha mo lnga ste rig ma dgu phyir spros nas yum la thim pa'i rkyen gyis yum bde ba chen po lhag par rgyas pas yab mnyes par gyur/ slar yang rang gi thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis sangs rgyas thams cad rdo rje 'dzin pa lha bcu dgu'i bdag nyid du spyan drangs/rang gi zhal nas zhugs byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+ma ra babs pa'i thig le yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje sems dpas gtso byas pa'i lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa dus gcig tu grub pa las 'phros pa'i 'od dang / rang gi thugs ka nas kyang 'od zer 'phros pas/ sems can thams cad bkug nas slob ma 'jug pa'i tshul du gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgo bzhi nas bcug ste dkyil 'khor gyi nang du 'khod par gyur/slar yang rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i rigs lnga yum bzhi sems dpa' sems ma bcu gnyis la sogs pa'i rgyal ba 'khor bcas thams cad spyan drangs zhal du zhugs/ rjes su chags pa'i mes byang chub sems su ro gcig tu gyur/ rdo rje'i lam nas 'thon te sems can de rnams la dbang bskur —82—

bas phung khams skye mched thams cad sbyangs nas/ thig ler zhu ba yongs su gyur pa las/ k+ṣi dzi kha ga ska sa/ dza : ba ho zi kha ra/ la mā pā tā/ bhu a dzi kha hū rnams las byung ba'i byang chub sems dpa' drug dang / rdo rje ma drug dang / yum bzhi dang / sangs rgyas rigs lnga ste/ lha nyi shu rtsa gcig tu gyur pa rnams/ k+ṣi nas hu gi bar gong bzhi brjod/ pad+ma nas phyir spros pa/ nam mkhar 'khod nas/ e ma sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /byang chub sems kyi 'jug pa ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gsang / /rnyog med rnam par mi rtog pa'o/ /zhes ched du brjod pa ched du brjod nas rang rang gi zhing du gshegs par gyur to/ /bdag nyid dri za'i tshul du gnas pas de gzigs te/ bde ba chen po lhag par rgyas pas yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+ma ra babs pa/ 'dod chags chen po'i rang bzhin kha dog dmar po'i thig ler gyur/ de'i 'od kyis yab yum gnyis kyang byang chub sems su zhu ba dang lhan cig zla ba zhu ba lta bu'i thig le dri ma med pa'i 'od 'phro bar gyur/ de nas glus skul ba ni/ mā ma kis/ sems can khams na gnas kyi dbang phyug khyod ni rdo rje'i thugs/ /dga' ba yid 'ong don chen 'dod pas bdag la bskyab tu gsol/ /mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchis bzhed na/ /sems can yab chen gnyen mchog bdag la dgyes par mdzad du gsol/ /spyan mas/ rdo rje'i sku khyod bka' yi 'khor lo sems can kun la phan/ /sangs rgyas don du byang chub don dam rjes su phan brtson pa/ /mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchis bzhed na/ /'dod chags dam tshig chags pas bdag la dgyes par mdzad du gsol//—83—

gos dkar mos/ khyod ni rdo rje'i gsung ste kun la phan cing thugs brtse ba/ 'jig rten dag gi dgos pa'i don mdzad pa la rtag tu brtson/ mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchis gzhed na/ /ra dga'i spyod pa kun tu bzang pos bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /sgrol mas/ khyod ni rdo rje 'dod pa dam tshig mchog gi phan don che/ /yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi gdung mchog mnyam pa nyid gzigs pa/ /mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchis bzhed na/ /yon tan rin chen mang po'i gter gyur bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /ces skul pas/ thig le de cha gnyis su gyur pa'i cha gcig yongs su gyur pa las/ 'od zer rnam pa lnga 'phro ba'i ma yig dmar ser du gyur/ de las byung pa'i ral gri'i yu ba la gnas pa'i zla ba'i steng du ma yig go /yang de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros sems can thams cad 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i go 'phang la bkod/sangs rgyas rnams dang lhan cig 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i rnam par spyan drangs te ma yig la thim/ ral gri zla ba ma dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid dpal 'jam pa'i rdo rje zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ sku mdog dang rtsa zhal dmar ser gur gum gzhon nu lta bu'i mdangs can gser gyi lhun po ltar gzi brjid 'bar ba/ g.yas zhal in+d+ra nī la ltar sngo sangs/ g.yon zhal ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba/ rab tu 'dzum pas lha mo la gzigs shing sgros 'dzin pa/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis rang snang gi yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis kyis ral gri dang mda'/ g.yon gnyis kyis ut+pal dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad brgyad cus —84—

brgyan pa/ mchog tu sgeg pa dpag tu med pa'i rigs kyi sprul pa phyogs bcur 'phro ba/ mthon 'thing dbu skra steng du bcings shing rin po che'i thor tshugs cod pan rdo rje'i tog gis mtshan pa dang bcas pas brgyan pa/ nyi zla'i 'od zer rab tu 'bar zhing / sil sil gyi sgra sgrog pa'i rin po che'i dbu brgyan/ mgul brgyan/ do shal/ dpung brgyan/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub/ se mo do dang ske rags te rin po che'i brgyan brgyad la sogs pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/snyan gong ut+pa la'i gdengs ka dang / dar dpyangs kyis mdzes pa/ lha'i dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' gsol shing / sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa rigs sngags kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i dbang phyug chen por gyur/ oX dharma dh+wa tu swa bhā ba ut+pa ko3haX/gnyis pa nyer sgrub ni/ mig tu zla ba la k+ṣi las 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa/ lte bar zla ba la gnas pa'i k+ṣi gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad sa snying gi rnam par spyan drangs nas thim/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ sa snying dkar po rnam snang lta bu'o/ /de bzhin du sbyar te/ rna ba zla ba la dzi las rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa/ lte bar yang dzi/ phyag rdor gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ yongs su gyur pa las/ phyag rdor nag po mi bskyod pa lta bu/ sna la khaX/ rin po che ljang khu cha dgu pa/ nam mkha'i snying po ser po rin chen 'byung ldan lta bu'o/ /lce la gaX pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa/ 'jig rten dbang phyug dmar po 'od dpag med lta bu'o/ /skra mtshams kyi nang du skaX/ ral —85—

gri sngo sangs 'od 'phro ba/ sgrib sel ljang khu don yod grub pa lta bu'o/ /lte bar sa/ rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa/ kun bzang dkar po rdo rje 'chang lta bu'o/ /gsum pa sgrub pa ni/ rang gi nu ma gnyis kyi dbus su zla ba la gnas pa'i hu nag po yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar yang hū nag po/de las 'od 'phros 'gro ba rnams thugs rdo rje'i go 'phang la bkod/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams bde bas mnyes/ thugs rdo rje'i rnam par spyan drangs nas thim/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las thugs rdo rje nag po mi bskyod pa lta bu'i thugs kar rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar zla ba la hu sngon po'o/ /de bzhi du 'tho pa spos te/ mgrin pa'i nang du: ngag gi ngo bo ā dmar po pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa/ gsung rdo rje dmar po 'od dpag med lta bu'i thugs khar pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba la ā dmar po'o/ /spyi bor rang gi lus kyi: oṃ dkar po ge bor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i: sku rdo rje dkar po rnam snang lta bu'i thugs kar 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba la oṃ dkar po'o / / /de gsum gyi thugs ka'i yi ge 'bru gsum las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas sku gsung thugs rdo rje dpag tu med pa spros shing / mchod pa'i lha mo mtha' yas pa sprul te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa la mchod par gyur/ar+gha nas shasta'i bar gyis ma sgo/ dpal ldan rdo rje thugs 'chang ba/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum sgom pa/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /rdo rje thugs kyis mdzad du gsol/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum sgom pa/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /rdo rje thugs kyis —86—

mdzad du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas/ thugs rdo rje dang de'i rdo rje can rnams thugs rdo rje dang rang la thim/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta badz+ra swa bha ba at+pa ko3haX/ chos kyi gsung lam dpal dang ldan/ rdo rje mi phyed: /deng bdag: /rdo rje gsung gi: /phyog bcur sogs gong ltar las/ rdo rje gsung : /zhes gsol ba btab pas gsung rdo rje dang de'i rdo rje can rnams gsung rdo rje dang rang la thim/ lkoX sarba ta thā ga ta bāka badz+ra su bhā ba ut+pa ko3haX/ dpal ldan rdo rje'i sku 'chang ba/ /rdo rje mi phyed / deng bdag /rdo rje sku yis: /phyogs bcur /rdo rje sku yis5 /zhes gsol ba bto pas/ sku rdo rje dang de'i rdo rje can rnams sku rdo rje dang rang la thim/ lkoX sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra sla bhā ba ut+pa ko3haX/bzhi pa sgrub pa chen po ni/ rang gi snying kha'i thugs rdo rje'i gong du zla ba la gnas pa'i maX yig dmar ser yongs su gyur pa las/ ral gri'i yu ba'i nang du zla ba la maX gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phro spres/ sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes par byas/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i rnam par spyan drangs nas maX la thim/ ral gri zla ba maX dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' ral gri'i yu bar zla ba la gnas pa'i maX dmar ser ro/ /thugs ka'i maX las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rgyal ba yab yum 'khore dang bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs/ ar+ghaX nas shabha'i bar gyis mchod/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang rab tu sgrol ba'i phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rjes deng bdag stsole/ /zhes gsol ba bto pas/ dbang —87—

bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ khams gsum kun gyi phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi/ /gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hu/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ lus thams cad de ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang / sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rang gi spyi bor mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan zhing / sa snying la sogs pa rnams rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan par gyur/ de dag ni yan lag bzhi chung tsho bskor ro/ /gnyis pa bsnyen sgrub par ma/ la yang bzhi las/ dang po bsnyen pa ni/ rang gi mdun na gnas pa'i thig le yongs su gyur pa las/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i rang bzhin yum 'jam pa'i rdo rje ma sku mdog dang rtsa zhal dmar ser gur gum gzhon nu lta bu/ g.yas sngo zhing g.yon dkar ba phyag dang po gnyis kyi gtso bo'i mgul nas 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis ral gri dang mda'/ g.yon gnyis ut+pal dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung gis yab la 'khyud pa/dbu skra ltag par phyed bcings shing / phyed sil bur grol bas sku stong khyab pa/lo bcu drug lon pa ltar gzhon nu lang tsho la bab cing / nu 'bur rgyas pa/mnyen lcug 'khril bag chags pa'i sku mchog tu sgeg cing mdzes pa/ shin tu 'dzum pa'i zur gyis lta ba la sogs pa sgyu stsal gyi nyams dang ldan pa/ dar sna tshogs pa'i na bza' dang cod pan dang / rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa shes rab kyi yan lag thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ oṃ dharma sogs gong bzhi brjod/—88—

gnyis pa nyer sgrub ni/ mig tu k+ṣi dang 'khor lo'i 'od kyi 'phro 'du las sa snying dkar po rnam snang lta bu zhes sbyangs te/ rna bar dzi dang rdo rje'i/ snar kha dang rin po che'i/ lcer ga dang pad+ma'i/ dpral bar ska dang ral gri'i/ lte bar sa dang rdo rje'i zhes sbyor ba ni khyad par ro/ /gsum pa sgrub pa ni/ gong bzhin las/ rigs gsum gyi gsol btab bor ba dang / sngags gsum 'jug tu sbrel nas brjod pa ni khyad par ro/ /bzhi pa sgrub chen ni/ gzhan rnams gong dang 'dra ba las/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i gnas su 'jam pa'i rdo rje ma zhes pa dang / rang la mi bskyod pa zhes pa'i skabs su/ yum 'jam pa'i rdo rje ma la mi bskyod pas zhes 'don pa spo ba ni khyad par ro/ /bsdus pa byed na 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa bzhengs skabs nyid du yum yang bskyed yan lag lhag ma phyogs gcig tu byed pa dang shin tu bsdus na/ gshin rje gshed nag ltar yan lag phyi ma gsum gtso 'khor lhan cig tu byas na 'di'i sgrub pa dang mi mthun pa ltar snang ba zhig byung rung gnad gcig pa sogs kyis rung par bzhed do/ /yum gyi spyi gtsugs nas snying kha'i bar du zla ba la gnas pa'i oṃ dkar po rnam snang gi rang bzhin/ snying kha nas lte ba'i bar du hū nag po mi bskyod pa'i rang bzhin/ nye ba nas gsang ba'i bar du snya ser po rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rang bzhin/ gsang ba nas brla'i bar du ā dmar po 'od dpag med gyi rang bzhin/ brla nas rkang ba'i bar du hā ljang khu don yod grub pa'i rang bzhin rnams nyi ma la gnas par gyur/ de rnams las byung ba'i 'od zer rnam pa lngas gang ba'i yum gyi sku/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i rdul phra rab kyi rang bzhin du gyur/ rang gi gsang gnas mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las/ hu las byung —89—

ba'i rdo rje dmar po rtse lnga pa/ oṃ dkar po las skyes pa'i nor bus mtshan pa/yum gyi gsang gnas mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las/ hu las byung ba'i pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa ā las skyes pa'i ze 'brus mtshan pa/ gnyis ka'i bu ga phaṭa kyis bkag par gyur/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dga' ba dang bde ba nyams su myong ba'i bde ba chen pos sangs rgyas thams cad mchod par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa ut+pa ko3ha/ zhes nga rgyal bya ste/ de yan chad ni dang po sbyor ba'o/ /gnyis pa dkyil 'khor rgyal po mchog la yang / bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi las dang po bsnyen pa ni/ rang gi thugs kha'i ma las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad dkyil 'khor gyi rnam pas spyan drangs pa rnams/ rang gi zhal nas zhugs te/ rjes chags kyi mes byang chub sems su zhu ba/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+ma babs pa'i thig le ma yig dmar ser gyis mtshan zhing byin gyis brlab par gyur/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo thig le de yongs su gyur pa las/ rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur pa ni/ gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa lha'i gdan rnams dang bcas pa'i dbus kyi gdan la/ rgyal ba mi bskyod rdo rje sku mdog sngon po sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis rang 'od kyi rig ma la 'khyud cing / lhag ma g.yas gnyis khro bo'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis rin po che dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ rang gi thugs kar drangs/ badz+ra lha ka thugs ka nas phyir byung / phyogs bcu'i zhing thams cad du —90—

sprul pa dpag tu med pa spros/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa thams cad mdzad/ khyad par du sems can rnams kyi zhe sdang sbyangs/ rnam shes kyi phung po gnas gyur/ chos dbyings ye shes la bkod/ slar 'dus rang nyid la thim par gyur/ shar du rnam par snang mdzad dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis rang 'od kyi yum la 'phyud cing / lhag ma g.yas gnyis 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis rin po che dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ rang gi thugs kar drangs/ dzi na dzika thugs ka nas phyir phyung phyogs bcu'i zhing thams cad du sprul pa dpag tu med pa spros/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa thams cad mdzad khyad par du sems can rnams kyi gti mug sbyangs/gzugs kyi phung po gnas gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes la bkod/ slar 'dus te gzhal yas khang gi le tshe dgu las shar du zla gdan la 'khode/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ lhor rin chen 'byung ldan ser po ser nag dkar pa'i zhal gsum nas/g.yas gnyis rin po che ljang khu cha dgu pa dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis 'khor lo dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ rat+na dhika nga rgyal sbyangs/ tshor ba'i phung po gnas gyur/mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes la bkod/ lhor nyi gdan la 'khod/ nub tu 'od dpag med dmar po dmar nag dkar pa'i zhal gsum nas/ g.yas gnyis pad+ma dmar po 'ang/ba ma brgyad pa dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis nor bu dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ a ro lika 'dod chags sbyangs/ 'du shes kyi phung po gnas gyur/so sor rtog pa'i ye shes la bkod/ nub tu nyi gdan la 'khod/ byang du don —91—

yod grub pa ljang khu ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum nas/ g.yas gnyis ral gri sngo sangs 'od 'phro ba dang 'khor lo/ g.yon gnyis nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/pradz+nyā dhika phrag dog sbyangs/ 'du byed kyi phung po gnas gyur/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes la bkod/ byang du nyi gdan la 'khod/ 'di man ho du si kyi ge ngor lo bskor ba la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa thams cad mdzad ces pa'i tshig 'di mi brjod/ gzhan thams cad sbyor lugs 'dra ba las/ lha mo rnams rang 'od kyi yab la 'byud pa zhes spyor te/shar lhor spyan ma dkar mo rnam snang lta bu/ mo ha ra tī/ sems can rnams kyi sa'i khams kyi dri ma sbyangs/ snying rje tshad med mngon du byas/ thabs kyi phar phyin/shar lhor zla gdan la: lho nub tu mā ma gī sngon mo mi bskyod pa lta bu las/ rdo rje'i gnas su ut+pal dmar po 'dzin pa/ dre ṣa ra tī/ chu'i khams/ byams pa tshad med pa/ smon lam gyi phar phyin/ lho nub tu zla gdan la: nub byang du gos dkar mo 'od dpag med lta bu/ rā ga ra tī/ me khams/ dga' ba tshad med pa/stobs kyi phar phyin/ nub byang du zla gdan la: byang shar du sgrol ma ser mo rin 'gyung lta bu la rin po che'i gnas su/ ut+pal ser po/ badz+ra ra tī/ rlung gi khams btang snyoms tshad med/ ye shes kyi phar phyin/ byang shar du zla gdan la 'khod/de bzhin du rim pa gnyis pa'i shar lhor/ gzugs rdo rje ma rnam snang lta bu la/'khor lo'i gnas su me long dmar po/ oṃ āXhuX/ sems can rnams kyi gzugs kyi skye mched sbyangs sbyin pa'i phar phyin la bkod/ slar 'dus te rim pa gnyis pa'i shar ltor zla gdan la 'khod/ de 7r+sā du sbyar te/ lho nub tu sgra rdo rje ma mi bskyod pa lta bu la/ rdo rje'i gnas su pi waX sngon po/ oṃ āXhūX/ sgra'i skye mched/—92—

tshul khrims kyi phar phyin/ lho nub tu zla gdan /nub byang du dri rdo rje ma rin 'byung lta bu la rin po che'i gnas su dri'i dung chos ser po/ oṃ ā hu/ dri'i skye mgo/ bzod pa'i phar phyin/ nub byang du zla gdan: byang shar du ro rdo rje ma dmar mo 'od dpag med lta bu la/ pad+ma'i gnas su ro'i snod dmar po/ oṃ ā hu/ ro'i skye mched/ brtson 'grus kyi phar phyin/ byang shar du zla gdan:shar sgo'i g.yas su reg bya rdo rje ma ljang khu don grub lta bu la/ ral gri'i gnas su gos kha dog sna tshogs pa/ oṃ ā hu/ reg bya'i skye mched/ bsam gtan gyi phar phyin/ shar sgo'i g.yas su zla gdan: shar sgo'i g.yon du chos dbyings rdo rje ma dkar mo rdo rje sems dpa' lta bu la/ rdo rje'i gnas su chos kyi 'byung gnas dkar po/ oṃ ā hū/ chos kyi skye mched/ shes rab kyi phar phyin/ shar sgo'i g.yon du zla gdan la 'khod/ de thams cad kyang zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs shing / dbu skra ral pa'i cod pan phyed bcings kyis mdzes pa/ zhal re re la spyan gnyis gnyis dang ldan pa/ zhi zhing sgeg pa brgyad gnyis lon pa'i na tshod dang ldan pa/ gzhad cing 'dzum pa la sogs pa'i rnam 'gyur gyis bde ba chen po'i longs spyod la lhag par rol ba/ nyi zla'i 'od zer rab tu 'bar zhing / rin po che'i rgyan brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ lha'i dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' klubs pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dbu skra thor cog rin po che'i dprog zhu can/ lha mo rnams dbu skra ltag par bcings pa rnam snang dang lha mo thams cad zla ba'i 'od 'phro ba dang gshegs pa gzhan gsum nyi ma'i 'od 'phro ba'o/ /yang rigs rdo rje'i skyil krung dang lha mo bcu sems skyil du byas kyang rung —93—

ngo / /de bzhi du sbyar te/ shar sgor gzhan rjes mthar byed nag po mi bskyod pa lta bu la/ rdo rje'i gnas su rdo rje'i thob ba/ ya mun+ta krita/ sems can rnams kyi phung po'i bdud sbyangs/ dad pa'i dbang po la bkod/ slar 'dus te shar sgor nyi gdan la 'khod/ lho sgor shes rab mtha' byed dkar po rnam snang lta bu la/'khor lo'i gnas su rdo rje dbyug pa 'dzin pa/ prarnyornya spo ta/ nyon mongs pa'i bdud sbyangs/ brtson 'grus kyi dbang po la bkod/ lho sgor nyi gdan la/ nub sgor pad+ma mthar byed 'od dpag med lta bu/ pa dhan+ta krita/ 'chi bdag gi bdud sbyangs dran pa'i dbang po la bkod/ nub sgor nyi gdan la/ byang sgor bgegs mthar byed nag po mi bskyod pa lta bu la/ rdo rje'i gnas su rdo rje nag po kha gyes 'dzin pa/ birtswan+ta krita/ lha'i bu'i bdud sbyangs ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po la bkod/ byang sgor nyi gdan la 'khod/ khro bo bzhi po thams cad kyang sbom zhing thung la mi sdug pa'i nyams can/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes shing / smin ma dang sma ra dmar ser rab tu 'bar ba/ zhal re re yang dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing / mche ba rnon po bzhi bzhi brtsigs pa/ ha he'i gad sbyangs drag po sgrog cing / bzhin shin tu 'gyur ba'i khro gnyer can/ gsus khyim che zhing gsus pa 'phyang ba/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan zhing /stag gi lbags pa'i sham thabs can/ klu'i rgyal po mtha' yas sngon pos dbu skra bcings shing / 'jog po dmar pos rna brgyan byas pa/ rigs ldan khra bos dpung pa la brgyan pa/ pad+ma dkar pos mgul brgyan byas pa/ dung skyong ser pos lag gdub byas shing / stobs rgyu ljang khus mchod phyir thogs byas pa/—94—

nor rgyas kyi bu bdud rtsi'i kha dog lta bus ske rags byas shing / pad+ma chen po dkar pos rkang gdub byas pa/ stobs chen pha rol gnon pa chen po sku las skyes pa'i ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na/ gdug pa can thams cad tshar gcod pa'i 'phrin las la brtson pas g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /gzhal yas khang rang gi thugs kar drangs/ oX āXhūX/ thugs ka nas phyir phyung / snod kyi 'jig rten sbyangs/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor du gyur/ slar 'dus nas gzhal yas khang la thim/ rang gi snying kha'i 'od zer gyis ye shes sems dpa' lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor badz+ra sa mā dzaX oX ya mun+ta krita huX/ oX pratswan+ta krita hūX/ oX pad+man+ta krita hūX/ oX rna krita hūX/ zhes bgegs bskrad/ ar+ghaX nasashabha'i bar gyis mchod/ oX ya mun+ta krita dzaX oṃ pratswan+ta krita hūX/ oX pa dhan+ta krita baX/ oX bis+thān+ta krita hoX zhes dgug gzhug bcing mnyes bya'o/ /gnyis pa nyer sgrub ni/ lha thams cad kyi mig tu zla ba zhes pa nas/ rdo rje 'chang lta bu'o/ /zhes pa'i bar gtso bo'i skabs ltar bya'o/ /gsum pa sgrub pa ni/ lha thams cad kyi nu ma gnyis kyi zhes sogs sbyar te nga rgyal bzung la gsum gyi bar yum gyi skabs bzhin no/ /bzhi pa sgrub pa wo po ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i maX las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pa sogs gong dang 'dra ba las/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ rnam snang sogs de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi/ mā ma gī/ sgra rdo rje ma/ shes rab mthar byed/bgegs mthar byed rnams la mi bskyod pa/ spyan ma gzugs rdo rje ma/ gzhin rje mthar byed rnams la rnam snang / dri rdo rje ma la rin 'byung / gos dkar mo/—95—

ro rdo rje ma/ pad+ma mthar byed rnams la 'od dpag med/ sgrol ma dang reg bya rdo rje ma la don grub/ chos dbyings rdo rje ma la rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan zhing /skye mched dang sku gsung thugs kyi lha rnams la/ rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan/ de dag ni bsnyen sgrub chen po bskor bzhi'o/ /da ni cho ga'i yan lag la/ mchod pa/ bstod pa/ bdud rtsi myang ba gsum ste/ dang po ni/thugs ka'i maX las 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i 'dod pa'i yon to thams cad bkug rang gi lus la zhugs byang chub sems su zhu ba rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+ma ra babs pa'i thig le bcu/ laX maX paX taX dzaXhūX baX hoXkhaX raX rnams su gyur/ de rnams kyi 'od kyis lha mo bcu'i lha tshogs spyan drangs te/ sa bon de rnams nyid la thim pa yongs su gyur pa las yum bzhi dang / mchod pa'i lha mo drug tu gyur te/ mchod rdzas dpag tu med pa dang bcas pa mkha' nang nas phyir spros te/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams la mchod par gyur/ tshogs wo gi skabs ltar mchod pa byas la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā ba at+pa ko3haX/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkhas pa che/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /gsang ba'i dbyings la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che/ /rdo rje zhi ba dga' ba che/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal mchog gi mchog /ston pa rdo rje phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /rdo rje mkha' 'dra dri ma med/ /rang bzhin dag la gos pa med/ /rdo rje sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che/ /mi rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes/ /rdo rje gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /don yod rgyal po rdzogs —96—

sangs rgyas/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /dag pa ngo bo nyid las byung / /rdo rje sems dpa' phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta stu tī ra badz+ra swa bhā ba ut+pa ko3ha/ nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs la 'then srin g.yon pas 'bul te/'og nas 'byung ba'i sngags re re'i mthar yi ge 'bru gsum gsum btags pas so/ /gsum pa las rgyal po mchog ni/ zab gsal gnyis su med pa'i tshul du shes par bya ste/ de la thig le rnal 'byor dang / phra mo'i rnal 'byor gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rang gi ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka'i ting 'dzin sems dpa' ral gri'i yu bar zla ba la gnas pa'i ma yig las 'od zer 'phros pas/ sems can thams cad 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i go 'phang la bkod pa rnams dang lhan cig de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs te/ thim pa'i rkyen gyi ma yig 'od du zhu nas/ rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin thig le 'od zer sna tshogs pa 'phro ba dwangs shing gsal ba yungs kar gyi 'khru tsam la sems bzung zhing sems 'phro na thig le las 'od zer 'phros pas ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' nas/ snod bcud kyi bar rim gyis kun tu snang bar byas nas slar yang de bzhin du rim gyis bsdus te thig le la thim/thim le las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi 'bab par yun ring du bsam par bya'o/ /de la sems brtan pa ni/ thig le'i nang du lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor skad cig gis gsal btab la/dkyil 'khor thig le dang bcas pa las 'phros pa'i 'od zer rang gi ba sbu'i sgo thams cad nas 'phros te phyi nang thams cad snang bas khyab par bsgoms pas bying ba mtha' dag sel bar nus so/ /—97—

gnyis pa phra tsho rnal wor ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs te/ rang gi zhal nas zhugs pa byang chub kyi sems zhu ste/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+ma'i sna rtser babs pa yongs su gyur pa las/ zla ba la gnas pa'i ral gri nas 'khru tsam gyi yu ba'i dbus su/thig le phra mo ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin 'od zer shin tu gsal ba'i nang du lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa skad cig gis gsal btab ste/ de la yun ring du sems bzung bas du ba la sogs pa'i rtags rnams 'char bar 'gyu/ra la/ mtshan ma de 'dra ma mthong gi bar du mi spro zhing / mthong nas dkyil 'khor du ma spros te/ 'gro ba'i don byas nas slar yang bsdu ba'i spro bsdu la bslab par bya'o/ /bsgoms pas skyo na bzlas pa bya ba ni/ sku gsung thugs rdo rje dang ye shes sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs kar rlung dang chu dang me dang sa'i dkyil 'khor la gnas par gyur pa ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka'i maX gyi mthar bzlas pa'i sngags kyis bskor ba dang / rdo rje gsum gyi thugs kha'i oṃ āXhūX rnams las/ rlung 'gro 'ong dang lhan cig rdo rje gsum rim pa pas saX gcig car spros/ nam mkha' gang ba'i lha mo rnams kyis 'khyud pa sogs mchod pas mnyes shing / 'gro ba'i don mdzad nas maX gyi 'od zer gyis bsdus te yig 'bru rnams la thim par bsam la/ oṃ āXmaX hūX zhes gtso bor bzlas shing / gzhan yang / oṃ āXmañju badz+ra maX huX/oX āXbadz+ra lha ka huX skyoX/ oṃ āXrat+na lha ka aX skyoX/ oṃ āX.a ro le ka hiXhūX/ oṃ āXpradz+nyā dhika khaX hūX/ oṃ āXmo ha ra tī laX huX/ oṃ āXdī ṣa ra tī maX huX/ oṃ āXrā ga ra ti paX hūX/skye( āXbadz+ra ra tī tāX hūX/ skye( āXrū pa badzā dzaXhūX/ glu rna āXrjo badzā baX hūX/ tsho( āXrā sa —98—

badzā hoXhūX/ oX āXspar sha badzā khaX huX/ oṃ āXdharma bhā tu badzā raX huX/ oṃ āXya mun+ta krita huX hūX/ tseX( āXprarnyornya krita huX huX/ tso ( āXpa dhan+ta krita hūX hūX/ tseX( āXdzo krita huX hūX/ spa bzlas par bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor bsdu bar 'dod na rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor las sku'i rigs rnams sku rdo rje dang / gsung gi rigs rnams gsung rdo rje dang / thugs kyi rigs rnams thugs rdo rje la thim pa'i tshul gyis dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rang la thim par gyur bas/ rdo rje gsum shin tu brtan par gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsam mo/ /gtor chog ni zas bzang dgu sha dang myos byed kyis brgyan pa/ bdud rtsi lngas sbags pa'i gtor ma gnyis mchod pa dang bcas pa mdun du bshams la/ lkoX āXbirtswan+ta krita hūX/ oX hūṃ n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba ut+pa ko3haX/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las yaX las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can rgyal mtshan dang / yaX gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raX las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa raX gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du kaX las mi mgo'i sgyed bu gsum gyi steng du a las thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ dpral ba rang la stan pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang gi shar du/ bhuX las dri chen bhuX gyis mtshan pa/ lhor aX las rak+ta aX gis mtshan pa/ nub tu dzi las byang sems dzi gis mtshan pa/ byang du khaX las sha chen khaX gis mtshan pa/ dbus su hūX las dri chu huX gis mtshan pa/ thun mong gi steng du oX yig dkar po 'od zer 'phro bar gyur/ rang gi thugs kha'i maX gyis de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga spyan drangs te/ rang rang gi sa bon la thim rlung g.yos te me sbar bas rdzas rnams zhu zhing khol dri ma thams cad sbyangs shing kha dog dmar ser nyi ma 'char ka'i —99—

mdog can gsal zhing dwangs par gyur/ de'i slangs pa gyen du phyur ba las byung ba'i huX las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od zer rab tu 'phro ba gsum yang bar snang de nyid du zhu ba thod par lhung bas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi zag pa med pa'i ro dang bcud kyi brgyan par byas/ oṃ yig gi 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na gnas pa'i snod bcud kyi bdud rtsi thams cad bkug nas bstim pas rgya cher spel zhing byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ oṃ āXhuX lan gsum brjod/ mchod pa rnams bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ āXhuX rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ 'thor 'thung / me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/rol mo la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas thams cad rang bzhin bde stong gi ye shes/rnam pa mchod rdzas kyi sprin dpung / byed las rang g.yin gyi dbang po mtha' dag zag med kyi bde bas tshim par byed pas phyi nang kun tu gang bar gyur/ oṃ a rgyuX āXhuX/ de bzhin du/ ngu khyuX/ añca ma naX/ puspro/ dhū pe/ ā lo ༷ke ga rnye/ ni wi teX/shabha/ rū pa/ shasta/ gan+ta/ rā sa/ spar sha /dharma bhā tu/ āXhū/ badz+ra spa ra ṇa kha/rang gi snying ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaX oṃ pad+ma ka ma la ye stuX/ zhes gdan phul/ mdun bskyed kyi lha thams cad kyi ljags huX las byung ba'i rdo rje'i 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma gsol bar gyur/ oṃ āXbadz+ra dhika sarba dus na sa ma ya mu dra pra bhañja kam ma sharnyi rak+ṣa tsa ku ru ku ru swāhā huX zhes lan bdun gyis mi bskyod pa dang / badz+ra dhika gi gnas su lha rnams kyi mtshan so sor bcug ste lan gsum gsum gyis lha tshogs rnams la 'bul —100—

bar bya'o/ /yang na thog mar badz+ra dhika gi gnas su mañju badz+ra zhes bcug pa ni 'jam pa'i rdo rje la'o/ /mthar tshogs zhing gi skabs bzhin mchod pa phul la/ de nyid lnga pas bstod nas/ rdo rje gsum dngos mi phyed sku/ /ye shes lnga ldan bde ba che/ /'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /zhes sogs 'phrin las gzhol/ 'jig rten pa'i lha tshogs rnams la gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer nag po lcags kyu lta bu 'phros/ phyogs skyong 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad ā kar+ṣa dza zhes bkug te gong ltar gdan phul la/ mchod yon dang nyer spyod kyisamachod la/ thugs kha'i 'od zer gyis drangs te zhal du zhugs/ byang chub kyi sems su zhu rdo rje'i lam nas/ lha mo'i mtsho skyes su babs pa thig le'i ngo bor gnas/thig le de nyid cha bco lngar gyur/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ 'dus pa'i lha tshogs rnams su gyur pa ni/ shar du rdo rje mtshon cha ser po/ de'i g.yon phyogs su rdo rje sgyu ma sngon po/ shar lhor rdo rje ma dmar po/ lhor rdo rje dus nag po/ lto nub tu rdo rje gas shing nag po/ nub tu rdo rje klu dkar po/ nub byang du rdo rje rlung ljang khu/ byang du rdo rje 'jigs byed ser po/ de'i g.yas phyogs su rdo rje sna rings dkar po/ byang shar du rdo rje khro bo dkar po/ dbang po'i g.yas su rdo rje 'khyil ba dmar po/ g.yon du rdo rje 'od dkar po/ de'i yang g.yon du rdo rje mi smra ser po/ nub dang bden bral gyi bar du thags bzang ris sngon po/ de'i g.yon du sa'i lha ser po/ thams cad kyang zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rang rang gi mtshon cha dang rang rtags 'dzin pa/ sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng du rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rang snang gi rig ma la 'khyud pa/ 'od kyi dra ba 'gyed pa can —101—

no/ /de nas rdo rje ma drug dang / nyer spyod kyis mchod nas/rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye ste/ o ā badz+ra yudha sarba dug sa ma ya mu tra pra bhañja ka ma ma shān+ti rak+ṣa tsa ku ru hri dzazhes lan gsum la sogs pas dbang po la 'bul ba dang / badz+ra bud dha (yudha3'i gnas su/ma ya badz+ra dang / badz+ra a na la dang / badz+ra kā la dang / badz+ra mu ṣa la dang / nā ga badz+ra dang / badz+ra a nā la dang / badz+ra shos dang / badz+ra bhi ra ba dang / badz+ra kro dha dang / badz+ra kuṇ+ḍal dang / badz+ra pra bha dang / mo na badz+ra dang / be+e ma tsi tra dang / pri shrī de ba tā zhes pa rnams bcug nas gzhan rnams la yang so sor lan gsum gsum sogs phul te/ skye( ā dus gsum skyes pa kun dang phyogs bcu yi/ /'jig rten khams rnams nam mkha'i mthas klas pa/ /rgya mtsho'i sprin gyi bkod pa rab 'byams kyi/ khren du phra ba'i rdul skyes dkyil 'khor ni/ /phan tshun cig gi nang du cig son pa/ /snyoms par 'jug la kun tu gnas pa yi/ /chos kyi dbyings su yang dag par 'du zhing / /nam mkha'i khams kyi yongs su mthar thug pa'i/ /dus gsum skyes pa kun dang phyogs bcu yi/ /'jig rten khams rnams mtha' yas sprin bkod pa/ /nam mkha' rab 'khyams mnyam dang 'jig rten skyong / /kun dang sems can kun yang 'di lta ste/ /rdo rje mtshon cha sgyu ma rdo rje dang / /rdo rje me dang rdo rje dus dang ni/ /rdo rje gtun shing rdo rjer klu dag dang / /rdo rje rlung dang rdo rje 'jigs byed dang / /rdo rje sna rings rdo rje khro bo dang / /rdo rje 'byil ba rdo rje 'od dang ni/ /mi smra rdo rje dang ni thag bzang ris/ /sa yi lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /me tog dag dang bdug pa mar me dang / /dri dang lha bsho/sa la sogs yang dag ldan/ /nye bar spyod pa dang ni gtor ma 'di/ /so sor bzhes shing nye bar —102—

longs spyad nas/ /bdag gi dbyig gser nor 'bru lang tsho che/ /nad med pa dang bde ba dam pa rnams/ /'phrog par byed pa'i bgegs dang log 'dren kun/ /sdang dang rab tu sdang ba thams cad dang / /mi dang mi ma yin rnams rmongs par mdzod/ /bdag la dbyig gser nor 'bru lang tsho che/ /nad med pa dang bde ba dam pa dang / /bde ba chen po rab tu 'phel ba rnams/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i mthar thug bar/ /gnang bar mdzad cing rtag tu gtong grogs dang / /zhi ba dang ni bsrung bar mdzad du gsol/ /skyo/ zhes pas spyi khyab tu lan gsum mam bdun la sogs pa bya/ de nas de thams cad kyis legs so zhes gsung bas dge ba dang /dngos grub ci 'dod pa stsol bar zhal gyis gzhes par bsam/ khyed rnams kyis bdag la dngos grub ma lus pa stsol ba dang / las thams cad sgrub pa'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/ yi ge brgya pa mang du bzlas/ bdag ni rnam g.yengs rmugs dang le lo yis/ /sems ma 'dus dang mi gsal ma sgrub pas/ /mgon po khyed rnams thugs dang 'gal ba gang / /rang bzhin dag pa'i chos gzigs bzod par mdzod/ /oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs pa dang / /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ a kā ro mu kha sarba dharmā ṇa a du nudzin twata badz+ra mu zhes gshegs su gsol/ smon lam gdab cing bkra shis kyang bya'o/ /'di rgyun 'byer gyi gtor chog bsdus pa yin gyi/ gtor ma chen po'i cho ga ni gzhan du gsal te gal yang chen po'o/ /de la bzlas pa dang / sgom pa'i dkyil 'khor mchod pa dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi bcud len dang dkyil lubor nye bar bsdu ba dang / spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor dang / zas kyi rnal 'byor dang / dam tshig gsob dang / khrus kyi rnal —103—

'byor dang / nyal ba'i rnal 'byor dang / ldang ba'i rnal 'byor dang / bar chad zlog pa dang / mchod pa dang / gtor ma ste/ bcu bzhi ni rjes spyod yan lag dang bcas pa'o/ /de ltar bskyed rim goms pa brtan pa na las tshogs thams cad sgrub pa dang /rdzogs pa'i rim pa sgom dgos pa las/ de'i man ngag ni gzhan du shes par byas la/ rim pa gnyis kyi rnal 'byor goms pas ye shes la cung zad dbang bar gyur pa na/ thun mong gi dngos grub chen po rnams kyang sgrub nus par 'gyur la/ de nas rdzogs pa'i rim pa la gtso bor rten pas/ ye shes la dbang bar gyur pa na/ sems can sna tshogs pa rnams don chen po la gzung pa'i phyir/ rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa spyod cing / des ye shes la yang dag par dbang bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas phyag rgya'i sbyor ba las nang gis bcu mngon du byas te/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi sku rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phangs mngon du byed pa yin no/ /de ltar sgrub thabs bshad las bsod nams gang / /thob pa des kyang mar gyur 'gro ba rnams/ /dpal ldan 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i go 'phang mchog /da lta nyid du thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i sgrub thabs mdo tsam du bkral ba 'di ni/ rgyal khams kyi rnal 'byor pa tā ra nā thas smras pa ste/ rgyas par spro na sngar bshad pa las rtogs par bya'o// //ma ṅga la/—104—

dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ye shes snang byed ces bya ba bzhu/gas/〈cung zad bsdus pa/〉oṃ snya sti/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa ye shes zhabs lugs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ye shes snang byed ces bya ba/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i lha tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan 'od gsal bde chen rdo rje'i thugs/ /gnyis med ye shes dag pa'i dkyil 'khor can/ /zung 'jug gsang ba 'dus pa'i lha tshogs la/ /rtag par dngos po kun gyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di yi dkyil 'khor cho ga ni/ /sngags rig kun gyis yang yang mdzad/ /'on kyang mos pa gtsor gyur pas//'bri ba 'di la skyon yod min/ /'di ltar ste/ sa chog dang / sta gon dang / dngos gzhi zhug gi cho ga dang / dbang bskur ba dang / rjes kyi cho ga'o/ /dang po ni dbang chog chen mor shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa la spyir lhag gnas bzhi yod kyang / slob ma lhag gnas 'og tu bshad na lag len bde bas/ 'dir bdag bskyed sngon tu 'gro ba'i/ sa'i lha mo lhag gnas dang / lha lhag gnas dang / bum pa lhag gnas dang / rjes kyi bya ba ste bzhi las/ dang po ni lhag gnas kyi sa gzhir dri bzang gi thig le bya/ sa'i lha mo'i mchod gtor dang / spyi mchod rnams bshams/ sngon 'gro gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ oX āXhūX ha hoXhiX rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs skyong ba bcu srid pa gsum gyi 'gyung po'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams dang / gnas bdag gzhi bdag grong bdag gnyug mar gnas pa thams cad ā kwanā ya dzaX zhes spyan drangs/—105—

skye( 6/rgyu ya/ a/sna ye/ ya ma ya/ ne ri tu/ wā ya we/ ṭa/ be ra yā/ 6/ 41 na ya/gi sgo pra h+ma/ sur+ya gra ha a dhi pa ti tsan+d+ra na k+ṣa tra/ a dhi pa ti/ a dho pri thi lī de skyi khyu a su ra khyu na ga khyu oṃ a kā ro mu kha sarba dharmā ṇa a du nu tu lha twata/ oṃ ā hū phaṭa swāhā/ lan gsum dang / tse( gnas bdag gzhi bdag gro/nga bdag gnyug/ mar gnas pa thams cad sa pa ri wā ra a kā ro sogs lan gsum/ o sarba bhu te sbyo ar+gha nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ sa la rgyu ba'i 'byung po dang / /gang yang sa la brten pa rnams/ /sa phyogs dge gnas 'di nyid du/ /dam pa'i dkyil 'khor cher 'byung ba/ /ji ltar nus par nyer spyod na/ /khyod kyis bar chad mi byed par//dge ba'i grogs po nyid du mdzod/ /sa'i phyogs 'dir de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po bzhengs su gsol te/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba dang / slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur bar 'tshal na/ phyogs skyong ba la sogs pa dkar po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i 'byung po'i tshogs rnams mchod spyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ dkyil 'khor khang pa'i phyogs bcur bzhugs te bar du gcod pa thams cad bsrung ba'i las mdzod cig gnyug/ mar gnas pa rnams kyang zhi ba'i sems dang ldan par mdzad du gsol/ gang dag nag po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba gsang spyod blta bar mi dbang ba thams cad sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par songs shig ces mtshams rngam dang / rol mo'i sgrar bcas pas gtor ma gtong ngo / de nas gnas dang yo byad byin gyis brlab pa ni/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hu yig las byung ba'i bsrung ba'i —106—

'khor lo'i nang du/ gnas khang bhuX las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal med khang pa gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis brgyan pa/ rgyan dang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su/ a las byung ba'i nas/ rol mo byin 'bebs kyi bar sgrub thabs ltar ro/ /de nas gtor ma ltar nang mchod byin gyis brlabs/ skyabs 'gro nas dkyil 'khor nyer bsdu'i bar sgrub thabs yongs rdzogs sgom/ de nas sa lha'i mchod gtor rnams/ bsangs sbyangs/ oX āXhūX lan mang du brjod pas byin gyis rlabs/ sa lha'i tshom bu bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la/ paX las byung ba sa'i lha mo ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yon bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa 'dzin cing / g.yas dpang por khas len pa'i phyag rgya can/ zhi zhing dges la/ rgyan dang na bza' ser po can du gyur/ rang gi lag pa g.yas par zla ba la hūX gsum/ rdo rje rtse gsum gyis phyag rgya sa la reg ste/ huX hūX hūX ṭak+ki huX dzaX sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ dza huX baX hoX dpral bar lkoX/ mgrin par āX thugs kar huX/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaX ar+ghaX nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ lkoX badzi bha wa a bhi khiñca huX/ zhes dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu rgyan/ oX pri thi swe de lī sa pa ri wā ra khyuX ar+ghaX pra titsā swāhā/ de bzhin du sha lta'i bar du sbyar/ oṃ pri thi lī de lī sa pa ri wā re khyuX a kā ro btogs pa lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyi/ /sa dang pha rol phyin rnams la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur//skyob pa shākya seng ge yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi dpung bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag —107—

gis bdud kyi sde/ /pham par bya phyir dkyil 'khore bri/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ gnang ba byin par bsams/ sa'i lha mo slar yang sa de nyid la thim/ gnyis pa ni dkyil 'khor gyi sar dri bzang gis byugs/ gtso bo'i gnas su dri'i thig le gru bzhi dang / lha g.yin gyi gnas su zlum po bkod/ de rnams kyi steng du me tog gam 'bru'i tshom bu bya/ lha re re la sgos mchod bcu bcu las mi nyung bar bshams/ de rnams lag len mthong pas shes/ shar gyi g.yon du 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma dang g.yas su 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma bshams spyi mchod kyang kha gso/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rdo rje sa gzhi rwa gur rab tu yangs pa'i dbus su/ thar pa chen po'i khang bzang gzhal yas khang zhes pa nas/gzhal med khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ lha'i gdan rnams kyi steng du/ ma bru a dzi kha la ma pa tā/ dza : ba ho kha ra/ hū hu hū hu/ zhes pa rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus kyi gdan steng du/ mi bskyod pa'i ngo bo dpal ldan 'jam pa'i rdo rje nas/ thams cad dang ldan par gyur/ de'i pang du yum 'jam pa'i rdo rje ma nas/ yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ le tshe brgyad las shar du rnam par snang mdzad dkar po nas/ pad+ma 'dzin pa/ de bzhin du lho ru rin 'byung sogs rigs bzhi bskyed/ shar lho spyan ma dkar mo sogs yum bzhi bskyed/ rim pa gnyis pa'i shar ltor gzugs rdo rje ma sogs rdo rje ma drug bskyed/ de thams cad kyang nas/ nyi ma'i 'od 'phro ba'o/ khar sgor gshin rje mthar byed sogs khro bo bzhi bskyed nas/ khro bo bzhi po nas bzhugs pa'o/ /rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis dhi~X bar ༵sdu ye ༵sa pa/ snyim ba/ / hā~X dkyil khu sde te / cang kyi / kye mi te / ra ga ༵ rnyi /༵/ /bisnrun ge rgor ༵ kau —108—

kyis 'phro 'du las/ sa snying dkar po zhes pa nas/ kun tu bzang po rdo rje 'chang lta bu'o/ /sgrub thabs ltar mchod pa byin gyis brlabs nas dngos gzhi'i skabs su 'chad par 'gyur pa'i mchod bstod bya/ gtor chog ltar 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma 'bul lo/ /gsum pa ni/ bum pa rnams kyi mtshan nyid dang / nang rdzas dang / 'cha' tshul dang mchod gtor rnams ni spyi dang 'dra/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ paX las pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ baX las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba lto ba ldir ba mgrin pa phra ba mchu 'phyang ba lha'i gos kyi mgul chings dang dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang snying po thams cad kyis yongs su gang ba/ oṃ ta ste ta ste mahā ta ste swāhā/ lha'i chu bo dal gyis 'bab pas yongs su gang ba rnams su gyur/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i dbus su pad+ma'i gdan bcu dgu/so sor nyi zla'i gdan dang bcas pa de rnams kyi steng du/ maX bhuXtsho aX dzi khaX laX maX paX tāX/ dzaXhuX baX hoXkhaX raX/ huX huX huX huX/ rnams so so'i gnas su yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ mi bskyod pa'i ngo bo dpal ldan 'jam pa'i rdo rje nas g.yon rkyang gi stabs kyi bzhugs pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar/ lha sta gon gyi skabs bzhin no/ /las bum du pad nyi la hūX las bgegs mthar byed nag po nas pad+ma 'dzin pa/ khro bo'i rgyan dang cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /lha thams cad kyi mig tu k+ṣ-i sogs skye ma rtsen byin rlabs dang / lha rnams kyi nu ma gnyis kyi dbus su nas/oX dkar po'i bar gyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs sgrub thabs bzhin bya'o/ /rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros ye shes sems dpa' lha bcu dgu bgegs mthar byed dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaX oṃ ya mun nas hoX yang thugs ka'i sa —109—

bon las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha nas/ rang rang rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan gyi bar dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi sgrub chen bzhin no/ /oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta u da ka hu dang / oṃ ā hu lan bdun bdun gyis dung chos kyi chu bdud rtsir mos/ gzungs thag nas bzung ste gtso bo la brgya phrag gnyis sogs dang gzhan rnams la nyi shu rtsa gcig re/ las bum la snying po brgya rtsa dang 'phreng sngags ci rigs par bzla'o/ /de las hu lan bdun gyi dung chos gyi chu dang /bgegs mthar byed kyi snying po lan bdun bzlas pa'i me tog gsum bum par blug mchod pa rnams sgrub thabs ltar byin gyis brlabs te/ tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar phyi mchod dang de nyid lnga pas bstod/ so so'i snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul/ ku shas las bum gyi chu blangs nas bum pa rnams la bskor zhing gsang gtor byas nas/ ji srid dkyil 'khore chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bar chad bsrung ba'i 'phrin las mdzod ces bya/de nas gtor ma byin gyis brlabs nas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma 'bul te sgrub thabs bzhin no/ /yig brgya lan mang du brjod pa'i rjes su bum pa la rdo rjes reg ste slar yang / mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /sogs kyis bstod/ bum nang gi lha rnams 'dod chags chen po'i mes byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba bum pa'i chu dang ro gcig tu gyur/bzhi pa ni/ de nas mdun bskyed la dmigs te/ lce hu las byung ba'i rdo rjer gyur/oṃ badz+ra dzi hā/ spos phor dang dril bu thogs nas/ bcom ldan 'jam pa'i rdo rje mchog /rig sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang / khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /mgon po thugs rje'i bdag nyid can/ /dkyil 'khor bri bar bdag 'tshal lo/ /de phyir bcom ldan bdag gus la/ /bka' drin gnang bar mdzad pa'i rigs/ /sangs rgyas 'gro 'khor bya don stsol/ /byang —110—

chub sems dpa' 'bras gnas dang / /gzhan yang gang dag gsang sngags lha/ /lha dang 'jig rten skyong ba dang / /'byung po byang chub bstan gnas dang / /sems can bstan la mngon dga' ba/ /gang su rdo rje'i spyan snga rnams/ /bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ /'jam dpal 'gyung ba'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /'gro ba mi shes dag pa'i phyir/ /yo byad ci 'byor pas 'bri na/ /deng bdag slob mar bcas rnams la/ /thugs ni brtse bas nyer dgongs te/ /tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad ni/ /byin gyis brlabs par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab la gnang ba byin par bsam/mchod bstod bsdus pa zhig bya/ bstod pa shin tu bsdus pa dgos pa'i rigs la/ dpal ldan mi shes kun spangs sogs/ sho lo ka gcig gi mthar/ phung po khams dang skye mched rnams/ /rnam dag ye shes lnga yi dngos/ /zab gsal bcu dgu'i lha tshogs rnams/ /'khore dang bcas la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /zhes pa 'dis bstod/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol ba thams cad phyogs bcings par gyur/ lko brjod la/ re wo mi 'degs par zhag de nyid kyi nub mo mchod pa rgyun mi chad par bya'o/ /dngos gzhi dkyil 'khor gyi zhag gi cho ga la dkyil 'khor 'bri ba dang / sgrub pa dang /mchod pa gsum mo/ /dang po la/ ye shes kyi thig gi cho ga las thig gi cho ga rdul tshon byin gyis rlabs pa dkyil 'khor 'bri ba ste bzhi las/ dang po ni/ lha'i rnal 'byor rgyas bsdus gang rung sngon du 'gro bas/ tsho ni skud sna lnga la yungs kar gyi phye ma dang / bdud rtsi lnga la/ bsres pas byugs/ dri zhim pos bgos la/ nag dkar ser dmar ljang khu lnga rim pas mthe bong sogs kyi rtsa bar bkod nas cung zad bskyangs te/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ hu las byung ba'i thig —111—

skud nag po/ mi bskyod pa'i ngo bo/ bruX las byung ba'i thig skud dkar po rnam snang gi ngo bo/ lkoX las byung ba'i thig skud ser po rin 'byung gi ngo bo/ dzi las byung ba'i thig skud dmar po 'od dpag med kyi ngo bo/ khaX las byung ba'i thig skud ljang khu/ don grub kyi ngo bo rnams ye shes lnga'i rang bzhi du gyur/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams dang mkha' dbyings gang ba'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs kar huX bruX aX dzi khaX las byung ba'i ye shes kyi srad bu 'od kyi rang bzhin du bzhugs/ oṃ āX.ak+ṣi khyuXbadz+ra snyu draX me pra ca mahā maṇ+ḍal sru dra ṇa ya hūX/ zhes lan gsum dang / de bzhin du ak+ṣi khyuXganas su/ sha shwa ta dang / rat+na saX bha wa dang / a mi ta bha dang / a mo gha sirnyi zhes pa rnams bcug ste gsol ba btab/ rang gi mig gnyis su dzaX las nyi ma dang zla ba 'od zer ser po can/ mig 'bras hūX/ oṃ di rto drisgyi a du sha dzaX nam mkha'i lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi srad bu rigs lnga rnams spyan drangs/ dam tshig gi srad bu la thim/ de nas slob ma bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i 'jam pa'i rdo rje mar gsal ba dang lhan cig thig skud brkyangs te/ oṃ a no n+ya/ a nu ga ta/ sarba dharmā pa ra spa ra a nu pra bri gi sarba dharma ad+man+ta a nu bri gi sarba dharmā/ oṃ āXhuX/ zhes dang po so sor sgril/ de nas phyogs gcig tu sgril lo/ /de nyid snod gtsang mar bzhag la/ rang gi mig g.yon pa ma las nyi ma/ g.yas pa ṭa las zla ba/ badz+ra sbyo tho ma ṭa/ thig skud la drag tu bltas pas brtan par byas la/ las thams cad pa bzlas pa'i bdud rtsi lnga dang / yungs kar dang /dri bzang gi chus gtor/ lag pas reg la/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya snyu tra huX dang / oṃ āXhuX/brgya rtsa la sogs pa bzlas/ /las thams cad pas bsrung ba byas nas bzhag go/lhag gnas kyi —112—

dkyil 'khor la mchod pa gsar du bshams/ sgrub thabs bzhin byin gyis rlabs/ mchod bstod bsdus pa dang nang mchod phul nas/ oṃ badz+ra gi dhiṣ+ṭha zhes pa'i sngags rgyas dkyil 'khor btegs la nyi zla kha sbyor gyi dbus su bzhugs par gyur/ de nas mchod bstod bsdus pa dang las thams cad pas bsrung ba bya/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi la/ oṃ sarba sa sho dha ni hu/ zhes dri bzang gi chus gtor byi dor bya mtha' la me tog bkram/ slob dpon shar du phyogs pas lte bar lag pa g.yon pas thig skud bzung / slob ma nub tu phyogs pa la g.yas pas thig sna gtad/ rje zhes brjod slob mas g.yon pas blangs la lte bar bzung / de nas ji ltar thig gdab pa ni/ thig 'dzin tshul de nyid las/ slob dpon gyi g.yas pa'i theb mdzug gis thig skud nam mkhar 'debs pa'i tshe/o badz+ra sa ma ya snyu tra hū/ sems can don du khyed rnams kyi/ /dus yin de ring 'dir spyon cig /thig gi sgras/ nam mkha' gang ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams bskul te mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du byon nas thig skud la thim/ de yang nub shar gnas pas tshangs thig dang po gdab/ lho byang gnyis pa me dbang shar gyi logs/ /rlung srin nub dang rlung dbang byang yin te/ /mi srin gnas pas lho yi rtsa thig gdab//srin dbang zur thig dang po me rlung gnas/ /zur thig gnyis pa btab de thig chen brgyad/ /ces pa ltar la g.yas bskor dang rgyab 'gros sogs lag len bzhin bya/ de dag tu slob dpon rkang pa g.yon skyil krung dang g.yas rkang mthil sa la btsugs pa'i tsog pu dang / slob ma de las ldog pas so/ /gnyis pa ni/ thig skud de nyid dam gzhan yin na/ bsangs sbyangs/ hū las rdo rje hu gis mtshan pa las bgegs mthar byed/ las bum gyi skabs bzhin bskyed/ gnas gsum byin rlabs dang / dbang bskur rgyas gdab/ sa lha'i skabs bzhin byas la/ mi bskyo(da —113—

pas dbu brgyan/ ar+gha nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ zhu ba las byung ba'i thig skud du gyur/ oṃ badz+ra be gā kra ma ho/ zhes pas ye shes kyi thig bteg ste/ thig sna gtod tshul sogs ye theg dang 'dra bar byas nas las thig gdab par bya'o/ /tshangs dang zur thig legs btab nas/cha chen bcu drug bgo bar bya'o/ /dang drug phyed gdab phyi phyed gdab/ gnyis bdun bzhi cha bzhi ru bgo /gsum pa bzhi pa rang sar bzhag /lnga brgyad dbus dor mtha' gnyis gdab/ /dgu po rtsa ba'i thig yin te/ /bco lnga pa ni mda' yab thig /de gnyis zur nas zur du'o/ /bcu pa la sogs thig lnga ni/ /zur thig nas brtsam tshangs thig ngos/ /gnyis par reg pa dang po gnyis/ /bdun par reg pa phyi ma gsum/ /tshangs thig nas brtsam gnyis pa ni/ /bcu nas bcu gcig bar du'o/ /tshangs thig nas brtsam dang po ni/ /dgu nas bcu gnyis la reg pa'o/ /de nas dngos su gsum pa'i bar/ /steng du bcu gsum pa la reg /de gnyis rtse sbrel bzhi pa ni/ /bcu gcig pa nas bcu bzhi'i bar/ /rtse nas rtse ru bcu bzhi pa/ /tshangs thig nas brtsams lnga pa dang / /drug pa bdun rnams bcu gcig nas/ /bco lnga'i thig la reg par gdab/ /mda' phyir gcig nas tshangs thig steng / /cha chung gnyis kyi steng du bskor/ /g.yas g.yon sne las 'thud nas ni/ /cha chung re res g.yas g.yon bskor/ /de nang cha chung phyed kyis bskor/ /nang gi bskor thig la reg par/ /bcu drug la sogs thig bzhi ni/ /tshangs thig nas brtsams bdun pa dang / /drug lnga bzhi la reg par gdab/ /de dag rnams kyi rtse mo'ang sbrel/ /nyi shu la sogs thig gsum ni/ /tshangs thig nas brtsams dang po la/ /reg pa tsam du gdab bar bya/ /yang na rtsa ba cha chung gnyis/ /rtse mo cha chung gcig dbus rwa/ /tshangs phyir gnyis dang mda' phyir gcig /ka rgyan rtse nas nang rwa bskor/ /de nas ngos gnyis steng du gcig /phyi nas snga ma'i tshad kyis bskor/ /dbus kyi cha gsum bzhi bzhir bgo /bcu gnyis bcu —114—

gcig bcu steng bskor/ /gsum pa bzhi pa bsnol mar btab/ /le tshe dgu par 'gyur ba yin/ /phyi rol rim pas bskor thig bzhi/ /gcig phyed gcig gi tshad nas bskor/ /zhes bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ tshon sna lnga'am/ nyi shu rtsa lnga legs pa bshams/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sogs/ thig skud ces pa'i gnas su rdul tsho ni zhes pa dang / badz+ra snyu tra zhes pa'i gnas su badz+ra tsi tra dang / sru tra ṇa yi gnas su tsi tra ṇa ya zhes pa'i khyad par ma gtogs ye thig dang 'dra la/ mig g.yas pa la zhes pa nas/ brtan par byas kyi bar yang rdul tsho ni 'es pa nyid khyad par ro/ /oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya hu/ zhes brgya rtsa bzla zhing mtheb srin gyis mnye/ rdul tshon rnams la hi yig bris te/ bden pa gang gis sems can rnams rdul mang zhing / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams sems can la chags pa dang /rjes su chags pa'i bden pa des rdul tshon rnams 'bar bar gyur cig ces brjod la yid kyis mchod/bzhi pa ni/ skye( badz+ra be ga a kra ma ho / zhes pas las thig kyang btegs la/ slob dpon nang du zhugs te/ hi hi zhes rdo rje'i lta ba dang bcas sgo'i thad kyi rtsa thig dbye'o/ /gal te las thig la bskyed chog med par cha dbye ba tsam yin na 'degs mi dgos so/ /de nas slob dpon gyis dbus kyi phur bu phyung / ye shes pa lag pa'i rdo rje la thim/ phur khung rtsig pa'i rim pa dang mthun pa'i rdul rdzo gyis 'gengs bzhi du dril bu dkrol la/ 'di ni chos dbyings dag pa ste/ /sems can khams ni rab sgrol byed/ /rang nyid 'jam dbyangs rgyal po ste//de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /nyes pa kun las rnam grol ba/ /'khordo ra lo'i nang na yang dag gnas/ /zhes pa'i don dran bzhi du glu blang ngo / /de nas ci bder 'gyed de/ dkyil 'khor gyi cha thams cad kyi kha dog dang mtshan ma ni spyi dang 'dra la/ bum pa brgyad —115—

kyang 'bri/ le tshe dgu'i dbus ma sngo ba/ gzhan rnams phyogs mdog dang / ka ba nag po rang rang gi mtshan ma can/ gdung zlum nag po la rdo rje dkar po'i 'phreng ba'o/ /lha mtshan bskyed chog las shes shing / gling rgyab phyogs mdog dang sngon po gnyis kar 'gal lo/ /mchod bstod byas te rdul tshon gyi ye shes pa gshegs dam tshig pa rang la bsdu'o/ /gnyis pa dkyil 'khor sgrub pa ni/ de ltar 'bri ba'i bya ba zin pa na/ spyi dang mthun par bgegs sbyang ba dang / sdig pa sbyang ba dang / las bum gyis khrus gsol rnams byas la/ lasathams cad pa bzlas shing bsrung / rgyan dang mchod rdzas kun la 'di las thams cad pas bsang gtor byas nas sa rgyan gnam rgyan rnams bkram/ mchod pa yang sta gon gyi dus las mi nyung ba nges par bsham dgos shing mang ba la ni tshad med de/ bum pa yang shar sgo'i g.yon du 'god/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma gnyis kyang bsham mo/ /sngon 'gro gtor ma nas/bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa nyer bsdu'i bar sta gon bzhin byas la/ dkyil 'khor sgrub pa la 'jug go /de yang dkyil 'khor bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ 'og tu oṃ las byung ba'i nas/ 'bar bas bskor bar gyur/ de'i dbus su sa las rdo rje dkar po nas/ yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ gdan de rnams kyi steng du/ lha'i mtshan ma rnams sa bon dang phyag mtshan dang sku yongs rdzogs su gyur pa ni/ dbus su ma las ral gri ma gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las dpal ldan 'jam pa'i rdo rje nas/ thams cad dang ldan par gyur/ shar du bru las 'khor lo bru gyis mtshan pa las rnam par snang mdzad sogs/ lho ru a las rin po che a gis mtshan pa las rin chen 'byung ldan sogs/ nub tu dzi las pad+ma dzi gis mtshan pa las 'od dpag med sogs/ byang du kha las ral gyi kha gis mtshan pa las don yod grub —116—

pa sogs/ shar lhor la las 'khor lo la gyis mtshan pa las spyan ma sogs/ lho nub tu ma las ut+pal dmar po ma gyis mtshan pa las mā ma gī sogs/ nub byang du pa las pad+ma dmar po pa gyis mtshan pa las gos dkar mo sogs/ byang shar du tā las ut+pal ser po tā gis mtshan pa las sgrol ma sogs/ rim pa gnyis pa'i shar lhor/ dza las me long dmar po dzas mtshan pa las gzugs rdo rje sogs/ lho nub tu hū las pi wa sngon po hū gis mtshan pa las sgra rdo rje ma sogs/nub byang du ba las dri bzang ser pos gang ba'i dung chos ba gyis mtshan pa las dri rdo rje ma sogs/ byang shar du ho las ro drug gis gang ba'i snod dmar po hos mtshan pa las ro rdo rje ma sogs/shar sgo'i g.yas su kha las lha rdzas kyi gos kha dog sna tshogs pa kha gis mtshan pa las reg rdo rje ma sogs/ shar sgo'i g.yon du ra las chos 'gyung dkar po ra gyis mtshan pa las chos dbyings rdo rje ma sogs/de thams cad kyang nas/ nyi ma'i 'od 'phro ba'o/ khar sgor hu las rdo rje tho ba rwa nyi shu pa hu gis mtshan pa las gshin rje mthar byed sogs/ lho sgor hu las rdo rje mtshan pa'i be con dkar po hu gis mtshan pa las shes rab mthar byed sogs/nub sgor hu las pad+ma dmar po hu gis mtshan pa las pad+ma mthar byed sogs/byang sgor hu las rdo rje nag po kha gyes pa hu gis mtshan pa las bgegs mthar byed sogs/ khro bo bzhi po nas/ bzhugs pa'o/ /bdag nyid dang dkyil 'khor kyi gtso bo gnyis su med par gyur/ rang gi pang du sme sha can gyi rigs las byung ba'i bu mo ut+pal mthing kha lta bu'i mdog can lo bcu drug lon pa gzugs dang mdangs dang lang tsho phun sum tshogs pa la sogs pa mtshan nyid thams cad —117—

yongs su rdzogs pas gnas par gyur/ de nyid kyang ma yig dmar ser du gyur/ma las ral gri ma gyis mtshan pa las yum 'jam pa'i rdo rje ma nas/ rdzogs par gyur/ yum gyis spyi gtsug nas snying kha'i bar du nas/ at+pa ko3ha/ de ltar rjes chags kyis snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba chen po'i sgras/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' khro bo'i dbang po rang rang gi lha mo'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs shing gcig tu 'dus pa rnams bsgom pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor du gyur pa badz+ra sa mā dza zhes pa nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ rjes chags kyi mes byang chub sems su zhu ba rdo rje lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pa yongs su gyur pa las/ ye shes pa lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa yongs su rdzogs par grub par gyur/ dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs mkha' nas nang phyir spros/ oṃ ya mun+ta krita dzanas/ ho lha thams cad mig tu nas/ rdo rje 'chang lta bu'o/ /lha thams cad kyi nu ma gnyis kyi nas/ rdo rje gsum gyis sngags brjod zin pa'i bar bsnyen sgrub bar ma'i skabs bzhin bya'o/ /yab yum gnyis ka'i thugs rdo rje'i gong du nas/ yar lud pa las/ gtso bo yab yum gnyis dang / rnam snang sogs de bzhin gshegs pa nas/ bdag pos dbu brgyan gyi bar sgrub pa r+sā po bzhin no/ /dbang gi lha thams cad kyang gnyis su med par thim/ zhes brjod/ sems dpa' gsum rtsegs gi skabs/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje yab yum gyi rnam par spyan drangs zhes pa dang / ye shes sems dpa' 'jam pa'i rdo rje yab yum ser sngo dkar zhes sogs —118—

'don pa sgyur dgos/ yang rang gi thugs ka'i ma las 'od zer 'phros pas/ sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzanas/ ta krita ho'i bar bsnyen pa chen po'i skabs bzhin no/ /gsum pa mchod pa ni sgrub thabs bzhin mchod pa byin rlabs byas la/ dag cing dri med yid 'ong ba'i/ /sngags kyi yon chab mchog 'di dag /bdag gi dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes nas bdag la bka' drin stsole/ /o mañju badz+ra de wa tsakra maṇ+ḍal sa pa ri wā ra u hri pra wa ra sad ka rwa the/ ar+gha pra ru swāhā/ de bzhin du 'don pa spos la/ yon myong zhes pa'i tshab tu/ zhabs bsil dang / ar+gha zhes pa ni/ pu du/o lha yi me tog dam pa ni/ /dkyil 'khor mchod pa bgyis par 'tshal/ /thugs ni brtse bas nyer dgongs nas/ /mgon po mchod pa 'di bzhes shig /de bzhin du/ bdug spos/ dhu pe/ snang gsal/ ā lo ke dri mchog ga rnye/ zhal zas/ nai be du/ rol mo/ sha lta/ gzugs la rnam gsum shes byas nas/ /mchod par byed pas mchod par bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan sna tshogs pa/ /sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad gzhi/ /'bul sngags gzhan rnams sngar dang 'dra ba la/ rū pa zhes 'don pa spo/ sgra la rnam gsum shes byas nas/ /bdag gi rigs la dbul bar bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan rdo rje can/ /mi bskyod pa yi tshul bsnyes pa'o/ /shasta/ dri la rnam gsum shes byas nas/ /lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan sna tshogs pa/ /sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung gnas gtso/ /ga rnye/ ro la rnam gsum shes byas nas/ /sangs rgyas sogs la dbul bar bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan sna tshogs pa/ /'dod chags cho se kyi 'byung gnas gtso/ /rā sa/ reg la —119—

rnam gsum shes byas nas/ /lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya/ /de nyid sangs rgyas sna tshogs pa/ /sangs rgyas thogs med rdo rje 'dzin/ /spar+sha/ gzugs sgra ro la sogs pa la/ /rtag tu sems ni sbyar bar bya/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /gsang ba'i snying po btus pa'o/ /sto bhā tu/ zhing 'dir 'khor lo rin wo gyi/ /mkhas pa dag gis yongs bkang ste/ /dngos grub 'dod pas sbyin pa'i phyir/ /nyin rer bdag gis dbul bar bgyi/ /tsakra rat+na/ zhing 'di nor bu rin chen gyi/ /sogs/ ma ṇi rat+na/ btsun mo/ snyi rat+na/ blon po/ pu ru ṣa rat+na/ glang po/lha sti rat+na/ rta mchog a shwa rat+na/ khyim bdag gro ha pa te rat+na/ de nas nang mchod/oṃ āXhuX lan bdun gyis byin gyis brlabs/ dpal ldan rigs thams cad kyi bdag po rtsa ba'i bla ma rje btsun rdo rje 'chang / 'di zhes bya ba'i zhal du oṃ āXhūX/'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas ye shes mar me mdzad bzang po/ /'jam dpal grags pa bde ba chen po yi ge pa/ /ka rna pa dang dz+nyā na shrī mi tra dang / /ba li ā tsar+ya dang gnyos lo yon tan grags/ /rdo rje bla ma jo sras dpal seng grags pa dpal/ /sangs rgyas ras chen byang ngar bsod nams rgyal po dang / /bsod nams bla ma 'jam dbyangs rin chen 'byung gnas dang / /mkhas btsun ye shes rin chen blo gros bzang / /tshul rgyal dar bzang nam mkha' rin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'a myong / /dbang rgyud man ngag gsum ldan bla ma rnams la 'bul/ /zhes dang / oṃ āXmañju badz+ra maX huX/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i zhal du oṃ āXhuX/ oṃ āXbadz+ra lha ka huX hūX sogs so so'i sngags kyi mthar 'bru gsum btags pas phul/ gzhan yang bya ba'i rgyud spyod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor rgyud rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud de rgyud sde chen po —120—

bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal tu mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ oṃ u hā/ dgos kyi chos skyong yod na/ de dang de'i snying po'i mthar yi ge 'bru gsum ba khas la 'bul/ gzhan yang chos 'khor bsrung zhing bstan pa skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i chos skyong bsrung ma dam tshig can rnams kyi zhal du mchod pa 'bul lo/ /o u hu/ gzhan yang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'ebyor ma grub pa rig pa 'dzin pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ u hu/ gzhan yang phyogs skyong bcu lha chen po brgyad klu chen po brgyad gza' chen po brgyad/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa bdun 'jigs byed chen po dgu rgyal po chen po bzhi rnams kyi zhal du oṃ u hu/ gzhan yang bod khams skyong ba'i bstan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang gnas bdag gzhi bdag grong bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyi zhal du o u hā/ gzhan yang 'gro ba rigs drug lam rgyud lnga skye gnas rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad zag pa med pa'i bde bas rgyud tshim par gyur cig bud med gzugs ldan mdangs bzang ba/ /lo grangs bcu drug lon pa ni/ /dri dang me tog 'phreng brgyan ste/ /yon tan skye rags mā ma kir/ /shes rab can gyis byin rlabs la/ /'khor lo'i dbus su mchod par bya/ /rin chen 'gyung gnas na chung mchog /rin chen sna tshogs mchog gis brgyan/ /dngos grub rab tu bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /lha rnams kun la dbul bar bya//mtshan nyid ldan pa'i rig ma la/ /'du shes gsum gyis snyoms par zhugs/ /'pho med bde ba mngon du gyur/ /gsang ba'i mchod pas mchod par bgyi/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra su bhā wa at+pa ko3ha/ thabs shes mnyam par —121—

sbyor las byung / /byang chub sems sgros de bzhin gshegs/ /ma lus nam mkha' gang ba yi/ /bla med mchod pas mchod par bgyi/ /oṃ u a nut+ta ra pū dzi te hu/yang dag dga' ba'i me tog gi /rdo rje nyi ma pad+ma ra phyung / /me tog bdag nyid la mchod pa/ /rdo rje gsum gyi dam tshig mchog /oṃ badz+ra pur+sha u hu/ rnam par rtog pa kun gyi tshogs/ /lte bar gtum mo 'bar ba yis/ /nges par bsreg pa de'i spos/ /thugs kyi rdo rje la ni dbul/ /dhu pe/ yi ge hū ཾ las yang dag byung //sngags kyi 'od zer shin tu gsal/ /mar me 'bar ba yang dag 'od/ /thugs kyi rdo rje la ni dbul/ /ā lo ke bde ba chen po'i nam mkhar gnas/ /byang chub sems ni sad pa dang / /de nyid kyis kyang byug pa ni/ /thugs kyi /ga rnye/ 'dir ni gang dag gang longs spyod/ /dbang po thams cad yang dag brten/ /de dag thams cad thugs rdo rje/ /bza' ba'i phyir du mchod par bgyi/ /ne we t+ya/ rdo rje pad+ma ra yang dag bskyod/ /zhugs pa la sogs rim las byung / /rnal 'byor pa yis mi shigs sgra/ /thugs kyi: kha p+ta/ rgod dang sgeg dang rtse 'jo sogs/ /sna tshogs kyis ni sems dgar byed/ /rnam par thar ba'i sgo gang dag /thugs kyi:/mahā su kha/ srab 'jam yang ba lha yi gos/ /mi bskyod rdo rje'i sku brnyes la/ /mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul na/ /bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog /oṃ mañju badz+ra sogs gong bzhi la/ badz+ra lha sta ye/ de las gzhan yang mchod pa ni/ /ut+pal pad+ma kha dog lnga/ /dzā ti kha dog rnam pa gsum/ /me tog kaṇi ka ra dang / /ma li ka dang yu thi ka /me tog ka ra wi ra dang / /lha mo dgu dang nam mkha'i khams//dpag tshad bye ba'i khyon tsam du/ gru bzhi shin tu mdzes pa la/ /mchod rten rin —122—

chen snang bzhi pa/ /gsal zhing rang bzhin dri ma med/ /dkyil 'khor lha la mchod pa 'bul/ /de bzhin gshe/gas pa bdag gi lus/ /bla ma bshad dang gci bas mchod/ /mig bzang brtan pa'i blo ldan pa'i/ khu ba blangs nas mchod par bya/ /bla re gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang / /ba dan lda ldi sil snyan sogs/ /rta babs mchog dang bla re dang / /bsil yab 'khyams dang khri stan sogs/ /bum pa bzang po 'dod 'jo'i ba/ /rin chen ri bo dpag bsam shing / /nam mkha' mdzod sogs dbul bar bgyi/ /dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ /de nas bstod pa ni/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /sogs sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba ltar de nyid lnga pa dang / zag bcas phung po gnas gyur zhing / /nyon mongs rnam dag ye shes sku/ /kun mkhyen kun mdzad kun gyi gtso/ /rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la 'dud/ /sa sogs 'byung ba rnam dag cing / /byams sogs tshad med ngo bo nyid/ /zag med bde ba'i mdzod 'dzin pa/ /gti mug dga' ma sogs phyag 'tshal/ /ser sna la sogs rnam dag cing / /phar phyin drug gi ngo bo nyid/ /dkyil 'khor mchod la mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /rdo rje gzugs sogs phyag 'tshal lo/ /lta ba'i thibs po rnam bcom pa/ /bsdu dngos bzhi'i ngo bo nyid/ /dgug gzhug bcing dang dbang mdzad pa'i/ /sgo bsrung bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rten 'brel bcu gnyis rnam dag cing / /byang chub phyogs chos rang bzhin can/ /bde chen snying po legs rdzogs pa/ /gzhal med khang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnyis med ye shes rdo rje yi/ /sa gzhi rwa ba gur bla bre/ /ye shes me dpung 'bar la brtson/ /bsrung ba'i 'khor lor phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum rdo rje'i thugs yin srid dang thar gyur —123—

gang / /zhi zhing sgrib med nam mkha' 'dag pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /sangs rgyas rnam rgyas byang chub dbang phyug rdo rje can/ /de la lus ngag yid kyi rtag tu phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig gzugs dang tshor ba 'du shes 'du byed dang / /rnam par shes dang skye mched drug dang dbang po drug /sa chu me dang rlung dang nam mkha' thams cad ni/ /byang chub sems 'dra rgya chen de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gti mug nyes pa 'dod chags rdo rje chos bcas gang / /rig pa'i sbyor pa las byung rtag tu rab 'brel bar/ /rnam pa sna tshogs dga' bas myos pa'i dngos gyur pa/ /byang chub sems: /sdud dang dga' dang rnam pa de bzhin mi 'gyur dang / khyu dang 'bras bu'i rang bzhin sems su rjes thogs chos/ rmongs dang zhe sdang 'dod chags sgrib pa rdo rje ste/ /byang chub sems 'dra: /gang zhig thog ma med dngos rnam dag 'di sgom pa/ /thabs dang shes rab las byung spros dang rnam par bral/ /gsang ba'i dbang bskur rtul zhugs dam tshig sbyor ba rtag /byang chub rdo rje 'drar lta de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig dngos grub mchog gi thabs ni 'di bsgoms shing / /bsnyen pa'i cho ga nyer bar sgrub pa bsgrub pa dang / /bsgrub pa chen pos blo mi 'gyur ba'i bsgrub dbang po/ /byang chub rdo rje 'drar lta de la: /gang zhig thun bzhi'i rdo rje dang ni sgrub byed pa/ /mi snang la sogs sna tshogs mchog dang dman 'grub cing / /bla ma'i drin gyis 'di na ma nor lam rtogs pa/ /byang chub rdo rje 'dra lta de la rtag phyag 'tshal/ /gang zhig rab gsal 'dus pa'i rgyud ni nyan pa dang / /'don par byed dang klog pa dang ni sems pa dang / /mchod pa'i byed pa dang ni 'bri 'am 'brir 'jug pa/ /byang chub rdo rje 'drar lta de la rtag —124—

phyag 'tshal/ /gang du zhi sogs las tshogs shin tu brtags pa yi/ /'khrul 'khor sngags kyi cho ga de bzhin rgyas 'debs pa'i/ /bsgrub bya 'di dang ldan pa'i sgrub pa'i dbang po ni/ /byang chub: /gang gis gtso bo sgrub pa pos mthar reg pa dang / /legs par dran dang ming tsam nges par thos pa dang / /dad par byed cing phyogs cig tsam zhig 'dzin pa dag /byang chub rdo rje 'drar lta de la rtag phyag 'tshal/ /zhes so/ /de dag gi mthar bzlas pa ci rigs pa bya zhing yi ge brgya pa lan bdun brjod/ sgrub thabs su bshad pa ltar 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma ni skabs 'dir nges par 'bul zhing de yang gtor ma byin gyis rlabs ma thag mdun bskyed kyi lha la phul bas chog gi gtor ma'i lha spyan 'dren pa mi dgos so/ /dgos kyi chos skyong la gtor ma 'bul na/ yang bar 'dir bya la de nas sgrub thabs su bshad pa'i cho gas phyogs skyong la nang gtor 'bul lo/ /de'i rjes su phyi rol gtor ma gtor te/ gtor ma lcog zlum tshad che zhing sha chang la sogs pa la zas sku bag can gyis sbags pa bden kha dog sna tshogs pa btsugs pa zhig dkyil 'khor khang pa'i phyi rol du stegs bu'i steng du bzhug chu gsum mam/ gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod dang nang mchod rdor dril rol cha sogs 'dus byas sgrub thabs bzhin gtor ma byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu nas ka ma la ya stuX/ mchod yon dang nyer spyod lngas mchod/ oṃ āXbadz+ra yudha sogs kyis so sor phul/ oṃ āX dus gsum skyes pa kun dang nas/bsrung ba mdzad du gsol gyi bar gyis spyi bto/ de nas ma rdzo pa rnams gtor snod du bsdus la/ ar+ghaX nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ ma'edi sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la nas/kun 'grub shog /yig brgya lan gsum brjod/ bdag ni rnam g.yeng nas/ bzod par gsol/ /oṃ a kā ro nas/ badz+ra muX zhes gtor ma rol mo'i sgra dang bcas gtsang sar —125—

dor/ mtsham rngam dang bcas bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags drag tu bzlas te bgegs bskrad do/ /slob dpon gyis rting mnan la 'ongs te nang du nye reg bya/ rdo rje shugs kyi 'jug pas zhugs te lha snam gyi steng nas bskor ba byas par mos la hū bzhi pa bzla zhing / bskor ba lan gsum byas te/shar sgo nas/ me tog sngon po phul la/ oṃ mchog tu bde ba'i sems ni rol par ldan/ /skye ba'i phyag gis bcom ldan 'das la 'dud/ /dza : ba ho hi hi hi/ mgon po snyim pa'i me tog bzhes su gsol ho yang nub sto thad du song ste/ pad skor las hū mdzad kyi phyag rgya bkrol bzhin pas/ skye rna badz+ra uta gha ṭa ya sa ma ya pra be sha ya hu/ zhes pas shar sgo phye bar bsam mo/ /de bzhin du sgo bzhi char phye nas/ sa ma ya pra be sha ya mi/zhes pas me tog phreng ba blangs te/ mgo la bcings/ oṃ pra ṇa ma mi sarba ta thā ga tā/ zhes phyag bya/ sems can thams cad la dngos grub kyi bka' drin bstsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ bar 'dir sbyin bsreg gi cho gas lha mnyes par bya'o/ /bzhi pa dbang bskur ba'i bya ba la/ sta gon dang dngos gzhi gnyis las/ dang po la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis so/ /dang po la/ bsam pa 'chos shing bu ru bya/ /gsol btab mos pa bskyed pa dang / /thun mong sdom bzung byin rlabs dang / /mchod dang so shing dor ba dang / khyor chu ku sha bsrung skud byin/ /spro ba bskyed cing rmi lam brtag /ces pa ltar bcu gsum las/ dang po ni/rang gi bslab ldan 'khor bzhi po/ /theg chen la dga'i bdag nyid can/ / kun de dag la dkyil 'khore gyi/ /cho ga yang dag rjes su gnang / kha cig gsang sngags grub don gnyer/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni 'jug par byed/ /bsod nams 'dod pas de las gzhan/ /gzhan ni 'jig rten gzhan don gnyer/ /slar yang dad pa ldan pa dag /'jig rten pha rol don gnyer bas/ /blo ldan —126—

dkyil 'khor 'jug bya yi/ /tshe 'di'i 'bras bu 'don mi bya/ /tshe 'di 'dod par gyur pa la/ /'jig rten pha rol 'byung mi 'gyur/ /'jig rten pha rol don gnyer skyes/ /'jig rten 'di yi 'bras bu rgyas/ /zhes brjod la don sems su bcugaganyis pa ni/ slob ma rnams me'i dkyil 'khor 'bar ba la gnas shing snying khar yang ra yig las byung ba'i me'i dkyil 'khor de gnyis kar 'bar ba las sdig sgrib dang tha mal gyi phung po lhan cig tu bsregs te rnam shes o u hā gsum du gnas par gyur/ de nyid slob dpon gyi thugs kha'i hū gi 'od kyis bkug zhal du zhugs sku'i dbyibs rgyud rdo rje'i lam nas/ yum gyi mkhar babs pa 'od du zhu ba yongs su gyur pa las mi bskyod pa sngon po zhal gsum phyag drug par gyur/ slar yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs zhal du zhugs byang chub kyi sems su zhu ste rdo rje'i lam nas byung bas dbang bskur zhing mthar gnyis su med par thim/ hū zhes bya bas mkha' nang nas phyir spros te gral la rim pa bzhin du 'khor ba'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brda' sprad/gsum pa ni/ maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gse(la/ /lan gsum gsol ba btab/—127—

bzhi pa ni/ khyod ni tshul chen snod yin ste/ /bu tshur shog cig theg chen po'i/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga mchog khyod la yang dag bstan par bya//sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /dus gsum 'byung ba'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje sngags kyi mthu yis ni/ /ye shes mnyam med yang dag bsnyes/ /gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med pa/ /gang gis shākya seng ge sogs/ /mchog rnams kyis ni bdud kyi sde/ /mi bzad chen po stobs chen bcom/ /'jig rten rjes 'jug rtogs nas ni/ /'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /ces brjod la don shad do//lnga pa ni/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung / /zhes lan gsum mo/ /drug pa ni/ las thams cad pa bzlas pas slob ma la bsrung zhing /rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lag pa g.yas kyis slob ma'i snying ga la sogs pa gnas gsum du dri bzang gi chus thig le byed cing snyu gsum brjod pas/ snying khar rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hu sngon po/ mgrin par pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar ud mar po/ dpral bar 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar oṃ dkar po rnams bsam du bcug yang yas mar reg pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum spyan drangs te bstim la snyu gsum brjod/ yang mas yar reg pas slob ma'i sgo gsum dang rdo rje gsum dbyer med par gyur par mos so/ /—128—

bdun pa ni/ mchod pa rnams las thams cad pas bsangs/ tseX( āX huX gis byin gyis bsas/ me tog spyi bor spyin pa sogs dang / oṃ badz+ra pukhye āXhūX sogs kyi mthar/ dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su/ /'khor ba'i nyes pas ma gos par/ /mchod pa kun dang khyod ldan pas/ /dus rnams kun du bde bar mnos/ /zhes brjod/brgyad pa ni/ dri bzang gi maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi khru gang las mi chung bar byas la/ so shing hūX las byung bar mos te/ las thams cad pa bzla bzhin du slob ma'i lag tu gtad slob mas kyang rtse mo nas 'cha' ba'i tshul byas te maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du ltos med du dor/ phyogs bzhir las bzhi dang /mtshams bzhir gter kyi bum pa sogs dang steng du rig 'dzin 'og tu sa 'og sogs 'grub pa dang phyi rol du lhung na grub pa med par bstan to/ /dgu pa ni/ dung chos kyi chu la las thams cad pa lan bdun bzla/ de nas tsho( hiXbi shudha dharma sarba pā paX niñca a phya sgo / dh+wa ya/ sarba bi kalpa na a pa na ya hūX/ zhes khyor ba bkang te mthung du bcugabacu pa ni/ ku sha bsangs sbyangs/ huX dang dhīXlas byung ba'i ku sha che ba gtan dang chung ba sngas kyi don du/ hūX hūX/ zhes sbyin/stso gcig pa ni/ slob ma'i lus tshad dang mnyam pa'i srad bu dmar po gsum bltab du sgril la rdo rje'i mdud pa gsum btang/ de bsangs sbyangs/ hūX las byung ba'i rdo rje'i srad bu slob ma'i bar chad thams cad bsrung ba'i mthu can du gyur/ las thams cad pa lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ de kho na bzla bzhin du 'chang ste/skyes pa la dpung pa g.yon dang bud med la g.yas dang byis pa la mgul du bcing ngo /—129—
