stso gnyis pa ni/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /u dum wa ra'i me tog bzhin/ /rgya lam nang ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo / /gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba/ /de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste/ /gang gis sems can mnyam med don/ /bla med byed par nus pa yin/ /bskal pa byed par du mar ni/ /sngon du sdig pa byas pa gang / /dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra mthong ma thag /de dag zad par 'gyur yin na/ /grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i//tshul la gnas na smon ci dgos/ /skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas na ni/ /go 'phang bla na med par 'gyur/ /gang gis spyod pa mchog 'di la/ /blo gros shin tu mi g.yo na/ /sdug bsngal thams cad 'gyung ba yi/ /ngan 'gro de yis yang dag bcad/ /bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis/ /rnyed pa mnyam med de ring rnyed//gang phyir rgyal ba sras dang bcas/ /bdag nyid chen po rnams kyi ni/ /bstan pa 'di la khyed cag kun/ /yongs su bzung ste skye bzhin pa/ /de phyir khyod rnams theg chen du/ /sang ni rab tu skye bar 'gyur/ /theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i/ /lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan/ khyed rnams der ni dong bas na/ /rang byung skal ba chen po pa/ /'jig rten thams cad mkhyen pa yi/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du 'gyur/ /zhes brjod la don spyod do/ /bcu gsum pa ni/ khyed rnams do nub dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa'i gnas khang gzhan du yang rung ste ku sha chung ba sngas su bcug che ba stan du bting dug gsum gyi rnam par rtog pa thams cad spangs nas lha dang bla ma rjes su dran bzhin pas seng ge'i nyal stangs kyis nyol zhig des dge ba dang mi dge ba'i rmi lam gyi —130—

khyad par rnams mthong bar 'gyur bas/ rmi lam ci byung ba thams cad nang par nga la smra dgos so/ /kyai bu dag nyon zhig do nub ni/ /seng ge'i nyal stabs bzhin du nyol/ khyod kyi rmi lam dge mi dge /mthong ba tho rengs bdag la smros//zhes brjod la/ las thams cad pa bzlas pa'i gsang chus gtor zhing bsrung ba bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ maṇ+ḍal phul la/ 'khor lo phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang / /dam pa bdag la bstsal nas kyang / /mgon po 'khor lo lha dag gi /de nyid slob dpon 'phrin las dang / /sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dang / /sdom pa gsang mchog bshad du gsol/ /sems can kun gyi don bgyid phyir/ /bdag ni rtag tu slob dpon 'gyur/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba bto/ gsang ba chen po rigs dag pa'i//gsang ba yongs su 'dzin par ni/ /bdag nyid chen po khyod 'dod dam/ /wo slob dpon gyis dris pa la/ gsang ba nas bdag nyid chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /zhes lan btab/ de nas sdom pa bsgrags pa ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song / /'di ni sangs rgyas rigs dag pa'i/ /sdom pa brtan por gyur pa'o/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya ni/ /blo chen khyod kyis bzung bar bya/ /byang chub sems gang de rdo rje/ khres rab dril bu zhes sgrags so/ /slob dpon khyod kyis bzung bya ste/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /'di ni rdo rje'i rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig sdom pa yin par gsungs/ /nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /zang zing mi 'jigs chos dang byams/ /spyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /'di ni rin chen rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig sdom par rtag tu bshad/ /phyi nang theg pa gsang ba gsum/ /dam chos khyod kyis bzung bar bya//—131—

'di ni pad+ma'i rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig sdom pa yin par gsungs/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bya/ /de nas sdom pa bzung ba ni/sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de ltar bdag ni bgyid par 'tshal/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba ni/ /dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni bsdud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /so sor brtan por bzung bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i/ /sdom pa deng nas brtan por bzung / /rdo rje'i rigs mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang / /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin yang dus drug tu/ /spyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu spyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la/ /phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni ma lus bzung / /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan pa ni/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni bla med mchog /dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyid nas/ /—132—

sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral/ /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol/ /dbugs ma phyung ba dbugs dbyung zhing / /sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ /ces lan gsum mo/ /gnyis pa dbang dngos gzhi la/ bdag 'jug dang slob ma dbang bskur gnyis las bdag 'jug la/ dkyil 'bor du 'jug pa dang / zhugs nas dbang bskur ba'o/ /dang po ni/ maṇ+ḍal sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas/ dga' chen khyod bdag sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bo dhi a laṅka ra wā dra pū dza me gha sa mu tra spa ra ṇa sa ma ya āXhuX gis smad g.yogs dang / oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa haX gis stod g.yogs dang / oṃ badz+ra spru zhi ṣa hūX gis gtsug tor bcing ngo / /oX tsak+ṣu ban+ta wa ra mā na ya huX gis mig dar bcing / las bum gyi chus gtor la/oX āXrdo tā krita huX huX/ rang skad cig gis rnam snang dkar po dpral bar oX/mgrin par āX thugs kar huX/ 'khru gsum gyi 'od kyis lus gsal zhing dag par byas/kyai khyod su yin ci la dga'/ zhes dris pa la/ skal bzang bdag bde ba chen po la'o/ /zhes lan gdab/ ā khaX ldi ra huX gis me tog gi phreng ba gtad/ snying khar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i steng na/ don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje rtse lnga pa dkar po gyen du langs pa/ oX sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+ta da ya mi/ me tog dang bcas pa'i rdo rje snying khar gtugs la/ oṃ su ra te sa ma ya stuX ho sirnyi badz+ra ya thā su khaX/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyi rlobs par 'gyur gyis khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams —133—

la smra bar mi bya ste/ ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no/ /zhes gsang bar gdams so/ /de nas skye( āXya mun+ta krita huX/ skye( āXprarnyornya krita hūX/ tseX( āXpad+ma ta spo ta hūX/oX āXzhe ta krita hūX/ zhes sgo ba bzhi'i snying po dang / ā khaX wi ra hūX dang / na maXs man+ta gu ya waka tsit+ta badz+ra ṇi/ oṃ ṭak+ki huX dzaXzhes pa dang / hūX bzhi pa'i sngags rnams brjod/dam bzhag rnam pa bzhi ni/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyi/ ngas khyod la rdo rje ye shes bskyed par bya yi ye shes gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na dngos grub gzhan rnams lta smos kyang ci dgos/ khyed kyis dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams la ma smra zhig dam tshig nyams par 'gyu/ra ta re/ zhes dbang gi ye shes gsang bar gdams pa'i sgo nas dang / rdo rje snying khar gtugs la/ oX rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi/ /snying la yang dag zhugs par gyur/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ /bdud rtsi 'bru gsum gyis lte thog tu bzhag /'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na bsreg par byed//dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ster/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'thung zhig /oX badz+ra ud ga ṭhaXṭhaXṭhaX rdo rje spyi bor gsas la/ deng phyin chad bu khyod kyi phyag na rdo rje nga yin gyi ngas 'di byos zhes bsgo ba gang yin pa de bya dgos so khyod kyi nga la brnyas par ma byed cig byas na khyod mi bde ba ma spangs par dus byas nas dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ta re/ de nas thal mo sbyar te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs la/ rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la 'bab par gyur cig lan gsum/ skad cig gi rang nyid 'od dpag med dmar po zhal gsum —134—

phyag drug par gsal ba'i snying khar la las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi pa la grwa bzhir rdo rje dang dbus su thugs rdo rje'i ngo bo hu nag po mtshan pa/mgrin par ba las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po la bum pas mtshan pa'i dbus su gsung rdo rje'i ngo bo ud mar pos mtshan pa/ spyi bor ya las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zla gam rgyal mtshan gyis mtshan pa'i dbus su sku rdo rje'i ngo bo ha dkar pos mtshan pa/ rkang pa gnyis kyi 'og tu ya las rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po gzhu'i dbyibs can ba dan gyis mtshan pa'i steng du ra las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum me 'bar bas mtshan pa/ long bu gnyis su rdo rje gsum bskul bar byed pa'i sa bon sna dmar po me'i rang bzhin can/ de nas slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer phyung / rlung g.yos me spar dzhaiyig bskul de las 'phros pa'i me'i 'od rkang pa'i bu ga nas zhugs pas lus gang / snying kha'i sa bsregs mgrin pa'i chu bskol/ spyi bo'i rlung gis mnan pas chu'i dkyil 'khor las babs pa'i bdud rtsi sa la thim pas/ bde drod 'bar te lus sems mchog tu tshim pa thob hu ā he'i 'od kyis lus thams cad gang /dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dpal ldan 'dus pa'i lha tshogs kyi rnam par spyan drangs te rang gi lus la thim par gyur/ oṃ u be sha ya sta bha ya/ ra ra ra ra/ tsā la ya/ hu ā ha dzhai zhes drag tu bzlas mthar/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ lan gnyis kyi spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag tra las byung ba'i rin po che'i me tog pra titsā badz+ra ho pra ti grit+na stu/i ma satwa mahā ba la/ me tog spyi bor byin/ mig gnyis su 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i —135—

oṃ/ oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad//phye bas thams cad mthong 'gyur ba/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /ces mig dar bkrol/ he badz+ra pa khyo/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor mngon sum du mthong bar gyur/ oX rdo rje'i dkyil ge rgor wo po yi/ /dkyil 'bor du ni bdag zhugs so/ /oṃ rnal 'byor dkyil 'khor chen po yi/ /dkyil 'khor de ring bdag gis mthong / /oX gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po yi/ /dkyil 'khor du ni bdag dbang bskur/ /sa ma ya ho ho hoXganyis pa zhugs nas dbang bskur ba la/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i dbang gnyis las/ dang po ni/ maṇ+ḍal phul te/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang rab tu bsgral ba'i phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rjes deng bdag stsole// /zhes lan gsum/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags kyi gsang ngo / /de nas dbang dngos la/ chu dbang ni/ bdag dang dbang rdzas bum pa'i chu gnyis ka mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ oX spyo bhā wa sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las huX rdo rje hūX gis mtshan pa las/ gnyis ka'ang mi bskyod pa nag po nag dkar dmar ba nas/ pad+ma 'dzin pa rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ dbang rdzas la mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ bdag dang dbang rdzas gnyis ka'i spyi bor oṃ/mgrin par āX thugs kar huX/ thugs ka'i hūX gi 'od zer gyis rang 'dra'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaX dzaXhuX baX hoX gnyis ka la gnyis su med par thim/ mi bskyod pa yab yum zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chur gyur/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas sogs/ lan gcig dbang bskur ba po'i lha rnams kyis/ dbang —136—

bskur rdo rje nas hūX zhes gsung bzhin dbang bskur lus thams cad gang bde ba chen po myong dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ oX badz+ra purdze āXhūX sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod/ de ltar na dbang lnga la chu'i dbang thob/ zhe sdang dag rnam par shes pa'i phung po gnas gyur me long lta bu'i ye shes rgyud la skyes mi bskyod pa'i go 'phang mngon du byas so/ /spyo brjod/ cod pan gyi dbang ni/ bdag dang dbang rdzas dbu rgyan gnyis ka mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ oX swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ aX las rin po che aX gis mtshan pa las/ gnyis ka'ang rin chen 'byung ldan ser po nas/ 'dzin pa/ dbang rdzas la rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu rgyan can/ spyi bor oX nas/ thugs kha'i hūX gi 'od zer gyis rang 'dra'i ye shes pa spyan drangs te/ gnyis ka la gnyis su med par thim/ rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum zhu ba las byung ba'i dbu rgyan du gyur/byang chub rdo rje sogs/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rgyal srid tshe/ /dbu rgyan rin chen dam pa ste/ /rin chen kun gyi mchog 'gro bas/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas su dbang bskur ro/ /oX sarba ta thā ga ta rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣañca hūX/ zhes dbu rgyan mgo la bkon/ oX badz+ra tu rtsi ho/ zhes dar dpyangs bcings/ oX sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī huX/ zhes gsungs zhing / nas rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu rgyan/ gong bzhin mchod/dbang lnga pas cod paṇa gyi dbang nga rgyal dang ser sna/ tshor ba'i/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi/ rdo rje'i dbang ni/ de nyid dang 'dra ba las/ dbang rdzas rdo rje dzi las pad+ma dzi gis mtshan pa las/ gnyis ka'ang 'od dpag med dmar po nas 'od dpag med kyi dbu rgyan can/ 'od dpag med yab yum rdo —137—

rjer gyur/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang / /de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// sangs rgyas kun tu rab sgrub phyir/ /rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyi long / /lkoX sarba nas/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ rdo rje'i dbang /'dod chags/ 'du shes kyi/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ 'od dpag med kyi/dril bu'i dbang ni/ dbang rdzas dril bu/ khaX las ral gri khaX gi rme mtshan pa las/gnyis ka'ang don yod grub pa ljang khu/ nas/ don yod grub pa'i dbu rgyan can/don yod grub pa yab yum/ dril bur/ oX badz+ra a dhi pa ti stuX/ a bhi khri3 huX/tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sma ma ya stuX/ don yod grub pas dbu rgyan/ dril bu'i dbang / phrag dog dag 'du byed kyi/ bya ba grub pa'i don yod grub pa'i/ ming gi dbang ni/ dbang rdzas/ me tog phreng ba'am/ rdo rjer bcas pa'i dril bu/ bhāX las 'khor lo bhāX gyis mtshan pa las/ gnyis ka'ang rnam par snang mdzad dkor po nas rnam mdzade kyi dbu rgyan can/ rnam par snang mdzad yab yum/ me tog phreng bar gyur zhes sam/rdo rje dang bcas pa'i rdo rje dril bur gyur zhes brjod/ oX badz+ra a dhi pa ti stuX a ghi khiñca maX/ badz+ra nā maX.a bhi ṣe ka ta/ kyi dpal nai mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /zhes ming dbang bskur zhing / rnam snang gis dbu rgyan/ming gi dbang / gti mug dag gzugs kyi chos dbyings ye shes rnam par snang mdzad kyi zhes 'don pa sprosno/ /rang la dngos kun gang snang ba/ /de ni gtso chen 'jam dbyangs rgyal/ /gang de'i sangs rgyas ye shes nyid/ /chos kun rang bzhin gyis dag pa'o/ /zhes brjod cing / don rgyas par bshad do/ /—138—

brtul zhugs kyi dbang ni/ 'dir dam tshig gsum sbyin pa la byed do/ / dbang rdzas rdo rje bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hū las rdo rje hu gis mtshan pa las/ rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po zhal gsum phyag drug par gyur/ de zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rje/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad de/ /rdo rje sems dpa' phyag na gnas/khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcing / /phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /lan gsum gsor nas snying khar gtod/ lko sarba ta thā ga ta sirnyi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa stu dha ra ya mi badz+ra satwa hi hi hi hi hū/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems ma'i bdag po'i bdag /bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skye bu'o/ /dril bu bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las ā las dril bu zhwas mtshan pa las kun tu bzang mo dkar mo zhal gsum phyag drug par gyur/ de zhu ba las dril bu/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcad/ /byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed/ /phyogs brgyad du dkrol/ a srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' mchog /srid pa dam pa byed par 'gyur/ /skad cig gis rang nyid kun tu bzang po rdo rje 'chang chen po dkar po nas/ rin po ches spras par gyur/ gzugs sogs 'dod pa'i dam tshig gi /gsang sngags ma tshang med par bzlos/ /rang gi rigs pa'i ngo bo de/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum khyab gyur pa/ /rang gi lha'i sbyor ba yis/ /bdag dang gzhan la mchod par bya/ /mi bzang dkar thub sdom pa ni/ /rten kyang mi snang mngon shes dang / /mkha' —139—

spyod sku gsung thugs rnams las/ /byung ba'i dngos grub 'grub mi 'gyur/ de bas sangs rgyas sems dpa' mchog /sngags kyi spyod mchog spyod pa rnams/ /'dod pa thams cad bsten pa yis/ /'gyur med mchog gi chos brnyes so/ /sdug bsngal ma yin bdag bde bas/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga rnams brten/ /gang gzhan dman par bshad pa rnams/ /sngags kyi bzlas pas 'gru/ba 'gyur zhing / /ye shes don gnyer chags can gyi/ /sbyor bas sku gsung thugs rnams ni/ /bsgoms na myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /thun mong ma yin pa'i dbang gi thog ma rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang la dngos dang / mtha' brten gnyis las/ dang po ni/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ byang chub rdo rje sogs kyis gsol ba btab/stong pa'i ngang las dbang stegs kyi steng du/ rang sems hu dkar po las rdo rje hū gis mtshan pa/ de las kun tu bzang po rdo rje 'chang chen po sku mdog dkar po dkar nag dmar pa'i zhal gsum phyag drug nas/ rin po ches brgyan pa yid ngag lus gsum rnam par dag pa thugs gsung sku rdo rje gsum gcig tu 'dus pa ni snying rje chen po dang stong pa nyid dang / phyag rgya chen po'i mtshan nyid can te byang chub kyi sems so/ /mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i ma las 'od zer 'phros zhes pa nas/ shrī hū/ yan chad sgrub thabs bzhin te chu dbang dang / tse( badz+ra rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi khiñca hu/ zhes dbu rgyan dang / sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang/ /lko sogs kyis rdo rje dang / shes rab thabs dang ldan pa yis/ /'gro don mnyam med byed pa dang / /mchod pa'i las rnams rdzogs byed phyir/ /rdo rje las kyi dbang bskur ro/ /zhes dril bu dang / oṃ badz+ra a dhi sogs ming gi dbang bskur ro/ /slar yang brtan byed du/ dbang —140—

bskur rdo rje nas/ spyin par bya/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/lus thams cad gang / dri ma thams cad dag par gyur/ o phun sum tshogs pa sogs bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad gsum brjod/ ar+gha nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha thams cad kyang slob ma'i lus la gnyis su med par thim/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las dbang rtags rdo rje 'chang chen pos dbu brgyan cing / thugs kar rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' dang de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' yang grub par gyur/ brtan bzhugs ni/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+re swāhā/ zhes brjod cing me tog dor / de nas 'di skad ces/ de ring khyod ni dkyil 'khor gyi/ /slob dpon sngags dang rgyud 'dzin par/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / lha rnams kun gyis mthun par gsungs/ /sems can rnams la rjes brtse bas/ khyod kyi dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin/ /rab tu 'bad de bri bar bya/ /rgyud pa po rnams rgyud la sbyor/ /gnyis pa la/ rjes gnang dang / de nyid brjod pa gnyis so/ /dang po la/ mig thur gyi rjes gnang ni/ o badz+ra nai tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa la hri/ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis//'jig rten rab rib bsal ba ltar/ /bu khyod kyi ni mi shes pa'i/ /rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal/ /me long dang po ni/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /bzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las yang dag byung / /ngo bo nyid med gnas med par/ /de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /'on kyang skyob pa'i sras su skye/ /dril bu'i rjes gnang ni/ dril bu 'khrol bzhin pas/ thams cad nam mkha'i —141—

ma mo ni nyid de/ /nam mkha' la yang mtshan nyid med/ /nam mkha' dang ni mnyam sbyor bas/ /kun mchog mnyam pa nyid du gsal/ /mda' gzhu'i rjes gnang ni/ yi ge ho las byung ba'i mda' gzhur gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang rjes su chags par bya'o/ /zhes so/ /de nas me long gnyis pa ni/ a las byung ba'i me long /o badz+ra satwa a/ rdo rje sems dpa' me long ltar/ /dag cing gsal la dri ma med/ /sangs rgyas kun bdag rang bzhin ni/ /bu khyod kyi ni snying la zhugs/ /gang 'di de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po byang chub kyi sems yin par shes par gyis shig chos spyod kyi rjes gnang ni/ oṃ badz+ra he tu ma/ o badz+ra bha ṣa ra/ o badz+ra lha rnye a/ ā deng nas brtsams te sems bskyed pa/ /brtsams te chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /de ring phan chad 'jig rten la/ /skyob pa rnams kyi 'khor lo bskor/ khyod kyis the tshom dogs med par/ /yid gnyis med pa'i sems kyis su/ /chos kyi dung ni bla med pa/ /kun tu ma lus gang bar gyis/ /sngags spyod tshul gyi cho ga yis/ /skye bo rnams la rtag tu shod/ /de ltar byas na sangs rgyas la/ /phan 'dogs drin du gzo zhes bya/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa de kun yang / khyod la rtag tu bsrung bar mdzad/ /rigs lnga'i sprul bshad kyi rjes gnang ni/'jig rten khams ni thams cad du/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur pa'i/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /de bzhi du/rdo rje'i ge bor lo/ rin kho 'bor lo/ pad+ma'i lubor lo/ sna tshogs 'bor lo rab tu bskor/ bdag 'jug dang slob ma dbang bskur gyi skabs gang yin yang rung ste shin tu sdus pa la dga' bas mig thur nas de yan chad bzhag kyang rung zhing rjes snang 'di dag dbang bzhi —142—

pa'i mthar sbyar na'ang legs pa yin no/ /sems can gyi don gyi rjes gnang ni/ ngo bo nyid kyis sems can gang / /ji ltar ji ltar 'dul gyur pa/ de lta de ltar sems can don/ /chags sogs dag pas sgrub par gyis/ /zhes so/ /bsgoms shing dngos grub bsgrub pa'i rjes gnang ni/ nyin re bzhin yang dus gsum du/ /ting 'dzin gsum gyi rnal 'byor dang / /ldan pas thun mong cig shos kyi/ /dngos grub thams cad bsgrub par bya/ /mi snang bar ni stong cig dang / /mngon shes ldan pas stong gnyis dang / /rig pa 'dzin pas stong gsum dang / /rdo rje can gyis 'gro kun bdag /gzhan yang zhi dang rgyas la sogs/ /gang la ci 'dod las rnams ni//'khor lo rjes gnyis sbyor ba yis/ /sgrubs na myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /lko so/ /gnyis pa ni/ gzhal yas khang ni byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun rnam par dag pa yin la/ lha rnams ni phung po dang khams dbang po yul dang bcas pa dang lta ba bzhi rnam par dag pa/ ye shes lnga dang tshad med bzhi dang pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang dad sogs bzhi'i ngo bo yin la/ de bzhin du dbang bskur ba dang dngos grub kyi don du dkyil 'khor bri ba dang sgrub pa dang rab tu gnas pa dang spyin sreg dang dbang bskur dang zhi ba la sogs pa'i las rnams ni slob dpon gyi bya ba'o/ /de ltar na lus te gzugs brnyan can gyi dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang bskur ba thob/ lam bskyed pa'i rim pa sgom pa la dbang / lus kyi dri ma mtha' dag sbyangs/ 'bras bu sku rdo rje sprul pa'i sku mngon du khyur ro/ /—143—

dbang gong ma spyi khyab gyi don du maṇ+ḍal phul la/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo rnam spyod pa/ /de ring bshad pa'i rin wo gyis/ /gtso bos bdag la bka' drin stsol/ khyod zhabs mkhro spangs nas ni/ /gtso bo gzhan la skyabs ma mchis/ /'gro ba'i dpa' bo thub chen gyis/ /blo mchog bdag la gnang bar mdzodi/ /sdug bsngal kun gyi gnas gyur pa/ /dmyal ba nas ni gtso bos drongs/ /sdug bsngal thams cad thar mdzad pa'i/ /mgon med bdag la thugs brtser mdzod/ /ces lan gsum gsol ba btab/gsang dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ de nas dam tshig sgrags pa ni/ ji ltar dbang bskur tshul las ni/ /sangs rgyas la sogs kun thob pa/ /de ltar byang chub spyod pa sogs/ /dge ba'i tshul gsung gzhan gyis min/ /de bas bu khyod dam tshig dang / /sdom pa rtag tu skyong bar byos/ kha lnga bdud rtsi lnga bza' zhing / /de las gzhan yang dam tshig bsrung / /dkon mchog gnod byed gzhom bya ste/ /bud med kun la spyad par bya/ /rnal 'byor rgyud las gang bshad pa/ /de yang cho ga bzhin du bsrung / /zhes pa la/ de bzhin du bgyi'o zhes lan bto/ rdo rje sems khyod sangs rgyas kun gyi bde ba rab tu sgrub pa ste/ /rnam dag byang chub sems dpa' rgya chen sras su gyur pa rnams/ /yun ring stong pa nyid sgoms pas ni rab tu gdungs pa la/ /dga' ba yid 'ong bde ba chen po nyid kyis mnyes par mdzod/ /'dod chags de ni dri med kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa ste/ /dag pa'i rdo rje 'dod chags dam tshig las ni phye mdzad nas/ /dka' ba rnam pa drug po spyod pas shin tu gdungs pa rnams/ /rab tu dges dbang 'dod pa'i bde pa nyid la 'jog par —144—

mjodi/ /pad+ma'i dbus nas rin chen 'bar ba rab phyung nas/ /ma lus rgyal ba rnams kyi dbu ni skams pa la/ /rnam dag rdo rje las ni byung pa'i ye shes chu/ /dri ma med pa rin chen spyir dbab dbang bskur gsol/ /mnyam dang mi mnyam 'dod chags tshul dag pas/ /pad+ma'i gnas su rdo rje'i mdzod gtong ba/ /sna tshogs sems dpa' sems can brlag gyur pa/ /spyor ba gzhan min ma thogs bshad du gsol/ /rdo rje sems dpa' khyod ni dbang mchog bgyid mdzad cing //rdo rje pad+ma phye ba'i tshul du sbyor mdzad la/ /rgyal ba kun gyi gzugs kyi sku ni rab ston ste/ /bde ba thams cad sgrub pa nyid kyis mnyes mdzad gsol/ /zhes lan gsum bya/ gong bzhin mig dar bcings/ me tog bzung / o shā n+ya tā sogs/ rig ma stong pa'i ngang las ma las ral gri ma gyis mtshan pa las/ yum 'jam pa'i rdo rje ma nas/ rdzogs par gyur/ mig tu k+ṣ-i nas/ sa sngon po/ snying khar hu nag po/ mgrin par ā dmar po/ spyi bor o dkar po/ yab kyi gsang gnas mi dmigs te nas mchod par gyur/ dga' ba'i sgras sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' khro bo'i dbang po sras dang btsun mor bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs gtso bo'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar byang chub kyi sems dang ro gcig tu gyur pa sku'i dbyibs rgyud nor bu'i rtse mor lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes brtan par byas nas mthar mtheb srin gyis phyung la bum pa'i dung chos sam pad+ma'i snod du bzhag la/ oṃ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas/ /kun gyi bdag nyid rigs kun gyi ni bdag po mchog /sems can ma lus bde bskyed bde ba chen po ste/ /de yis deng khyod dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog /ces sogs bkra —145—

shis gyi glu dang gong du bstan pa'i/ pad+ma'i dbus gnas rin chen zhes pa nas/ spyir dbab dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ ā hu zhes lce thog tu bzhag myangs la a ho mahā su kha zhes brjod/ de nas 'bru gsum gyis mig dar bkrol la/ de ltar na/ kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba thob/ lam thig le gsum gyi rnal 'byor snang bcas rgyu lus dang bcas pa sgom pa la dbang / ngag gi dri ma 'bras bu gsung rdo rje lodas spyod rdzogs pa'i sku zhes 'don pa spo/shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal la phul/ dam tshig bsgrags pa ni/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /rang rgyal nyan thos de bzhin te/ /sku gsung thugs su sbyor ba na/ /phyag 'tshal na ni ma rung 'gyur/ /kun tu rdo rje sems dpa' yis/ /lus ngag yid kyi dkyil 'khor la/ /bsam gtan rdo rje gsum sbyor bas/ /sngags bzlas pas ni bsam gtan bya/ /mdor na sems can khams rnams ni/ /bsam gtan rdo rjes bskur bar bya/ /rdo rje gsum gyi phyag 'tshal mchog /dam tshig rdo rje las byung ba'o/ /mchod rten dag gi las mi bya/ /glegs bam bklag par mi bya zhing / /dkyil 'khor dag kyang yod mi bya/ /rdo rje gsum mchog phyag mi bya'o/ /rdo rje'i thig ni gdab pa dang / /tshon rtsi dag ni dgye ba nyid/ /sngags kyi sems dpa' mi bya ste/ /byas na byang chub brnyes par dka'/ /gal te byang chub mchog 'dod na/ /lag pa'i phyag rgya mi bcing ngo //sngags rnams kun gyi dam tshig ni/ /rgyal ba kun kyang mi 'da' 'o/ /zhes dam tshig bsgrags pa la/ de ltar bgyi'o/ /zhes khas blangs/ mchog spyin rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud/ /yang dag mthar gyur khyod la 'dud/ /stong nyid las byung khyod la —146—

'dud/ /sangs rgyas byang chub phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes che/ /thams cad stong pa bla na med/ /mngon par byang chub mthong bar ni/ /slob dpon chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /las dang skye las rnam grol ba'i/ /tshe 'dir byang chub mchog thob pa/ /rang myong mtshan nyid gcig pa nyid/ /sems dpa' chen po sne tshe sdo nil du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ gong bzhin mig dar bcings/de nas mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyag rgya gtad/ bzung ma yid 'ong 'di khyod kyis/ /brten byar sangs rgyas rnams kyis brtags/ /'khor lo'i rim pa sbyor ba yis/ /bde ba dam pa myang bar gyis/ /rdo rje skyil krung kyis sems ni/ /nor bu'i nang du son lta bas/ /zhes brjod/ dri ba dri lan ched brjod kyang spyi dang mthun par byas kyang legs mod/ lag len bsdus pa'i skabs 'drir med kyang rung ngo / /bhañca mo k+ṣa ho/zhes pang du byon/ rang dang rig ma gnyis ka mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las gnyis ka'ang maX las ral gri maX gyis mtshan par gyur/ de'i 'od kyi 'phro 'du las/ rang nyid dpal ldan nas ldan par gyur/ rig ma 'jam pa'i rdo rje ma nas/ rdzogs par gyur/ oX dharma nas/ rigs bdag gis rgyas btab pa'i bar bsnyen sgrub bar ma'i skabs bzhin rdzogs par brjod/ khyad par bum pa'i chus dngos su dbang bskur/ yum gyi spyi gtsug zhes pa nas phaṭa kyis bkag par gyur gyis bar yang sgrub thabs bzhin/ de nas yab yum phan tshun du blta zhing rjes su chags pa yang dag par bskyed/ sī ta shi shi shi ha ha ha/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ zhes nga rgyal bzung / de'i tshe slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od kyis bkug pa phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad byang chub kyi sems —147—

su zhu ba bdag nyid rig mar bcas pa'i phyag rgya bzhi la dbang bskur tshul gyis thim par gyur/ rmongs la gti mug bdag nyid sbyor/ /gti mug dga' ma yang dag ldan/ /gti mug rgyun gyis dbang bskur na/ /gti mug rdo rje rang nyid 'gyu/ra/ /de bzhin du sbyar te/ sdang la zhe sdang / zhe sdang dga' ma/ zhe sdang rgyun/ zhe sdang rdo rje/ chags la 'dod chags/ 'dod chags dga' ma/ 'dod chags rgyun/'dod chags rdo rje/ shes rab ye shes bdag nyid/ rdo rje dga'/ ye shes rgyun/shes rab ye shes bdag nyid 'gyur/ dga' bzhi dang ye shes gsum gsal zhing brtan par gyur/ mig dar bkrol/ de ltar na/ phyag rgya bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba/ lam dbang gi ye shes dang 'od gsal bsgom pa/ yid kyi dri ma 'bras bu thugs rdo rje chos sku zhes 'don pa spo/de nas tshig dbang bzhi pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul la/ sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi mchog /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gsang / /bla na med pa'i byang chub sems/ /bcom ldan snying po bshad du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum/ rdo rje 'a myong ba chen po yi/ /sku ni blta bas mi ngoms shing / /zhal gsum phyag drug ltar snang ba/ /rnam kun mchog ldan rig mas 'byud/ khres rab ye shes dbang dus su'ang / /mtshan nyid dpe yi tshul du gnas/ /dngos po thams cad dang bral ba//phung po khams dang skye mched dang / /gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam spangs pa/ /chos bdag med pa mnyam nyid pas/ /rang sems gdong nas ma skyes pa/ /stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin no/ /lko sku dang ye shes zung du 'jug pa yin la/ 'bras bu'i mthar thug de nyid chos thams cad kyi de kho na nyid kyang yin zhing / de nyid zab gsal —148—

gnyis su med pa dang yan lag bdun dang ro myang brgyad kyi bdag nyid do/ khyod kyis srog chags bsad par bya/ /rdzun gyi tshig kyang smra bar bya/ khyod kyis ma byin par yang long / /gzhan gyi bud med bsten par gyis/ /de ltar na/ don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du/ bzhi pa'i dbang / lam zung 'jug bsgom pa sgo gsum gyi dri ma 'bras bu sku gsung thugs mi phyed pa ngo bo nyid sku zhes 'don pa spo/ dbang dngos gzhi rnams bstan zin to/ /mtha' rten ni/ rig ma'i brtul zhugs dang / lung bstan dang / dbugs dbyung ngo / /dang po ni/ thabs gzhan gyis ni 'tshang mi rgya/ /de bas rig ma 'di ni mchog /gnyis su med pa'i chos rnams ni/ /gnyis kyi dngos po mtshon pa yin/ /de phyir khyod kyis rtag tu ni/ /'khor bar bral bar ma byed cig /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rig pa'i brtul zhugs bla na med/ /rmongs pa gang zhig 'da' byed pa//de la mchog gi dngos grub med/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'dir ni khyod la ngas lung bstan/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /srid pa shin tu dag pas na/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las ba|zhe/ /kyai dpal nas/ a gang zhig de ltar lung bstan pa'i/ /sngags pa 'gro ba kun gyi gtso/ /bla na med pa'i byang chub tu/ /bde gshegs rnams kyis lung bstan to/ /zhes brjod/gsum pa ni/ mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /zhugs pa dang ni mthong ba yis/ /sdig pa kun las rnam grol ste/ /de ring khyed rnams bde bar gnas/ /bde chen theg pa 'di la ni/ /phyin chad 'chi ba yod min te/ /mi thub —149—

tshugs pa yod min pas/ /cis kyang mi 'jigs dga' bar gyis/ /srid pa shin tu dag pas na/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal las khyod 'das/ /ston pa mchog tu khyod 'gyur ro/ /dngos grub dam tshig sdom pa 'di/ khyod kyis rtag tu bsrung bya ste/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis mthun par gsung / /mchog tu rtag pa'i bka' yin no/ /rdo rje zhes bya'i phyag rgya ni/ /gang zhig bskyed pa tsam gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas nyid du the tshom med/ /byang chub sems ni btang mi bya/ /dam pa'i chos la smad mi bya//nam yang dor bar mi bya'o/ /mi shes pa'i rmongs pa yis/ /de nyid rnam par bstan mi bya/ /rang gi bdag nyid yongs btang ste/ /dka' thub kyis kyang gdung mi bya/ /ji ltar bde bar bde bzung na/ /'di ni ma 'ongs rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya ni/ /nam yang dor bar mi bya'o/ /slob dpon smad par mi bya ste/ /'di ni sangs rgyus kun dang mnyam/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun mnyam pas/ /slob dpon la ni gang brnyas pa/ /de ni sangs rgyas kun brnyas pas/ /rtag tu sdug bsngal thob bar 'gyur/ /rims dang dug dang dbyig dug dang / /mkha' 'gro rnams kyis gtses pa dang / /bgegs dang log 'dren gtum po yis/ /bsad nas sems can dmyal bar 'gro/ /de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis/ /rdo rje slob dpon blo chen po/ /dge ba rab tu mi spyoms pa/ /nam yang smad par mi bya'o/ /bla ma la ni gus bcas yon/ /rjes mthun khyod kyis sbyin par bya/ /des ni rims sogs gnod pa rnams/ /phyir zhing 'gyung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu rang gi dam tshig bsrung / /rtag tu de bzhin gshegs pa mchod/ /rtag tu bla ma la dbul bya/ /'di ni sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /de phyin sangs —150—

rgyas thams cad la/ /rtag tu byin pa nyid du 'gyur/ /de byin bsod nams tshogs yin te/ /tshogs las dngos grub mchog tu 'gyur/ /gang phyir 'di la legs gnas pas/ /deng khyod skye ba 'bras bur bcas/ /dam tshig lha rnams dang mnyam par/ /'gyur ba 'di la them tshom med/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje can kun gyis/ /de ring tshe ldan dbang bskur te/ khams gsum gyi ni rgyal srid che/ /bdag po nyid du khyod nges so/ /de ring bdud las rnam rgyal te/ /grong khyer dam par rab tu zhugs/ /de ring khyod kyis sangs rgyas nyid/ /thob 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /de ltar yid ni rab dang rdo rje nyid du gyis/ /rang gi dam tshig mi bzad bde ster bsten par gyis/ / 'gro ba bde ba myur la rdo rje sems dpa' dang / /mtshungs pa'i rtag pa nyid du khyod rnams phyin par 'gyur/ /go brjod/gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de dag thams cad dbang gis bgyi/ /zhes lan gsum gyis khas blangs / maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ deng nas brtsams te sogs/ de nas nus na zhi rgyas kyi spyin bsreg gis kyang lha mnyes par byas la/ mthar dam tshig gsum gyi glu dang bden pa'i stobs brjod pa ni/ nam mkha' skye ba mtshan ldan phyir/ /thog ma mtha' ma med pa'i mchog /sems dpa' rdo rje che rang bzhin/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag grub mdzod/ /dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog /dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi rgyal/ /mi 'gyur mchog tu bdag grub mdzod/ /nyes pa mi mnga' rtag pa khyod/ /'dod chags kun gyi rjes su chags/ /bcom ldan chags chen dga' ba che/ /de nyid kyis ni bdag grub mdzod/ /shin tu rnam dag kun gyi mchog /gdod nas grol ba de bzhin gshegs/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag —151—

nyid/ /byang chub sems su bdag grub mdzod/ /dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog /dbang phyug chen po'i rgyal mchog gis/ /grub pa'i rdo rje cher bstod pa//rdo rje snyems bdag bdag grub mdzod/ /sems can kun gyi yid khyab pa/ /sems can kun gyi yid la gnas/ /sems can kun gyi yab gyur nyid/ dam tshig mchog gyur 'dod pa mchog /shes rab thabs bdag dkyil 'khor gyi/ /bden pa gang gi ye shes mchog /bden pa de yi mgon bdag la/ khyod kyis 'dod pa rab rdzogs mdzod/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las yang dag byung / /de bzhin de nyid nges par 'byung / /bden pa de yis dkyil 'khor ni/ /gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma rnams/ /kun gyis dri med mthong bar shog /ces so/ / de nas slob ma la dbang bskur ba ni dbang chog wo mo las rtogs par 'gyur zhing / gal te cho ga mdor bsdus su dbang bskur na/ ngag 'don rnams gong bdag 'jug gi skabs ltar dang lag len mthong ba rgyud pa las shes so/ /lnga pa rjes kyi cho ga ni mchod pa bshams pa'am kha gsos/ sgrub thabs ltar byin gyis brlabs ar+gha nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ de nyid lnga pas bstod/ nang mchod 'bul rang gi yid dang mthun par gsol ba btab/ yig brgya mang du bzlas/ ma 'byordo ra ba dang sogs lhag pa dang sogs/ bag med spyod pa sogs/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /o u hā mu mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa la/ sku'i rigs rnams sogs nas/ brtan par gyur —152—

gyi bar sgrub thabs bzhi/ gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor nam mkha'i rang bzhin du gyur/ o a kā ro mu kha sarba dharmā ṇa u du nu tu sno tad o ā hu phaṭa swāhā/ zhes dang por lha mtshan rnams bsdus/ de nas tshangs thig nas gtso bo'i gnas kyi bar rnams rdo rje'i rtse mos phyis/ mthar thams cad phyags la bum par blug te chu bor spyan drang ngo / /phur pa phyung zhing phur khung bgang / smon lam dang bkra shis bya'o/ /'dir smras pa/ rgyal ba'i lam bzang sngags kyi theg pa 'dir/ /dang por 'jug sgor bar du srog shing mthar/ /'bras bu 'grub byed dbang chog legs bshad pa'i/ /dge des 'gro kun rdo rje 'dzin par shog /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ye shes zhabs lugs cung zad bsdus pa ye shes snang byed 'di yang / rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// //ma ṅga la/

brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dngos grub 'khyu/nga gnas zhes bya ba bzhugs/lkoX spru sti/ chos kun rang bzhin gdod nas rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo nyid//dang po'i sangs rgyas bde ba chen po'i dga' ba lhan cig skyes/ /dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus kun gyi ye shes sgyu ma'i gzugs/ /nges pa don gyi bla ma mchog gi zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /rdo rje 'chang chen phyag na rdo rje in+d+ra bhā ti dang //klu yi rnal 'byor ma dang bi pu kalpa sa ra ha/ /klu sgrub yab sras bzha dang zla grags slob pa'i rdo rje dang / /nag po pa dres de wā ka ra mgos lo khug pa dang //mang ra sangs rgyal ye shes seng ge nyi seng nyi ma lcam/ /rngog ston 'phags lha thang spe ba dang gser ldengs gzhon nu 'od/ /chos sku 'od zer 'phags 'od bu ston rin chen rnam rgyal dang / /dpal mchog don grub tsan+d+ra shrī 'khrul zhig tshul rgyal ba/ /mkhyen rab mchog grub dkon mchog dpal bzang bkra shis rgyal mtshan dang / /dpal ldan chos bzang kun mkhyen sgrol mgon ye shes rgya mtsho'i zhabs/ /blo gros rnam rgyal ngag dbang 'phrin las kun bzang rgyal dbang dpal/ /tshe dbang nor bu 'phrin las shing rta bstan pa'i nyin mor byed/ /tshe dbang kun khyab karma rat+na 'od gsal 'gyur ba med/ /chos 'phel rgya mtsho ngag dbang chos 'dzin bstan 'dzin grags pa'i zhabs/ /thub bstan 'gyur med —154—

kun dga'i rig pa 'dzin pa'i mchog gi zhabs/ /rdo rje 'chang dngos rtsa brgyud bla ma dam pa thams cad la/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud dag par byin gyis rlobs/ /bsod nams 'di yis yang yang skye ba'i rim pa rnams su yang / /'gro ba'i don bsgrub don la 'jig pa med par dga' ba dang / /sku yi 'od zer nam mkha' khyab par 'phro pas dbang bskur ba/ /bde chen rol ba lhan cig de yi go 'phang thob par shog /ces dpal gsang bos mi bskyod rdo rje'i bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dngos grub 'byung gnas zhes bya ba rdzogs so/ /sman mchod skabs su/zag med ye shes bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ /o ā hu/zhes kha bsgyur bar bya'o// //

khrid yeg rgyud don gsal ba bzhugs/lkoX na mo gu ru maṇ+ḍal de bā khyuX bla ma rdo rje can zhabs mchog gi sku//sum cu rtsa gnyis dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i tshul/ /ye shes gcig nyid du ma'i skur ston pa/ /'dus pa'i lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal nas/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa klu sgrub kyi/ /man ngag rje btsun mchog rnams las/ /cung zad rnyed gang 'dir bri ste/ /byin rlabs mchog gis bka' drin stsol/ /'dir 'phags pa yab sras kyi zhal lung rnams/ mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i lo tsā ba chen po 'gos khug pa lhas btsas kyi man ngag ji lta ba bzhin du brjod par bya'o/ /de yang rje 'gos chen po dang / mkhas pa rngog yab sras sogs kyi skabs 'khrid tshul 'di la dam dog che bas/ dmigs pa rnams la la zhal shes/ la la shog gril gsum sogs yig chung / la la gtong thun dang rgyud bshad kyi khongs su 'thor thabs las khrid yig ma mdzad/ phyis 〈zha sogs 〉mar 'gos gnyis 'dres kyi yi ge dang / rang 〈ri 'jigs/ bka'/〉rtog gi sbyar ba sna tshogs pa mang du byung la/ kha 9ra bka'/〉 cig gis 'gos lugs dang mar lugs gtsang /ma byed par bsams na'ang / phar 'dres tshur 'dres su song ba ma shes/ bar skabs kyi mun sprul du ma 'dres shing / rang rang gis kyang gzu lum gsar pa mang po dag bcug man ngag gi rgyun med par glegs bam tsam la brten pa'i —156—

skyon gyi ches ma dag pa dang / 'khrugs pa dang ma tshang ba dag snang ngo / /des na 'dir kho bos gsal bar bya'o/ /'di nyams su len pa la/ sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi gnyis las/ dang po la/ sdig sgrib sbyong ba rdo rje sems dpa'i bsnyen pa/ tshogs rdzogs pa'i phyir maṇ+ḍal/ byin rlabs 'jug pa'i phyir bla ma'i rnal 'byor ro/ /de thams cad kyang skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rgyas bsdus gang yang rung ba len pa sngon du 'gro bar bya ste/ dang po ni sgrub thabs rnams su shes par bya la/ gnyis pa rang gi mdun du stegs bu la maṇ+ḍal tshom bu lnga pa zhig bzhugs su gsol/ mtha' mchod pas bskor/ mchod pa byin rlabs spyi dang mthun par bya/ skad cig tsam gyis dbus kyi tshom bu'i steng du bla ma rdo rje 'chang / mdun du yi dam/ g.yas su sangs rgyas/rgyab tu dam chos/ g.yon tu dge 'dun rnams skad cig gis bzhugs par bsams la/ mchod pa rnams sngags dang phyag rgya spyi dang mthun pas phul/ gang gis drin gyis bde chen nyid sogs dang / khong stong khyed kyi sku la med/ ces sogs ci rigs pas bstod/ maṇ+ḍal spyi dang mthun par lan mang du phul la/thun 'jog khar rgyun bshags dang rigs lnga'i sdom gzung tshar gsum re bya/mos gus drag pos/ bla ma 'od gsal chos kyi sku la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bde chen longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bla ma thugs rje sprul pa'i sku la gsol ba 'debs so/ /sku gsum dbyer med bla ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rim gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin khyad par can skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rim lnga'i —157—

rtogs pa rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ gzhan yang blo chos su 'gro ba sogs gsol ba mang du btab la/ mthar de thams cad 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ dar cig sems ma bcos par bzhagagasum pa ni/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang blang ba mkhas pa btsun mo can gyi man ngag ste/ rang gi mdun du seng khri pad+ma nyi zla brtsegs pa'i gdan gyi bkod pa bzang la rgya che ba'i steng du/ rtsa ba'i bla ma sku bkrag mdangs gzi brjid dang ldan pa/ sku la dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i cha lugs can/ lha sum cu rtsa gnyis sogs dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo la yul rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma'i ngo bo/rnam pa mi'i bu mo lo bcu gnyis lon pa'i na tshod can/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pas 'khyud pa'o/ /de nas rang gi lus dang longs spyod phyi snang ba rab 'byams dang bcas pa bla ma la phul la/ gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ sku'i dpral ba nas 'od zer dkar po byung / rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs lus thams cad gang / bum dbang thob/ sbyor mtshams nas 'od zer dmar po byung /mgrin par thim/ gsang ba'i dbang thob/ thugs ka nas 'od zer sna tshogs byung / rang gi snying gar thim/ shes rab ye shes dang dbang bzhi pa thob/ yang gsol ba btab pas bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ de'i ngang der cung zad mnyam par bzhag thun re re la yang de nyid yang nas yang du sgom pa yin no/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ las gyi ngo bo rim pa gnyis/ lam gyi bogs 'don spyod pa/ grogs dam tshig 'bras bu dngos grub rnams gnyis so/ /dang —158—

po la gnyis las/ dang po dmigs thun gyi nges pa ni/ sngon 'gro la gsum/dran pa gcig pa la dmigs pa gcig la thun sum cu rtsa lnga/ rtog pa'i rnal 'byor la dmigs pa gnyis la dmigs skor bcu drug lus dben la dmigs pa dgu/ ngag dben la dmigs pa'i gtso bo bcu la dmigs skor bzhi bcu zhe bdun/ sems dben la bzhi/ sgyu lus la brgyad/ 'od gsal la nyer lnga/ zung 'jug la gnyis te spyir dmigs chen zhe bdun/ dmigs skor brgya drug cu re gcig go /gnyis pa de dag sgom tshul ni bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim gnyis kyi/dang po la dran pa gcig pa dang / rtog pa'i rnal 'byor ro/ /dang po ni/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te/ bzlas pa'i bar du mngon rtogs ltar dmigs pa rtse gcig tu bsgoms la/ dang por rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo rgyal pa mi bskyod rdo rje zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ 'ja' tshon ltar snang la rang bzhin med pa la sems gzung / de nas shar gyi rnam snang nas/ 'og tu gnod mdzes kyi bar lha re re la sems 'dzin te/ mthar lha sum cu rtsa gnyis la gcig car sems 'dzin no/ /so gsum mo/ /de nas gzhal yas khang la sems 'dzin te so bzhi/ de nas snod thams cad gzhal yas khang / bcud thams cad rgyal ba mi bskyod rdo rje'i skur bsam ste so lnga'o/ /'di'i skabs thun dang po la mngon rtogs rdzogs par bsgoms/ thun mtshams la 'jug pa'i tshe/ dkyil 'khor ma bsdus par gtso bo'i thugs ka nas sku gnyis pa zhig chad la/ phyi rol gyi bya ba rnams la gnas par bsam/ thun gnyis pa dang gsum pa la/ rang nyid shar sgo —159—

nas zhugs te/ dbus kyi gtso bo la thim de nas lha sku la sems 'dzin zhing /thun mtshams gong du 'dra'o/ /thun tha ma la/ gzhan de nyid dang 'dra ba las thun bsdu ba'i tshe/ dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa rdo rje'i lam nas snying gar bsdus/ gtso bo'i nga rgyal gyis nyal bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa rtog pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ bad kan shas che na steng sgo la brten pa dang / rlung shas che na 'og sgo la brten pa dang / 'khris pa shas che na gnyis ka la brten pa'o/ /dang po ni rang nyid mi bskyod rdo rjer gsal ba'i sna rtse'i nang du zla ba'i steng du hu sngon po la sems rtse gcig tu 'dzin te/ dmigs skor gcig yang de rdo rje hu gis mtshan par gyur pa la sems 'dzin te/ dmigs skor gnyis/ de la sems brten na/ lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i thig le lha so so'i kha dog can la sems 'dzin/ de bzhin du sa bon dang phyag mtshan so gnyis la sems 'dzin/ dmigs skor re re ste lnga'o/ /de dag la sems rtse gcig tu brtan par gyur na/ sna rtser thig le'i dbus su dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo yongs su rdzogs pa bsgoms la/ thig le'am/ sa bon nam/ phyag mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor la sems 'dzin te/ de gsum so sor bgrangs pas brgyad do/ /de dag la sems brtan pa thob na/ rtog pa'i rnal 'byor tshad du phyin pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ rang rgyal ba mi bskyod rdo rjer gsal ba'i gsang ba'i sna rtser hū yungs 'khru tsam la sems rtse gcig tu gzung ste gcig/de la sems cung zad brtan na/ de nyid thig ler zhu ba la sems gtad de dmigs skor gnyis —160—

de brtan na thig le'i dbus su sa bon sgom ste dmigs skor gsum/ de yang brtan na/ de las rdo rje sogs phyag mtshan du song ba la sems gzung ste bzhi/de la brtan na/ lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i sa bon dang phyag mtshan gyi bar du sngar bzhin bsgoms te lnga/ de rnams la yang sems brtan na/ shes rab kyi gsang ba'i sna rtser spros la/ dkyil 'khor dpag tu med par gyur nas spro ba ste drug go /thig le'i dbus su dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bsgoms nas spro ba la sogs pa spro bsdu gnyis po zad mi shes pa'i bar du bya ste bdun no/ /'di thams cad la sems brtan pa'i tshad ni/ reg mthong gi mtshan ma rnyed pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ gnyis po spel gyin sgom pa yin kun gril bas bcu drug go /slob ma bkri ba'i rim pa la ni/ gegs mi sdang ba'i dgos pa chen po yod pas nang khams dang bstun pa 'di yang nges par dgos pa'i man ngag yin la/spyir rnam rtog shas che na steng sgo la dmigs pa dang / nyon mongs shas che ba'i tshe 'og sgo la dmigs pa yin te/ gtso bor 'di bzhin du bkri bar bya'o// //gnyis pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa la/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa'i rim pa sems la dmigs pa'i rim pa/ sgyu lus bdag byin brlabs pa'i rim pa/ 'od gsal mngon par byang chub pa'i rim pa/ zung 'jug mi gnas pa'i myang 'das kyi rim pa ste lnga'am/ dang po la gnyis su phye nas/ drug tu mdzad pa ltar na/ lus dben/ ngag dben/ sems dben/ skyu lus/ 'od gsal/ zung 'jug gi 'khrid rnams yod pa las/ dang po la/ gzugs kyi lus dben/ rang bzhin gyi —161—

lus dben/ rnam shes kyi lus dben/ ting nge 'dzin gyi lus dben te bzhi las/dang po ni/ lus sha khrag la sogs pa mi gtsang ba'i khams sum cu rtsa drug tshogs pa'i phung por snang tsam la sems gtad de 'jog pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ lus sems su snang ba 'di ni phung po lnga/ khams bzhi/ skye mched drug yul lnga/ ye shes lnga sogs rnam pa sna tshogs pa sil bur gnas pa las/ rtag gcig rang dbang can/ bden par grub pa cung zad kyang med par shes par byas la mnyam par 'jog pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ yul dang dbang po 'phrad pa las rnam par shes pa 'byung bar snang yang / phyi yul rdul phra rab tu bshig na mthar mtha' med du song bas dmigs su med/ de bzhin du dbang po rnams kyang bshig na dmigs su med/rnam par shes pa nyid kyang phyi nang gang na yang ma dmigs/ kha dog dbyibs sogs gang du yang ma grub pas/ phyi nang bar gsum stong nyid mtha' bral du gyur pa la mnyam par bzhag go /de rnams ni rim pas lus la gtsang zhen dang / bdag tu 'dzin pa dang / gzung 'dzin bden par 'dzin pa'i gnyen po ste/lus dben gyi sngon 'gro yin no/ /bzhi pa la/ dam pa rigs brgya'i lus dben/ rgyal ba rigs lnga'i lus dben/ gsang ba rigs gsum gyi lus dben/ gsang chen rigs gcig gi lus dben no/ /dang po la/ thog mar phung khams brgya dam pa rigs brgyar dag tshul shes pa gal che bas/ de rnams mdor bsdus su brjod na/ spyir —162—

gzugs phung gi tshogs rnam par snang mdzad du bsgom/ de'i yang so sor phyi nas/dbyibs kyi gzugs rnam snang gi rnam snang/ bdag gzhan ri dang shing sogs kha dog dang dbyibs dang yul lnga kun 'dus pa rnam pa'i gzugs rin 'byung / kha dog gi gzugs snang mtha'/ nyi zla'i 'od sogs snang ba'i gzugs don grub/rig byed ma yin pa ste gzugs kyi rnam pa yid la shar ba rang rig pa'i gzugs na mi bskyod par bsgom/ tshor ba'i tshogs rin 'byung / de'i yang mkhris pa las byung ba'i tshor ba mi bskyod pa/ bad rlung las skyes pa rin 'byung / bde ba'i tshor ba snang mtha'/ sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba don grub/ tshor ba btang snyoms rnam snang du bsgom/ 'du shes kyi phung po'i tshogs snang mtha'/ de'i yang rkang gnyis pa'i 'du shes mi bskyod pa/ rkang bzhi pa'i 'du shes rin 'gyung / rkang med 'du shes snang mtha'/ rkang mangs kyi 'du shes don grub/ snod ltar mi g.yo zhing mi 'gyur pa'i 'du shes rnam snang du bsgom/ de rnams kyi dang po gzhi sems can de dang de'i 'du shes dang / phyi ma gzugs med khams la 'chad pa dang / yang dang po gzhi sems can de dag tu 'dzin pa dang / phyi ma snod kyi 'jig rten du 'dzin pa la 'chad pa dang / rim pa bzhin mthar gnyis su 'dzin pa dang / mtha' bzhi la brten pa dang / rang gi mtshan nyid gcig pur 'dzin pa dang / khyad chos mang por 'dzin pa dang / stong par 'dzin pa rnams la'ang 'chad pa de thams cad rung bar mngon pas gang rung gcig la bsgom par bya'o/ /'du byed kyi phung po'i tshogs don grub/ de'i lus kyi 'du byed rnam snang / ngag gi 'du byed snang mtha'/yid kyi 'du byed mi bskyod pa/ khams gsum du skye ba'i las kyi 'du byed rin —163—

'byung / thar pa'i lam gyi 'du byed don grub tu bsgoms/ rnam shes kyi phung po'i tshogs mi bskyod pa/ de'i yang mig gi rnam shes rnam snang / rna ba'i rnam shes rin 'byung / sna'i rnam shes snang mtha'/ lce'i rnam shes don grub/ lus kyi rnam shes mi bskyod par bsgom mo/ /sa'i khams kyi tshogs sangs rgyas spyan/ de'i yang / skra/ rus pa/ phyi sa/ mchin pa/ snying / phyi'i ri rab rnams spyan ma'i rnam snang / sbu/ sen mo/ rnag snying / phyi'i 'dzam bu'i gling rin 'byung / so/ lpags pa/ sha snying / phyi'i ba lang spyod snang mtha'/ rus pa/ sha/ rtsib ma/ snying / phyi'i sgra mi snyan don grub/ dri ma/ rgyu ma/ mkhris pa/ snying / phyi'i lus 'phags po mi bskyod par bsgoms/ chu'i khams kyi tshogs mā ma ki de'i yang bad kan dang /mchi ma dang phyi'i 'bab chu rnam snang / gcin dang / phyi'i rgya mtsho'i chu mi bskyod pa/ rdul dang / phyi'i chu bo'i chu rin 'byung / khrag dang / phyi'i bkod pa'i chu snang mtha'/ kha chu dang / phyi'i nyeng ka'i chu don grub tu bsgom/ me'i khams kyi tshogs gos dkar mo/ de'i yang mgo bo'i drod dang / phyi'i rdo las byung ba'i me rnam snang / snying ga'i drod dang / phyi'i rgyun bzhag gi me mi bskyod pa/ lte ba'i drod dang / phyi'i me shel sogs kyi me rin 'byung / yan lag gi drod dang / phyi'i shing las byung ba'i me snang mtha'/ lto ba'i drod dang / phyi'i nags kyi me don grub tu bsgom/ rlung khams kyi tshogs sgrol ma/ de'i yang srog rlung snying la gnas pa dang phyi'i shar gyi rlung mi bskyod pa/ thur sel 'doms na gnas pa dang lho'i rlung rin 'byung / gyen rgyu lkog mar rgyu ba dang nub kyi rlung snang mtha'/ me mnyam lte bar gnas pa dang byang gi rlung don grub/ khyab byed tshig sa thams cad la gnas pa —164—

dang steng gi rlung rnam snang du bsgom/ mig gi skye mched kyi tshogs sa'i snying po/de'i yang rgun 'khrum gyi tshad tsam gyi mig dbang sa'i snying gi mi bskyod pa/ mig 'bras dkar po'i rang bzhin rin 'byung / zur gyis blta ba'i gzugs snang mtha'/ mig gi rnam par g.yo ba don grub/ gzugs gsum 'dzin pa rnam snang du bsgom/ rna ba'i skye mched kyi tshogs phyag na rdo rje/ de'i yang gro ga gcus te bcad pa lta bu'i rna dbang mi bskyod pa/ rna ba'i rang bzhin rnam snang / rna ba'i bu ga snang mtha'/ rna ba'i rtsa ba don grub/ sgra gsum 'dzin pa rin 'byung du bsgom/sna'i skye mched kyi tshogs nam mkha'i snying po/ de'i yang mi sman gyi thur ma bshigs pa lta bu'i sna dbang mi bskyod pa/ sna'i rang bzhin rnam snang / nang gi dbus rin 'byung / sna bug gi khung don grub/ dri gsum 'dzin pa snang mthar bsgom/ lce'i skye mched kyi tshogs 'jig rten dbang phyug de'i yang zla ba phyed pa'i dbyibs lta bu'i lce dbang mi bskyod pa/ lce'i rang bzhin rnam snang / lce'i rtsa ba rin 'byung / lce'i rtse mo snang mtha'/ ro gsum 'dzin pa don grub tu bsgom/lus kyi skye mched kyi tshogs sgrib sel/ de'i yang lus dbang rnam snang / rus pa'i rang bzhin rin 'byung / sha'i rang bzhin snang mtha'/ lpags pa'i rang bzhin don grub/ reg gsum 'dzin pa mi bskyod par bsgom/ yid 'jam dpal gyi ting nge 'dzin ni/ lus kyi nang na snang ba'i rnam par shes pa gsum po de ni yid kyi dbang po ste/ dbang po thams cad kyi bdag po yin/ so so rang rig pa yin pas/ phyi'i yul ni med kyi/ chos dbyings yul du byas nas/ lam dus kyi ye shes lngar 'char ba 'jam dpal du bsgom/ de'i yang me long la —165—

gzugs brnyan snang ba bzhin/ dngos po ma lus pa rnams cig car du yongs su shes pa me long lta bu'i ye shes te rnam snang du bsgom/ rkang med dang rkang gnyis dang rkang mangs kyi sems can rnams kyang sems tsam mo zhes rnam pa gcig tu rtogs pa mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes te rin 'byung / phung po dang khams la sogs pa phyi nang gi dngos po rnams so sor rnam par phye ste/ rnam par brtags na thams cad kyang sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin no zhes shes nas/ chos thams cad kyi cha shas ni 'di dag go zhes pad+ma'i 'dab ma ltar so sor rtog kyang rtog pa med pas gnas pa de ni so sor rtog pa'i ye shes te snang mtha'/ bdag dang gzhan gyi bya ba lus dang ngag dang yid kyi las rdzogs par byed pa'i ngo bo nyid ni bya ba grub pa'i ye shes te don grub/ lus dang ngag dang yid kyi sgrib pa dag cing /las dang nyon mongs pa las grol te/ dge ba dang mi dge ba'i bag chags rnam par sbyangs ba ni chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag pa'i ye shes te mi bskyod par bsgom/ yang na gzhi dus kyi ye shes lnga po de bzhin gshegs pa lngar mos pa bya ste/ yid 'jam gyi ting nge 'dzin no/ /ldang zhing rgyu ba'i rlung mig gi skye mched la brten nas gzugs rnam pa lnga'i bya ba rdzogs par byed pa gzugs rdo rje mar bsgom/ de'i yang snang ba dang / sgrib g.yogs med pa dang yid la byed pa dang /mig gi dbang po'i tshogs pa dang ldan pa'i rgyu las gzugs kyi yul rnams mthong ba gzugs rdo rje ma'i rnam snang / 'gying bag dang rnam par rol pa dang sgeg pa'i gzugs mi bskyod pa/ rjes su chags pa'i gzugs rin 'byung yid du 'ong mi 'ong btang snyoms kyi 'du shes 'jug pa'i gzugs snang mtha'/ bya ba —166—

byed pa'i gzugs don grub tu bsgom/ rnam par rgyu ba'i rlung rna ba'i skye mched la brten te sgra rnam pa lnga'i bya ba byed pa sgra rdo rje ma/ de'i yang rna ba'i nang gi sgra dang mgo dang skra'i sgra rnam snang / glu dang rgyud kyi sgra rin 'byung / dkan dang mchu dang ngag gi sgra snang mtha'/ nags tshal dang chu bo dang se gol dang thal mo dang rdza rnga la sogs pa rol mo'i sgra don grub/ yi ge hū zhi ba dang / drag po'i sgra mi bskyod par bsgom/ rab tu rgyu ba'i rlung lce'i skye mched la brten nas ro rnam pa lnga'i bya ba byed pa ro rdo rje ma/ de'i yang ro mngar ba rnam snang / bska ba rin 'byung / tsha ba snang mtha'/ kha ba mi bskyod pa/ lan tshwa ba dang skyur ba la sogs pa ro drug gi bye brag don grub tu bsgom/ nges par rgyu ba'i rlung lus kyi skye mched la brten nas reg bya rnam pa lnga'i bya ba byed pa reg rdo rje ma/ 'di'i yang gtan gcig la gnas pa'i reg bya rnam snang / 'khyud pa'i reg bya rin 'byung / 'o byed rig bya snang mtha'/ rngub pa'i reg bya don grub / bha ga dang liṅga sbyor ba'i reg bya mi bskyod par bsgom/ de ltar na phung po la nyer lnga/ khams la nyi shu/ skye mched la ye shes lnga dang bcas pas sum cu/ yul la nyer lnga ste rigs brgya'o/ /de la phyi'i 'byung bzhi rnams phyi nang dag sbyor gyi dbang du byas nas/ nang gi 'byung bzhi sogs la 'dus par sgom pa yin la/ de yang rtog pa'i rnal 'byor yan chad kyi bskyed rim phra rags thams cad la brtan pa thob pa'i dbang du byas nas/ rigs brgya/ rigs lnga/ rigs gsum ste/ lus dben dang po gsum po spros pa rgya chen po slar bsdu pa'i tshul gyi rim pas sgom pa yin par 'gos pa rnams 'dod pa dang man ngag tu las dang po pa la mos sgom rjes mthun pa'i —167—

dbang du byas nas las dang po la rim lnga'i khrid 'debs pa'am/ spros pa la mi dga' ba rnams ni thog ma nas gsang chen rigs gcig la 'jug par bya'o zhes 'dod la/ sngar bskyed rim la gsal snang thob zin pa'i dbang du byas nas/ phung khams sogs phyi nang gi chos de dang de/ lha de dang de rnams yin par ngo shes tsam byas pas/ zhal phyag gi rnam pa ched btad ma bsgoms kyang / dam pa rigs brgya la sogs pa'i lhar gsal snang 'byung ba la bsams nas 'gos lugs pa rnams sman pa mkhas pas slob ma la sman ngo sprod pa ltar ngo shes byas pas chog gi zhal phyag la sogs pa bskyed chog gis bskyed mi dgos par 'dod do/ /spyir lha'i rnam pa ma bsgoms kyang / lha de dang de'i mos pa brtan po byung na/ rdor bzlas kyi brten tsam du gyur pa'i lus dben gyi go chod pa yod cing / de'i phyir lus dben 'di bskyed rdzogs ri thang mtshams pa dang / bskyed rim gyi zab shos dang / rdzogs rim gyi ma mthar bzhed pa sogs thams cad 'khrid tshul cung zad mi 'dra ba'i khyad par gyis yin pas/ man ngag rig pa rnams kyis de dag thams cad la 'khrul pa med par rtogs so/ /'on kyang bskyed rim la brtan pa thob pa sngon du ma song bar 'di sgom pa la yang / zhal phyag gi rnam pa can bskyed chog gzhan la ma bltos par skad cig gis gsal 'debs pa man ngag gi rgyun la yod pa ni shin tu legs shing nges par dgos la/ spyir lus dben gyi rim pa'i rtogs pa bskyed pa la/ bde stong las rang shar ba'i lha sku'i rnam pa nges par dgos/ rigs brgya rigs lnga rigs gsum rigs gcig rnams kyang lha mang nyung tsam ka ma yin pa lam mtho dma'i khyad —168—

chen po yod pa shes dgos so/ /'dir rjes mthun lam byed ltar na rnam par snang mdzad rigs lnga car rigs chen gyi dbang du byas nas sku mdog gzhi dkar ba la rigs chung gi dbang du byas nas/ so so'i mdangs kyis brgyan pa ste/gzugs phung la mtshone na rnam snang gi rnam snang shin tu dkar ba/ rnam snang gi mi bskyod pa dkar la sngo mdangs can/ rnam snang gi rin 'byung dkar la ser mdangs can/ rnam snang gi snang mtha' dkar la dmar mdangs can/ rnam snang gi don grub dkar la ljang mdangs can nam/ yang na sku mdog rigs lnga so so'i kha dog can du bsgom kyang rung ste/ gang ltar yang phyag mtshan nges pa mngon rtogs ltar rnam snang gi phyag mtshan can lngar bsgom mo/ /des gzhan rnams yang rigs 'gre'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rigs chung gtso che ba'i dbang du byas pa'i rnam snang gi rigs nyi shu rnam snang dngos dang / mi bskyod pa'i rim nyi shu mi bskyod pa dngos dang / rin 'byung gi rigs nyi shu rin 'byung dngos dang / 'od dpag med kyi rigs nyi shu 'od dpag med dngos dang / don grub kyi rigs nyi shu don grub dngos su skad cig gis zhal phyag mngon rtogs ltar gsal btab nas/ mos pa drag tu sbyangs shing / mthar der snang tsam pa mnyam par 'jog pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ rin chen rigs dang de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs thams cad sku rdo rje rnam snang dang / las kyi rigs thams cad dang pad+ma'i rigs thams cad gsung rdo rje 'od dpag med dang / mi bskyod pa'i rigs thams cad dang /khyab byed rdo rje 'chang thugs rdo rje mi bskyod pa 'du bas/ rang gi lus sku rdo rje —169—

rnam snang dkar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa dang / ngag gsum rdo rje 'od dpag med dmar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ sems thugs rdo rje mi bskyod pa sngon po zhal gsum phyag drug par mos shing / der snang ba la mnyam par 'jogabazhi pa la gsum gyi/ dang por rigs gcig tu bsdu ba ni lus ngag yid gsum ngo bo dbye ba med pa'i phyir/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer mi phyed pa rdo rje 'chang chen po'i ngo bor mos la rnam pa sngo dkar dmar pa'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi /g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje 'khor lo pad+ma/ g.yon pa rnams kyis dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ rang snang gi yum dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i skur lam me snang ba la mnyam par bzhag pas/ ji zhig ltar na rang lus rdo rje 'chang chen po'i skur rang ngo shes pa'i tshul gyis gsal snang khyad par can rang babs su 'byung la/ de nas zhal gsum phyag drug de yang bsdus te rdo rje 'chang dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs rdo rje skyil krung can/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang snang gi rig ma la 'byud pa/ mtshan dpe rdzogs shing dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa la sgom tshul snga ma ltar bsgom mo/ /gnyis pa spro ba ni/ de nyid la cung zad brtan pa thob pa'i tshe/ snang ba thams cad rdo rje 'chang chen po'i skur mos te de ltar snang ba tsam la mnyam par bzhagagasum pa spogs chog ni/ rdo rje 'chang zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i sku 'dra zhal phyag g.yas g.yon go ldog pa shin tu mtshar ba zhig byas la/ de'i gzugs brnyan me long la 'char bar byas nas/ de la yid dang mig rtse gcig tu gtad/—170—

de ma thag mig btsum nas/ de'i rnam pa yid yul du lam lam shar ba la mnyam par bzhag de ltar yang dang yang du byas pas gsal snang thob par 'gyur ro// //gnyis pa ngag rnam par dben pa la ngag dben dngos dang gegs sel zhar byung ngo / /dang po la bem por snang ba'i rlung rags pa la bslab pa dang /bem por snang ba'i rlung phra ba la bslab pa dang / gsal ba'i rlung rnam shes dang 'dre ba la bslab pa dang / btsan thabs rdo rje'i bzlas pa bum can dang 'brel ba ste bzhi las/dang po ni/ skyabs sems la sogs pa sngon 'gro rnams byas la/ lus rnam snang gi chos bdun spyi dang mthun/ rang lus dben ltar rdo rje 'chang gi skur gsal ba'i lus kyi nang stong seng nge ba rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi sogs rtsa thams cad khong stong du sang nge 'dug par bsams la/ rlung ro bsal ba lan 'ga' zung byas te/ dngos gzhi rdo rje'i bzlas pa'i skabs 'dir/ rlung 'byung 'jug gnas gsum yi ge 'bru gsum gyi gdangs su mos pa/ rlung sngags dbyer med du shes pa'i sgo nas/ lko gyis rlung nang du sas pas/ spyi bo nas rkang mthil dang sor mo'i bar tshun chad kyi/ phyi'i lus dang nang rtsa thams cad rkyal pa srubs med rlung gis bus pa bzhin tad gi khengs par bsam de yang rlung gi 'jug mgrin pa man chad du sleb nas gnas pa'i 'go rtsom pa yin la/ de nas cung zad cig ched kyis bzung ste 'byung 'jug las bag tsam yun ring bar byas la/de'i tshe ā zhes dran par bya zhing / steng 'og gi rlung cung zad kha sbyor du bya'o/ /hu —171—

zhes phyir phyung / phyi lus dang nang rtsa thams cad stong sangs kyis song bar bsam/ rlung gi 'go mgrin pa yan chad du song ba nas/ phyir 'gro'i 'go 'dzin no/ /gal te rlung gi rgyu ba mi gsal na/ ras bal sob pos snang bug cung zad bkag na rgyu ba gsal bas de ltar bya'o/ /rdo rje gdan gyi nag po pa dang mkhas pa mngon shes can ni 'di'i gnas pa'i skabs su bum can thub tshad du 'dzin par bzhed/ btsun mo can la sogs pa 'dus pa'i mkhas pa gzhan rnams sgo nga smin pa las byar 'gyur ba bzhin/ rdor bzlas goms pas rlung ngang gis 'gags te bum pa can du 'gyur par bzhed do/ /gnyis pa la/ zab mo bde ba'i rlung la bslab pa dang / thabs mgon po bzhi'i rlung la bslab pa/ shes rab lha mo bzhi'i rlung la bslab pa'o/ /dang po ni/rang lus snga ma ltar gsal btab la/ rlung gi ngo bo 'od kyi skud pa lta bu mar snang rdo rje'i rtse mo'i nang du 'byar ba lta bu'i tshul du zug cing / lus kyi dbus drang thad nas yar skud pa brkyang pa ltar song ste spyi bor zug cing / de nas tshur 'khyogs te yas sna rang de sna rtse'i nang du zug par bsams la bde ba'i nyams myong dran bzhin pa'i sgo nas/ rlung 'od zer gyi skud pa lta bu de nyid bde breng nge ba 'dug par bsams la/ rlung nang du 'jug pa'i tshe oṃ/ gnas pa'i tshe u 'gro ba'i tshe hū zhes dran par byas/ rlung gi skud pa de yang / yang nas yang du sbom po las je phra je phrar 'gro ba la sems gtad/ yang na rlung 'byung ba'i tshe lte ba nas sna sgor/ dar skud dkar po brkyang pa ltar nar gyis byung bas lus bde chil byung bar bsam/ nang du 'ong tsa na sna sgo nas gru gu bsgril ba ltar song nang —172—

du bde khril byung / gnas pa'i tshe lte bar gong bu gcig tu gyur pa bde ril la 'dug par bsams/ 'khru gsum dang sngar bzhin sbyar ro/ /de dag gis ni reg pa bde ba dang rlung spong nus pa 'byung ngo / /de nyid la legs par lobs pa na kha dog rgyu ba nges pa 'byung bas/gnyis pa ni/ me rlung dgu brgya phrag gcig rgyu ba'i tshe/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo'i dbus nas pad+ma'i mgon po'i rlung dmar po byung nas/ sa de nyid nas dbu ma phug nas/ sna bug g.yas nas 'byung 'jug byed cing / gnas pa'i tshe mgrin pa'i 'khor lo'i lte bar gnas par bsam la/ sngar bzhin yi ge 'bru gsum sbyar ba'i bzlas pa bya/ de bzhin du nye ba nas las kyi mgon po'i rlung 'od zer ljang khu'am/ sngon po'i rnam pas sna bug g.yon nas rgyu ba dang /gsang ba nas rin chen mgon po'i rlung 'od zer ser po'i rnam pa can byung ste/sna bug gnyis ka nas drag tu rgyu ba dang / snying ga nas rdo rje mgon po'i rlung 'od zer dkar po'i rnam pa can sna bug gnyis ka nas dal zhing shugs zhan pa'i tshul gyis rgyu ba rnams la'ang yi ge 'khru gsum sbyar nas dgu brgya pa phrag re re bzla bar bya'o/ /de ltar nyin mtshan 'khor yug tu bzlas pas/ ring por mi thogs par kha dog shin tu gsal bar mthong ngo / /de nas rim gyis mgon po re re'i rlung gi nang tshan lha mo bzhi'i rlung rnams kyang so sor nges pa 'byung bas/gsum pa ni/ mgon po re re yang lha mo bzhi bzhi'i rlung gis phye ba yin pas/ gang nas rlung rgyu ba'i gnas ni/ mgon po bzhi'i rlung gis bzlas pa'i skabs su bstan pa bzhin yin la/ kha dog ni me rlung gi skabs/ gzhi ma dmar —173—

po la mdangs so so can te/ dang por me rlung gi me shin du dmar ba gos dkar mo'i rgyu ba steng du 'gro ba dang / me rlung gi rlung dmar ljang sgrol ma'i rgyu ba sna gshe/ga gi logs la 'gro ba dang / me rlung gi sa dmar ser sangs rgyas spyan ma'i rgyu ba sna rtse'i thad kar 'gro ba dang / me rlung gi chu dmar skya mā ma ki'i rgyu ba thur du 'gro ba rnams nyis brgya nyer lnga pa re bzlas pa bya'o/ /sna bug gi sgo so so'i khyad par ma gtogs rgyu ba'i tshul ni 'dra la/ kha dog gi khyad par ni las kyi mgon po bzhir bzhag pa la thams cad kha dog gzhi ma sngon po'am ljang khu la so so'i mdangs kyis brgyan pa ste/ gos dkar rlud gi me ljang dmar dang /sgrol ma rlung gi rlung shin tu ljang ba'am sngo ba dang / spyan ma rlung gi sa ljang ser dang / mā ma gī rlung gi chu ljang skya'o/ /rin chen mgon po'i rlung rnams gzhi ma kha dog ser po so so'i mdangs can te/ gos dkar mo sa'i me ser dmar dang /sgrol ma sa'i rlung ser nag gam ser ljang dang / spyan ma sa'i sa shin tu ser ba dang / mā ma gī sa'i chu ser skya rnams so/ /rdo rje mgon po'i rlung thams cad gzhi ma kha dog dkar ba la so so'i mdangs te/ mā ma gī chu'i me dkar dmar dang /sgrol ma chu'i rlung dkar ljang / spyan ma chu'i sa dkar ser dang / mā ma gī chu'i chu shin tu dkar ba rnams so/ /de thams cad kyang nyis brgya nyer lnga pa re bzla ste/de rnams kyi phan yon rlung g.yas g.yon du bsams pa tsam gyis 'pho ba dang /phyi nang bsre nus pa dang / rlung bde ba'i reg bya can grang dus dro ba dang / dro dus bsil ba sogs su 'gyur ba dang / 'phrin las rnam bzhi thogs med du 'grub pa'o/ /—174—

gsum pa ni/ de rnams la rtag tu goms pas/ sems gzugs kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i tshe/ snying ga la sogs pa mgon po gang gi rlung rgyu ba'i gnas de nas/ mig gi 'bras bu'i dbus nas 'byung 'jug byed pa dang / sems sgra'i rjes su 'gro ba'i tshe rna ba dang / dri'i rjes su 'gro ba'i tshe sna'i bar ka dang / ro'i rjes su 'gro ba'i tshe lce'i dbus dang / reg bya'i rjes su 'gro ba'i tshe lus kyi ba sbu thams cad nas 'byung 'jug byed par bsams la yi ge 'bru gsum sbyar ba'i rdor bzlas bya'o/ /'dis ni nges par phyi nang gi rlung 'dres te rgyu ba 'gags pas ji tsam 'dod par rlung 'dzin nus pa dang / stong gsum gyi rlung yang lus nang du 'jug pa dang / sa rlung bkag na sred med kyi bu'i stobs dang /chu rlung bkag na mes mi 'tshig pa dang / me rlung bkag na chu dang grang ba'i reg byas mi gnod pa dang / rlung gi rlung bkag na chur mi bying zhing nam mkhar 'gro ba la sogs pa bshad/ gtso bor rlung dbu mar thim pas gtum mo rang 'bar du 'gyung zhing thig le rdzogs par bzhu bas bde stong rgyun mi 'chad/ byang chub kyi sems dbab bzlog 'dzin 'dren la dbang thob/ rlung las rnam par rgyal ba thob pa yin no/ khyad par yan lag gi rlung gi rdor bzlas 'dis/ dbang shes lnga bde bar 'char/ bde ba la brten nas mi rtog pa'i ye shes skye/ rlung spro ba'i bzlas pas nyams sna tshogs 'char ba dang / 'jug pa'i bzlas pas ma dag pa'i snang ba yal ba dang / gnas pa'i bzlas pas shes pa rang rig rang gsal du gnas pa 'byung ngo / /—175—

bzhi pa ni/ nag po dam tshig rdo rje'i man ngag shog gril las 'byung ba'i ngag dben te/ 'di la steng 'og gi rlung bsre ba dang / dbu ma'i lam du 'jug pa'o/ /dang po ni/ lus kyi 'khrul 'khor ni tsog pu'am skyil krung kyi ngang nas chos bdun spyi dang mthun pa las lto ba tshigs pa la gcer/ lag pa mnyam bzhag gam pus 'khyud bya/ lus nywa bzhi bsgrim/ ngag gi 'khrul 'khordo ra ni/ thog mar rlung ro bsal la/ steng rlung lte bar drag tu mnan/ 'og rlung a long 'byed 'dzum gyi sbyor bas nye bar kha sbyor du bsdams hu zhes dran par bya/ yid kyi 'khrul 'khor ni rlung gsang ba'i rtse mo nas yar ldog ste/ lto bar sbrul 'khyil ba lta bu la sems gtad/ de ltar 'khrul 'khor gsum po de yang nas yang du bya zhing / des ngal ba'i tshe/ rlud 'jug gnas 'byung gsum la yi ge 'khru gsum sbyar ba tsam gyis rdor bzlas dkyus ma ci 'grub bya/ thun mtshams su bags yangs par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ steng 'og gi rlung 'dres pas bde ba skyed pa'i tshe/ snga ma bzhin du rlung lte bar bsres la/ hu zhes khong 'dren byas pas rlung kha dog dkar po'i rnam pas nye ba nas spyi bo'i bar du yur chu drangs pa bzhin du khyu ru ru 'gro bar bsams la/ kha spyor gyen la drag tu bzlog par bya'o/ /yang na steng rlung mnan pa'i tshe/ oṃ zhes dran par byas la kha dog dkar po'i rnam pas lte bar sleb/ 'og rlung drangs pas gsang gnas yar byung bar bsams la hu zhes dran par bya/ nye bar bsres ba'i tshe u zhes dran par bya/ de nyid hu gi khong 'dren —176—

gyis tshangs bug gi bar du drangs/ oṃ gyi sgras slar lte bar phab/ ā zhes thub tshad du bzung / de ltar ci rigs par byas nas/ 'jug tu rlung 'byung ba'i tshe lte ba nas spyi bo'i bar du hu gi sgra dang bcas te 'gro ba dang / 'jug pa'i tshe spyi bo nas lte ba'i bar du oṃ zhes bya ba'i gdangs kyis 'ong ba dang / gnas pa'i tshe lte bar u zhes bya ba'i gdangs dang bcas pa la sems gtad de/ rdor bzlas mang du bya'o/ /rlung sbyor 'di ni gzhan lus kyi lam la nye bar mkho ba zhig yin par gnang ngo / /gnyis pa gegs sel zhar byung ni/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa sgom pa'i tshe mgo bo dang ro stod na ba dang snying mi dga' ba la sogs pa byung na/ lus khong stong spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar thams cad du bu ga khrol tshags lta bus khyab par bsams la/ rlung drag tu 'bud cing / 'bud chung yang yang bya'o/ /lus khol bur na na hu ring hu thung gi sbyor bas 'don te/ hū zhes brjod pas gang gzer ba de nas rlung phyur gyi byung la/ hū thung drag tu bton pas na sar bu ga hur gyis rdol nas/ du ba lta bu phyir phyur gyis 'thon par bsams/ de ltar yang yang byas pas sel lo/ /yang snying 'dar zhing dkrug na/ snying ga'i thad nas/ bu ga hur gyis byung / de nas rdor bzlas byas pas sel la/ de bzhin du mgrin pa mi bde na/ mgrin pa'i lam dang / 'og gi rgyu lam 'gags shing mdun rgyab kyi lam mi bde na 'og sgo gnyis nas rdo rje'i bzlas pa bya/ lto ba sbos shing 'khrog na lte ba'i bu ga nas rdor bzlas dang / tshigs thams cad na na gsang ba'i bu ga'am/ ba sbru'i bu ga thams cad nas rdor bzlas bya zhing / mgo bo na na dpral —177—

ba nas rdor bzlas byas pas sel/ mig na na mig nas rdor bzlas byed pa dang /rna ba sna lce rnams gzer ba dang mi bde na de dang de dag nas rdor bzlas bya/lus gzer na gang na sa nas rdor bzlas byas pas sel/ bum pa can dang rdor bzlas 'di dag byas pa tsam gyis snying ga tsha lam gyis 'byung ba dang / mgo 'khor zhing skyug pa dang / spyi gtsug gzer ba dang / sna'i rtse mo nas brtsams te mgo lus grang stong gis 'gro ba sogs byung na/ nyin zhag 'ga' zhig rtsol ba klod la kha zas bcud can bsten pa dang / spyod lam dal zhing bsku mnye bya/ de dag sangs pa na slar bsgom par bya'o/ /de dag ni dkyus kyi 'phros las 'byung ba yin la/ spyir gegs sel mtha' dag ni bla ma'i zhal gyi man ngag dang /nyams myong mthong ba brgyud pa dang bcas pa las shes par bya'o// //gsum pa sems rnam par dben pa ni/ lugs 'di la gtso bor gzhan lus la brten pa yin zhes 'chad la/ 'on kyang / rim lnga las/ gal te chu skyes rdo rje sbyor/ /kun rdzob tu yang med gyur na/ /lan cig tsam zhig myong nas kyang //rnal 'byor stobs kyis 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ las rgya la brten nas snang ba gsum legs par ngo 'phrod pa'i rjes su/ phyis rang lus la brten nas sgoms kyang rung mod/ yang thog mar rang lus la brten nas snang ba gsum ci rigs par 'dren nus par byas la/ phyis lus kyi phyag rgya la brten nas sems dben mthar 'byin pa yang yod de/ rang lus kho nas sems dben rdzogs pa med do/ /des na gzhung gi dngos bstan gyi dbang du byas nas slob dpon gyi bi du bha dra mngon shes can dang / rdo rje gdan gyi nag po pa'i man ngag —178—

la ni/ 'og sgo la brten pa 'ba' zhig la sems dben gyi gdams pa gzhan mi bzhed la/ slob dpon de ba ā kar tsan dra btsun mo can gyi man ngag las ni gnyis ka 'byung bas/ 'dir 'khrid kyi rim pa ni de bzhin du mdzad de/ sems rnam par dben pa steng sgo la brten pa dang / 'og sgo la brten pa'o/ /dang po la/ snang gsum lugs 'byung sgrub pa dang / lugs bzlog tu sgom pa'o/ /dang po la/ snang ba dang po'i ye shes sgrub pa/ snang ba mched pa'i ye shes sgrub pa/ snang ba thob pa'i ye shes sgrub pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sngon 'gro rnams sngar ltar bsgoms la/ lus ngag gi spyod pa cha mnyam/ rang rdo rje 'chang phyag gnyis par gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i nye bar a dkar po/ spyi bor ha yig dkar po mgo bo thur bstan byang chub kyi sems bde ba'i rang bzhin can du gsal btab/ rlung bum can drag tu bzung bas/ a las 'od zer bsil la rno ba shugs drag pa byung / ha la bsnun pas/ ha las byang chub kyi sems kyi rgyun dkar na ra ra babs te/ snying ga'i a la thim/ byang chub sems kyi 'od zer zla ba shar ba lta bu skya lam lam pas lus kyi phyi nang dang snang ba thams cad khyab par bsam la/dbang gi nyams myong cung zad dran par bya/ 'di yang yang goms pas/ snang ba'i ye shes kyi nyams skye bar 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ gzhan rnams de dang 'dra ba la/ snying gar nyi ma'i steng du rdo rje dmar po rtse lnga pa'i steng du ud mar po tsheg drag gnyis kyi bar du chud pa/zhes gsung yang tsheg drag gcig gis chog de las 'od zer shin tu tsha ba byung —179—

ste/ ha la bsnun pas/ byang chub kyi sems dmar pa'i 'od chags pa babs/ul thim/ phyi nang thams cad 'od dmar po nyi ma shar ba lta bus khyab par bsam pa sogs gong bzhin bsgoms pas mched pa'i ye shes kyi nyams skye bar tsor ro/ /gsum pa ni/ snying gar rten med par a thung nag po cig gsal btab la/ de las 'od zer mdangs mi gsal ba mog ge ba zhig byung gsung ba yod na'ang nag po legs sam snyam/ ha la bsnun pas/ ha las byang sems dkar dmar 'dres pa'am mun pa'i thig le na ra ra babs/ a la thim/ dbang gi nyams myong dran par byas te/ phyi nang gi snang ba dbyings su yal ba'i mun pas khyab pa lta bu la mnyam par bzhag pas/ thob pa'i ye shes kyi nyams skye bar 'gyur ro/ /yang man ngag gi khyad par cung zad mi 'dra ba la/ gsum car la byang chub kyi sems dkar po 'ba' zhig 'bebs pa dang / dkar lam dmar lam nag lam gyi rnam pa mi sgom pa la/ thig le'i dod du 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum rim pas sbyar ba dang / nyer thob kyi a thung dmar por sgom pa'i lugs kyang yod cing 'di dag gsal byed yig chung bzhin bla ma'i man ngag las 'byung ba'i dbang du byas pa yin la/ rje 'gos kyi shog ril dngos bstan la ni/ snang ba'i skabs su/ sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar zla ba sgom pa dang / mched pa la rdo rje nye bar nyi ma sgom par bshad do/ /de dag ni rim lnga las/ dag pa ༵ ga shā ༵sdu sna kau~X / dzhai/gsal rim sgyu dmi rdo sngar ka sna pa rdo sgoma'i ska / bas su / /di ༵kā snra rdo bye~X —180—

'khor pad+ma can/ /brtan par bya ba'i rgyur gyur pa/ /dang po'i yi ge thig ler bcas/ /zla ba'i 'od zer ltar snang zhing / /snang ba'i ye shes yang dag 'byung //zhes dang / mched pa'i skabs su/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ming dang ni/ /de bzhin du ni rdo rje'i ming / /thig le gnyis kyis brgyan pa yi/ /cha ru de nyid shes par bya/ /nyi ma'i 'od zer 'dra ba dang / /snang ba mched pa'i sbyor las byung / /zhes dang / thob pa'i skabs su/ sa bon thig ler ldan min la/ /rlung gi sgo nas 'byung ba min/ /gang zhig snang ba thob pa ni/ /yongs su rdzogs pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /zhes gsungs shing / spyod bsdus las kyang de dang 'dra bar gsungs pa yin no/ /gnyis pa lugs bzlog tu bsgom pa ni/ snang ba'i skabs su bde ba dang gsal ba cha mnyam pa tsam 'byung / mched pa'i skabs gsal cha cher 'phel la/thob pa'i skabs bde ba dang mi rtog pa cher 'phel te gsal cha zil gyis gnon pas/ de'i tshe ldang ba la bslab ste/ sngar bzhin thob pa'i ye shes bsgoms pa'i rjes thogs su/ dang por mched pa'i dmigs pa gong bzhin bsgom/ des gsal snang chen por 'gyur bas de'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag go /de nas sngar bzhin snang ba'i dmigs pa bsgoms la/ bde gsal mi rtog pa cha mnyam pa'i nyams skyes pa'i tshe de nyid ring du bskyang ngo / /de ltar de lta bu'i ldang 'jug rtag tu bsgoms pas/ snang ba gsum gyi rtogs pa rnam par dag par skye bar 'gyur/de nas de nyid mthar won pa'i phyir/ 'og sgo la brten nas sgom pa yin no/ /—181—

gnyis pa ni/ rim lnga las/ sgyu ma dag ni thams cad las/ /bud med sgyu ma khyad par 'phags/ /ye shes gsum gyi dbye ba ni/ /gsal bar 'di las mtshon par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs te/ phyag rgya dang mnyam par sbyar ba las byang chub kyi sems gsang bar son pa na snang ba dang / rdo rje'i sked par son pa na mched pa dang / rdo rje'i zumagul du son pa na thob pa skad cig ma gsum pa dang /rdo rje'i rtse mor yud tsam zhig nyer thob dpe'i 'od gsal mngon du byed pa yin la/ 'dis ni rang bzhin snang ba'i dbye ba thams cad gsal bar mtshon nus shing / 'di la phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid/ bde ba bsdu ba/ bde ba bzung ba/ bde ba bzlog pa/ bde ba spro ba ste don tshan lnga'i zhal gyi gdams pa logs su bkod pa las shes par bya'o/ /bzhi pa sgyu lus kun rdzob bden pa'i 'khrid la/ dngos dang / bogs 'don gnyis so/ /dang po la mnyam bzhag sgyu lus/ rjes thob sgyu lus/ rmi lam sgyu lus gsum las/ dang po la/ gzhan lus la brten nas sgom pa dang / rang lus la brten nas sgom pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ phyag rgya dang mnyam par sbyar bas/ bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes skyes pa'i ngang der skad cig tsam gyis rang nyid rdo rje 'chang chen por lam gyis bsgoms la/ bde ba'i nyams myong dang lha sku dbyer med du bsres te/ de'i nang du mnyam par 'jog pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ sngar bzhin snang ba thob pa'i ye shes bsgoms la/ lugs bzlog gi rim pas mched pa dang / snang ba'i nyams myong cung zad tsam dran par —182—

byas/ skad cig dran rdzogs kyis rang rdo rje 'chang dkar po phyag gnyis par bsgoms nas snang la rang bzhin med pa la mnyam par bzhag de ni rim lnga las/ me long gi ni gzugs brnyan gyis/ /sgyu ma'i lus ni mtshon par bya/ kha dog rnams ni 'ja' lta bu/ khyab pa chu yi zla bas so/ /zhes dpe gsum las dpe dang po zhal phyag sogs dus gcig car grub pa dang / dpe gnyis pa dngas gsal ma 'dres pa ni skad cig dran rdzogs kyis gsal btab ste snang la rang bzhin med par sgom pa 'di'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ dpe gsum pa nam mkhar zla ba gcig shar ba/ chu klung mtsho rdzing thams cad la zla gzugs cig car 'char ba bzhin/ da lta'i rang lus su snang ba dang / phyi'i snang ba gang shar ba/ de dang de snga ma bzhin du rdo rje 'chang chen po'i skur lam gyis bskyed de/ sgyu ma lta bu bden med du shes par byas la/cung zad cung zad mnyam par 'jog pa rtag tu goms par byas nas thun mtshams kyi nyams len yang 'di nyid kho nas bya'o/ /gsum pa la/ rmi lam lha skur bsgyur ba/ rmi lam du ngo shes pa byed pa/rmi lam la re dogs spangs pa/ rmi lam gyi sems dngos su spyong ba ste bzhi'o//dang po ni/ nyin par sngar bzhin bsgoms pa'i steng du do nub rmi lam du lha skur sgom pa 'di nyid dran par bya'o zhes 'phen pa yang yang btang zhing / nyal khang yang 'phen pa dang dmigs pa sbrags mar bya/ des rmi lam du sgyu lus kyi dmigs pa sgom nus pa 'byung ngo / /—183—
