yang rjes gzhig gi rim pas bsdus te don gyi 'od gsal du mos/ yang lhar skyes te zung 'jug tu mos pa byed do/ /yang na stong par 'jug ldang lan gnyis mi byed par/ sems dmigs dang 'od gsal rnam pa 'dra bas/ snang bzhi'i sdud rim gcig po de la/ sems dben gyi rim pa dang 'od gsal gyi rim pa gnyis kar mos pa nyis sbrag bya/ skyu lus dang / zung 'jug kyang yod lugs 'dra bas lha skur langs thengs gcig po de la mos pa gnyis ka bya'o/ /de ltar bsgoms pas da lta rim pa lnga'i sa lam rgyud la skyes pa ga la zhig rgyu'i ye shes kyang dngos su shar ba min mod/ rdo rje lus la gnad du bsnun pa ni yin zhing /bskyed rim gyi sku gsum mos pa lam byed sogs dang 'dra bar/ /rim pa lnga'i ye shes dang / sa lam de rnams myur du rgyud la skye ba'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyu rten 'brel sgrig phyogs bla na med pa yin pas/ rim pa lnga stan thog gcig tu rdzogs par bya zhes bya'o/ /de nas kyang dmigs pa de nyid bsgoms pa dang / rtsa lam byang ba dang / snang bzhi'i nyams dang / lha sku'i gsal snang cung zad tsam rim gyis rim gyis skye zhing / go rim ni gcig tu nges pa yang med do/ /de'i tshe/bde stong dang lha sku de dngos su na/ lus dben nam/ ngag dben gyi rim pa gang rung yin yang / rim pa gzhan rnams la'ang rjes mthun pa'i nyams myong skyes rjes mthun pa'i ye shes shar ba yin pas/ rim lnga'i nyams myong stan thog gcig tu rdzogs pa zhes bya'o/ /de ltar ma go bas/ mkhas rmongs so so la za zi langs lugs mi 'dra ba du ma byung ngo / /de ltar bsgoms pa'i phan yon ni/ don gyi 'od gsal thob na 'khor ba —295—

so sor skye bo'i sa las ni rgal zhing / 'phags pa'i gnas pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /de'i phyir rdzogs rim gyi ye shes bde stong dang lha skur rang shar rgyud la skyes pa nas gzung ste dang por thun gcig 'byongs ba 'byung la/ de nas rim pas nyin gcig gam/ zla ba phyed dang / zla ba gcig dang / lo'i dus kyi bar du yang bsgom dgos shing / sgyu lus kyi sku dngos thob nas ni bskal pa gcig gam/bskal pa stong gi bar du yang rung ste/ de ltar ngang gis gnas kyang gnas la/'khor 'das kun na de las lhag pa'i don g.yin med pas/ rgyun bsrings te bsgom dgos kyang dgos so/ /de yang rlung dbu mar thim pa'i bde stong gi ye shes bya rdzogs kyi skad cig ma re rer gnas pa las/ nam zhig langs pa'i tshe lha sku rang shar re re 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de ltar 'khor lo can la rgyas bshad mdzad pa ni/ rim lnga stan thog gcig ma 'khor lo can 'di la go ba shar na/'khor lo med pa sogs gzhan rnams shugs la go ba'i dbang du mdzad pa'o/ /gnyis pa bskyed rdzogs spyi'i bsgom tshul gsal bar bstan pa la/bstan bshad gnyis kyi dang po ni/ rim pa gnyis po la gnas pa/ mnyam par zung 'brel nyid du bsgom/ /zhes ste/ 'dis ni gnyis po la nyams myong ma skyes bar du/ thun stod la bskyed rim dang / thun smad la rdzogs rim sgom pa'am/thun dang po la bskyed rim dang / gnyis pa la rdzogs rim bsgom pa lta bu'i zung 'brel yang bstan/ gnyis ka la nyams myong cung zad shar na/ phan tshun du rgyas 'debs shing / gang rung gcig kho na la nyams myong shar na/ des cig shos la rgyas 'debs pa'i zung 'jug gi tshul du sgrub pa yang bstan to/ /spyir yang zung —296—

'brel la zung 'jug gis ma khyab/ ceng 'jug la zung 'brel gyis khyab bo zhes pa'ang go bar bya'o/ /lar skabs 'dir rim lnga las/ bskyed pa'i rim la legs gnas shing / /rdzogs pa'i rim pa 'dod rnams la/ /thabs 'di rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /skas kyi rim pa lta bur gsungs/ /zhes pa'i don la nges pa rnyed dgos so/ /gnyis pa rgyas bshad la/ bskyed rim/ lus dben/ ngag dben/sems dben/ bdag byin rlabs mngon par byang chub/ mi gnas pa'i myang 'das kyi rim pa ste bdun las/ dang po ni/ bskyed pa'i rim ste lha yi sku/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi dkyil 'khor mchog /rnam pa mngon du byed pa gang //legs par bslabs pas mthar phyin 'gyur/ /zhes te/ rim pa gnyis las bskyed pa'i rim pa 'di ni/ ngo bo lha sku la gsal snang du shar ba'i ting nge 'dzin te/ bsgom bya rgyal ba rigs lnga la sogs pa/ dkyil 'khor kyi 'khor lo mchog de dag rnam pa ni gsal snang mngon sum du byed pa gang yin pa ste/ man ngag bzhin du lha sku'i gsal snang dang / lha'i nga rgyal dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi rim pa rnams la legs par bslabs pas dbang po rno na lo gcig tsam gyis mthar phyin par 'gyur te/ mthar phyin pa'i tshad ni/ reg pa dang mthong ba'i tshad ma rnyed pa'o/ /bskyed rim da lta blos gsal 'debs pa ni/ rgyu tsam yin la goms nas gsal snang shar na ni/ bskyed rim dngos su 'gyur te ye shes kyi ming can no/ /de yang ngo bo dkyil 'khor gsal snang rtog med dang / nga rgyal dang rtsol ba rtog bcas gnyis 'dus yin zhing / rgyu ni snga rol nas rtog pa goms pa las byung ba/—297—

rnam pa mar la 'khor ba'i 'chi bar skye gsum dang mthun/ yar la sangs rgyas kyi sku gsum dang mthun/ bar du rdzogs rim dang rnam pa mthun pas/ dag rdzogs smin gsum lam du byed pa/ grogs rtsol bcas kyi bde ba dang stong pas brgyan pa cig la bskyed rim dngos zer/ mtshan nyid de rnams ma tshang ba'i lha bsgom sngags bzlas ni/ bskyed rim dngos ma yin rjes mthun pa'o/ /dbye na rags pa la sems zin pa dran pa gcig pa'i rnal 'byor dang / phra ba la sems zin pa rtog pa'i rnal 'byor gnyis yod/ dkyil 'khor rgyas bsdus kyi dbye ba dang rnal 'byor bzhi dang / ting 'dzin gsum dang / yan lag drug la sogs pa'i dbye ba rgyas par shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ lus dben snang ba sems dang lus/ khyu dang mi rgyu 'jig rten bcas/ /rim pas lha yi bdag nyid sbyor/ /rdo rje 'chang chen lam du byed//mos pa las byung ting nge 'dzin/ /rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'o/ /zhes te/lus rnam par dben pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ sems tshor ba sogs phung po bzhi dang / yid kyi dbang po sogs dang / lus gzugs phung dang / dbang po lnga dang /yul lnga ste/ lus sems de dag ni rgyu ba nang sems can gyis bsdus pa dang /'gyung ba bzhi ni phyi nang gnyis ka dang / yul lnga ni mi rgyu ba phyis bsdus yin pa las/ phyi'i 'byung ba bzhi ni mi rgyu ba snod dang / nang gi 'byung ba bzhi ni sems can gyi lus so/ /de ltar na/ phung po lnga/ 'gyung ba bzhi/ dbang po lnga/ yul lnga dang ye shes sam/ yang na yid rnams la lnga lngar phye ba/ snod kyi 'jig rten dang bcas pa'i 'khor ba'i snang ba/ dbye ba brgya phrag gcig po 'di dag re re bzhin —298—

rim pas dam pa rigs brgyas bsdus pa'i lha'i bdag nyid du sbyor zhing / de la goms nas rigs lnga dang / rigs gsum gyi dbye ba la bslab/ mthar gsang chen rigs gcig tu 'gyur ba yin yang / lus dben gyi rim pa'i skabs 'dir/rigs brgya rdzogs sam ma rdzogs kyang rung ste/ rigs brgyar gtogs pa'i lhar snang gi ting nge 'dzin cig dngos su thob par byas nas/ rgyal ba rigs lnga ste ye shes lnga'i rjes btab dang / gsang ba rigs gsum ste rdo rje gsum gyi rgyas btab dang / gsang chen rigs gcig ste rdo rje 'chang chen bde ba chen po'i rgyas bto rnams/ da lta dngos su ma thob mod/ mos pa las byung ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi lam du byed cing / de ltar mos pas rigs brgya dang rigs gcig gi bar de dag gi go 'phang mngon du 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel legs par bsgrib pa'o/ /'dir phung khams rigs brgya ni/ phung po lnga/ 'gyung ba bzhi/ dbang po lnga/ yul lnga rnams la lnga lngar phye bas/ dgu bcu go lnga yod/ de'i steng du yid lnga'am ye shes lnga ste/ lnga tshan gnyis po gang rung gcig dkyus su bcug pas brgya tham pa 'ong / lnga tshan cig shos de spyi khyab tu btang ngo/ /dam pa rigs brgya ni/ rgyal ba rigs lnga/ yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' lnga/ rdo rje ma lnga rnams la re re bzhin rigs lngas phye bas dgu bcu go lnga byung / ye shes lnga'i dbang du byas nas/rgyal ba rigs lnga spyi 'gro zhig snon pa'am/ yid kyi dbang du byas nas 'jam dpal rigs lnga bsnan pas brgya tham pa'o/ /lus dben gyi ngo bo ni/ rags pa'i rlung rags pa'i dbu mar cung zad thim pa'i bde stong gi ngang las rnam rtog gis ma skyed par/ yid ngo kho nar rang —299—

shar ba'i lha sku'o/ /yang de tsam min kyang stong pa'i nyams myong cung zad bsgom pa'i ngang nas/ rtsol med du lha skur 'char tsam byung na/ lus dben rjes mthun pa yin no/ stong par mos pa'i ngang nas/ rtsol bcas kyi lha sku skyed na/ ngo bo'i sgo nas bskyed rim kho na las ma 'das kyang lus dben du mos pas/ 'brel ba'i sgo nas lus dben gyi rgyu khyad par can du 'gyur ro/ /deng sang gi las dang po pa la 'khrid 'bogs pa'i tshe/ de tsam gyis lus dben gyi dmigs pa go chod par 'gyur te/ de'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa ni/ rlung gi 'byung 'jug gnas pa gsum/ sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje las/ rlung sngags mnyam par sbyor ba gang / /rdo rje'i bzlas pa'i rim pa'o/ /zhes te/ rlud gi rgyu ba phyir 'byung ba ni/ rlung de dang thugs kyi rdo rje'i sngags hu yig mnyam par rab tu sbyor ba dang / rlung 'jug pa dang sku rdo rje'i sngags o yig mnyam par sbyor ba dang / rlung gnas pa dang gsung rdo rje'i sngags ā yig mnyam par rab tu sbyor ba rnams/ rtsa dbu ma'i rlung du gyur pa gang yin pa de ni/ ngag dben rdo rje'i bzlas pa'i rim pa'o/ /de la gong du smos pa ltar/yi ge 'bru gsum ngag tshig dang bcas pa'ang srid mod kyi nges par dgos pa ma yin/ yi ge 'bru gsum gyi don rdo rje gsum gyi ye shes yin zhing / de grib ma'i tshul gyis nyams su lon na rlung gi rnal 'byor gang byas kyang / rdo rje gsum gyi rnal 'byor las ma 'das pas rdo rje'i bzlas pa'o/ /de la dbye na gsum/gdong gi sna rtser 'od kyi thig le sgom pa zhes bya ba rtsa ba'i rlung dang yan lag gi rlung la/ rtsa lam sbyong ba'i rdor bzlas byed pa dang / snying ga'i sna rtser mi shigs —300—

pa'i thig le sgom pa zhes pa/ snying ga gtso bor gyur pa'i rtsa 'khor rnams su/yig 'bru'am thig le sogs la sems bzung bas/ rlung dang thig le ga tir 'ching ba dang gsang ba'i sna rtser rdzas kyi thig le sgom pa zhes bya ba/ las sam ye shes kyi phyag rgya bsten pas/ rlung sems dbu mar zhugs gnas thim gsum byed pa ste gsum mo/ /'dir rdzas zhes pa thig le kun da lta bu'i byang chub kyi sems yin la/ de nyid gsang ba'i sna rtser bsgom zhes gsungs pas/ 'khor lo bzhi la lugs 'byung lugs zlog yin te/ rdo rje 'phreng bar yang de la rgyas bshad mdzad pas/ gang dag 'phags skor gyi lugs la/ steng 'og phyogs mtshams kyi rtsa gnas nas byang chub kyi sems zhu ba snying gar 'du ba kho na yin gyi/ 'khor lo bzhi la 'gro 'ong byed pa min zhes 'chad pa ni mi 'thad de/ snying ga 'ba' zhig tu bsdus pa la/ gsang ba'i sna rtser bsgom pa'i tha snyad mi 'thad pa'i phyir ro/ /bzhi pa ni/ gsang sngags las byung rnam par shes/ snang ba gsum gyi bdag nyid ni/ ye shes 'byung zlog nges pa gang / sems la dmigs pa'i rim pa'o/ /gsang sngags te rlung rnams rdo rje gsum gyi ye shes su gyur pa de nyid goms pa las/ 'bar 'dzag gi ye shes bde stong lhan cig skyes pa 'byung la/de ni rnam par shes pa ste snang ba gsum gyi bdag nyid kyi ye shes 'jug pa ste/snang ba thim nas mched pa shar/ de thim nas thob pa tsam po shar/ de thim nas thob pa khyad par can dpe'i 'od gsal la ring du mnyam par 'jog go /zlog pa ni/ thob pa khyad par can de las langs nas/ thob pa phal pa skye/ de —301—

las snang ba skye/ de las sa sogs 'byung bzhi'am khams lnga skye bas rnam rtog phal pa 'byung ngo de lta bu'i 'jug ldog nges pa gang zhig rtag tu sgom pa ni/sems la dmigs pa'i rim pa'o/ /'dir nges dgos pa chi// snang ba bzhi dang / dga' ba bzhi don gcig ste/ snang ba dga' ba/ mched pa mchog dga' thob pa khyad dga'/ sems dben gyi rim pa'i skabs/ nyer thob skad cig bzhi pa dang / 'od gsal gyi rim pa la zhugs nas/ skad cig bzhi pa 'od gsal rang ste/ de gnyis ni lhan cig skyes dga' 'o/ /'on kyang lugs zlog gi tshe/ don gcig kyang ming mi 'dra ste/ thob pa la dga' ba mchog dga' gnyis dang / mched pa khyad dga' dang / snang ba lhan skyes so/ /sems dben rang gi ngo bo ni/ rnam rtog gi bzhon pa'i rlung rnams sgom stobs kyis rtsa 'khor rnams kyi lte bar thim pas thig le brtan par gyur pa'i bde stong gi ye shes yin la/ de sgrub par byed pa'i thabs ni/ rang lus gzhan lus gnyis kas las byed cing / rim lnga las/ 'dod chags nyid dang chags bral dang / /de yi bar te gsum po ni/ /dbang po gnyis ni mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /rdo rje pad+ma 'dus las so/ /zhes sems dben gyi sgrub pa las rgya nyid gtso bor gsungs pa lta bur yod kyang / zhib mor na/ snang ba'i sa/ mched pa'i sa thob pa tsam po'i sa rnams steng sgo 'ba' zhig gis kyang sgrub tu rung la/nyer thob bzhi pa'i sa thob pa ni/ nges par phyi rol gyi phyag rgya la rag las pa'o//zhes pa'ang spyir btang la nges pa yin no/ /snang gsum lugs zlog ni snga phyi gong 'og thams cad du 'byung mod kyi/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa'i rim pa man ho la lus —302—

ma rdzogs pa dang / rgyu lus kyi rim pa yan chad la/ gsar thob ma yin pa'i phyir ma smos la/ 'dir lus rdzogs pa gsar thob yin pa'i phyir smos so/ /de ltar yang / 'phags pas/ stong nyid shin tu stong pa dang / /gsum pa stong ba chen po dang / /bzhi pa thams cad stong pa ni/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu'i bye brag go /zhes lugs 'gyung gi tshe gzhan gsum rgyu/ bzhi pa 'bras bu/ lugs zlog dang sbyar na/ de nyid rgyu/ gzhan gsum 'bras bu'o/ /yang skad cig ma'i snang ba bzhi dang /snang ba'i sa bzhi po yang dbye ba phyed pa yang gal che ste/ rim lnga'i 'grel chen du rgyas par bshad zin cing / cung zad 'og tu 'chad do/ /lnga pa ni/ rmi lam lus ni rnam sbyang phyir/ /sgyu mar mtshon pa'i dus gang las/ /yul snang kun rdzob gang byung ba/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i rim pa'o/ /zhes te/ de la bdag byin brlab pa'i rim pa'i ye shes ni/ rgyu 'od gsal kyi rlung sems tsam las grub pa/ rkyen dang por snang gsum gyi rim pas/ las rlud mi shigs pa la thim pa'i bde ba shar/ bde ba de slar yang snang gsum lugs zlog tu shar ba las skyes pa'o/ /rnam pa ni gtso bo med du mi rung ba/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dang / zhar byung dag ma dag gi snang ba sna tsho gis dang bcas pa/ byed las rnal 'byor pa'i rang snang du lus kyi bya ba byed nus dang / nyams kyi khyad par gnas lugs mtshon par nus pa'i zhu bde'i bde stong gis khyab pa ste/ khyad par lnga lngan de ni/ bdag byin brlab pa'i mtshan nyid yin pa las/ mnyam bzhag sgyu lus la mtshan nyid thams cad gsal bar rdzogs pa yin zhing rjes thob sgyu lus la ni thams cad tshang bar gcis tu nges pa yang ma yin no/ /rim lnga las/ de —303—

nyid rlung dang yang dag ldan/ /rnam shes gsum po slar yang ni/ /rnal 'byor pa yi lus su 'gyur / /sgyu ma'i lus zhes de la bshad/ /ces mnyam bzhag sgyu lus kyi gtso bo dang / de bas 'di ltar 'gro ba kun/ /sgyu ma lta bur 'dir bshad de//sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin gnas/ /thams cad de dang 'dra bar mthong / /zhes mnyam bzhag sgyu lus kyi yan lag ye shes kyi sku shes bya la spro ba dang / rjes thob sgyu ma yang bstan to/ /sgyu ma'i sku la dpe bcu gnyis yod pa las/ dpe'i gtso bo gsum ni/ me long nang gi gzugs brnyan gyis/ /sgyu ma'i lus ni mtshon par bya/ kha dog rnams ni 'ja' lta bu/ khyab pa chu yi zla bas so/ /zhes gsungs so/ /spyir rnal 'byor pas ni gang gang dmigs/ /de de sgyu ma bzhin du brtag /ces snang ni snang yang bden ni mi bden pa sgyu ma lta bur rtogs pa zhig mnyam rjes kun tu dgos pa yin mod kyang / 'dir dpe 'di rnams bden med rkyang pa la mi sbyor te/ ye shes kyi sku'i mtshan nyid so so la sbyor ro/ /de yang / me long gi gzugs brnyan skad cig la rdzogs pa ltar/ /sku'am dkyil 'khor yang skad cig gis rdzogs pa dang / me long dwangs pa la gzugs brnyan shar/ shar ba'i dus na yang me long las ma 'das pa ltar/ bde stong lhan skyes las lha skur shar zhing shar zin pa'i dus na yang bde stong gi nyams dang ma bral ba'o/ /'ja' tshon ni chu zil dang / 'od las kha dog gsal bar snang ba ltar/ 'byung lus rags pa med kyang rlung sems phra mo las dbyibs dang kha dog ma 'dres par yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /'byung lus rags pa med kyang phra mo ni yod do/ /chu zla lta bu ni zla ba gcig shar chu klung kun la yongs su khyab pa ltar ye shes kyi sku —304—

gcig nyid snang ba sna tshogs pa la spro bar nus pa'o/ /de ltar go bar byas te rmi lam gyi lus kyis mtsho ni pa/ bar do la sogs pa gsal snang gi lus thams cad/ rnam par dag cing sbyong ba'i phyir/ lam 'di bsgom dgos pa ste/ sgyu lus kyi sbyang bya phra mo'i snang ba la zhen pa ste/ de rmi lam dang bar do'i thabs la brten nas sbyong zhes pa'o/ /ji skad du/ kun rdzob bden pa sgyu ma nyid/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku yang de/ /de nyid dri za'i sems can gyur/ /rdo rje'i sku yang de nyid yin/ /zhes so/ /man ngag pa snga ma rnams/ sgyu lus kyi sbyang gzhi rmi lam zhes zer ba yang de la bsams shing / rmi lam longs sku'i dang bar do longs sku tha snyad kyang 'di dag la brten no/ /rmi lam du lha sku bden med sgyu ma lta bur shar bas rkyen byas te sad dus kyi snang ba thams cad sgyu mar mtshon nus pa'i dus der mnyam bzhag tu snang stong skyu ma tsam shar ba na/ rjes thob tu yul snang kun kun rdzob snyu ma lta bur rtogs pa gang zhig 'byung ba de ni/ sgyu ma lta bu ste sgyu lus kyi rim pa'i man ngag go /gzhung chung 'dir rtags dang rtags can zhes sogs kyi skabs/ ye shes kyi sku'i mawo nyid zugad zin pas skabs 'dir ni/ las dang po pa nyid kyi sgom tshul/ sgyu lus kyi sgrub pa nyams len gsal bar bstan to/ /rje btsun mar pa lho brag pa'i gdams pa rnams las/ rim lnga dang chos drug gi gdams pa rnams su/ rmi lam dang bar do'i gdams ngag rnams sgyu lus kyi yan lag tu mdzad la/ ma rgyud kyi gdams ngag 'ga' rer/ rmi lam gyi gdams ngag sgyu lus kyi rtsa bar mdzad pa yang yod de/ gzhung tshig 'dir yang de lta bu'o/ /—305—

drug pa ni/ rang bzhin shes pa'i bsam gtan las/ thabs las ma skyes ting nge 'dzin/ /rang gsal ngo bo mi rtog pa/ /'od gsal don dam rig pa'o/ /zhes te 'dir/ rang bzhin shes pa'i bsam gtan las/ /zhes pas 'od gsal gyi sgrub pa bstan/ 'od gsal don dam rim pa'o/ /zhes pas/ don gyi 'od gsal mthong lam mngon par byang chub bstan/ thabs la ma brten sogs tshig rkang bar pa gnyis kyis 'od gsal gyi rim pa'i dmigs yul rtogs bya don dam bden pa dngos chos dbyings nyid bstan to/ /'dir rtogs byed lam gyi 'od gsal la yang don dam bden pa zhes bya ste/ don dam rtogs tshul la bslu med du bya ba byed nus yin pa'i phyir ro/ /des na lam 'dis dngos su rtogs par bya rgyu'i yul ni thabs te rgyu las ma byung zhing ma skyes pa'i ting nge 'dzin te rang bzhin bde ba chen po dang de nyid gdod ma nas rang gsal ba rnam par thams cad pa dang / rang gi ngo bo spros pa thams cad las yongs su 'das pa'i rnam par mi rtog pa'i stong nyid te dgag phyogs kyi sgo nas ma skyes pa dang /sgrub phyogs kyi sgo nas bde gsal mi rtog pa gsum ste/ mtshan nyid bzhi ldan du 'dir bstan to/ /gzhan ting nge 'dzin yin na thabs kyis sgrubs pa kho nar nges pa la chos dbyings 'di ni rtse gcig pa'i sems mthar thug yin pas/ ting nge 'dzin gyi mchog yin yang thabs kyis ma skyed de rang byung ngo / /ting nge 'dzin zhes pa ni/ sa bā dhi'i sgra las/ yang dag par kun nas 'dzin/ rtag tu 'dzin pa ste mi 'gyur bar yang 'dren pas/ mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba zhes pa'i don du 'gyur ba yang go dgos so/ /stong pa'i mtshan nyid ni mi rtog pa kho na te/ de yang rang —306—

rig yin gyi med dgag ben stong ma yin no/ /rim pa 'di mthar thug pa na gnas lugs de mngon sum du rtogs pa yin la/ de'i sgrub pa ni/ rang bzhin gnas lugs de la gsal bar dmigs shing shes nus pa'i bsam gtan gnyis kyis sgrub par byed do/ /de yang spyod bsdus sgron me las/ chu bo'am steng ka'i chu ni dri med dag la gong bur gnas pa ltar/ de bzhin de la rjes su gzhig pa rnal 'byor bas ni rtag tu bsam/ me long la ni rlung dag rim gyis zad pa bzhin du'ang blta bya ste/ril por 'dzin la'ang bya ba'i rim pa de bzhin 'dir ni yang dag brtag /ces gsungs la/ rim lnga las kyang / man ngag thob pa'i slob ma yis/ /de nas rnal 'byor rnam gnyis bslab/ /ril por 'dzin pa'i rim pa dang / /de bzhin rjes su gzhig pa'o/ /zhes sogs gsal bar gsungs te/ las dang po pas rnam pa lam byed du bskyed rim gyi dmigs pas bsgom pa'i tshe ni/ 'od zer spro bsdu sogs kyi rkyen las/ rang lus 'ba' zhig stong par bsdu ba ril 'dzin dang / snod bcud thams cad mtha' nas dbus su rim gyis bsdu ba rjes gzhig tu grags pa ltar yin la/ 'od gsal gyi rim pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas ni/de 'dra bsgom mi dgos/ de'i mar+sā don bsgom pa yin pas gtso bor rang gi lus dang / gzhan yang gdong thug tu gang snang ba de la/ bde stong gis rgyas btab pas snang ba de ni de 'phral dus gcig tu nub nas stong par thim pa ste/de ni ril por 'dzin pa yin la/ snang ba rgya bskyed pa thams cad la bde stong gis rgyas btab ste bsgom na/ 'di dmigs yul rgya che bas/ dus gcig tu stong —307—

par thim mi 'gro bar/ rim pas thim 'gro ba ni rjes su gzhig pa'o/ /rim pa thim tshul gnyis te/ yul snang ba thams cad kyi steng du gcig car/ stong nyams je che la stong par thim 'gro ba gcig dang / yul dngos po gcig dang por thim phyis gzhan rim pas thim 'gro ba gcig go /lam 'od gsal gyi rim pa'i ngo bo ni lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ba chen pos stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs par byed pa'i lam yin la/ rgyu ni snang ba bzhi'i rim pas 'jug pa dang / yul ni/bdag byin brlab pa'i rim gyis ni/ /'od gsal ba ni thob par 'gyur/ /zhes ye shes kyi sku la gtso bor dmigs te sgom pa yin/ byed las ni rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rnam rtog rlung dang bcas pa'i sa bon 'joms pa'am 'joms pa la phyogs pa'o/ /rim pa 'di'i mthar phyi nang gi mngon byang las/ don gyi 'od gsal thob par 'gyur ro/ /mngon byang ni/ rim lnga las/ mtshan mo snang ba'i cha ste gsal ba nyi ma'i zer 'gyed snang ba mched pa yin/ /mtshams ni snang ba thob pa rang gi rang bzhin rnams kyis lan gcig min par 'gro/ /mtshan min nyin par ma yin mtshams min gang zhig rang bzhin rnams dang gang bral ba/ /de ni byang chub skad cig yin par bla ma mchog bshad rnal 'byor pa nyid yul/ /mtshams kyi mtha' ni 'jig min mun nag tshogs ni ma lus gang du 'das pa dang / /ji srid nyi ma ma shar skad cig 'dir ni dri med yang dag mtha' ru bshad/ /slob dpon mchog ni rab rib bral bas slob ma la ni phyi rol byang chub bstan/ /nang gi bde ba rnyog bral sangs rgyas byang chub skad cig dag gis thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar nye rgyu rig brtul gyi dang der rdo rje slob —308—

dpon nam sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku gzhan gyis dbang bskur bas don kyi 'od gsal mthong lam thob pa des/ 'od gsal gyi rim pa rdzogs so/ /bdun pa ni/ bsam gtan mes sbyangs lha yi sku/ /rang byung ye shes dag pa'i lus/ /sbyang gzhi sbyong byed bral bar gnas/ /zung tu 'jug pa'i rim pa'o/zhes te/ sngar sgyu lus kyi rim pa'i skabs ma dag pa'i sgyu lus rang bzhin brgyad cu dang / snang ba gsum gyi dri mar bcas pa de/ 'od gsal gyi rim par bsam gtan gnyis kyi mes sbyangs pas/ spang bya dri ma de rnams sa bon dang bcas pa spangs shing / sngar gyi sku de'i ye shes kyi cha'i rgyun de zung 'jug gi lha'i skur 'gyur bas/ rang byung gdod ma'i ye shes kyi sku mthong spangs dang nyon sgrib spangs pas dag pa'i sgyu lus slob pa'i zung 'jug de/ don gyi 'od gsal thob pa'i rjes thogs bar ma chad par 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /ji skad du/ gzugs bcas 'od zer de dang de/ /rnam shes rlung dang ldan pa yis/ /bdag byin brlab pa'i rim gyis kyang / /sems can don du'ang lan 'ga' 'byung / /ji ltar dwangs ba'i chu klung las/ /nya dag rab tu ldang ba ltar/ /de bzhin thams cad stong gsal las/ /sgyu 'phru/la drwa ba 'byung bar 'gyu/ra/ /zhes bsha/da pa ltar/ sngar 'od gsal gyi rim pa'i skabs su ldang 'jug de bzhin goms pa las/ 'dir 'od gsal gyi rim pa las ngang gis langs nas/ zung 'jug dbang phyug brgyad dang ldan pa rtsol med du 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /zung 'jug thog mar 'grub pa'i sa mtshams ni mnyam bzhag yin gyi/ rjes thob tu 'dod pa ni nor ba'o/ /sgom stobs kyi lam gang la rang rang gi rigs mthun gyi mnyam bzhag sngon du song —309—

nas rjes thob 'byung ba yin gyi/ rjes thob sngon la yod pa don la mi srid par ma zad/ ming tsam gyi sgo nas kyang / rang gis rang nyid sun phyung ba'o/ /yang 'od gsal mnyam bzhag yin zhing / 'di de'i rjes thob yin pas mi 'gal snyam na/'od gsal gyi rim pa'i mnyam bzhag gi mthar/ rjes thob yong na/ rim pa de nyid kyi rjes thob 'ong ba 'thad kyi/ zung 'jug gi rim pa'i rjes thob ga la 'ong /des na zung 'jug kyang yin la/ rjes thob kyang yin pa zhig yod na/ de'i sngon du zung 'jug kyang yin la mnyam bzhag kyang yin pa zhig nges par 'gro dgos so//mi slob pa'i zung 'jug ni/ sbyang gzhi chos nyid dang / sbyong byed lam gyi dbye ba dang bral ba ste/ rtogs bya rtogs byed/ yul yul can gyi dbye ba med par rtag tu gnas pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang ste/ 'dir yang thugs chos sku dang sku longs sku zung 'jug ces tha snyad byed de/ sku dang thugs ngo bo tha dad gtan nas med do/ /rim pa lnga las zung 'jug pa'i rim pa'o/ /'dir zung 'jug gi mtshan nyid rnam grangs mang du bshad kyang / ji skad du/ de nyid shes par rim shes nas/ /bdag byin brlab dang 'od gsal ba/ /de nyid la ni 'dus pa gang / /zung tu 'jug pa'i rim 'di yin/ /zhes skad dang ye shes zung 'jug bshad de/ mtshan nyid 'di gtso bo yin la/ /kun rdzob dang ni don dam dag /so so'i cha ni shes gyur nas/ /gang du yang dag 'dres gyur pa/ /zung du 'jug par de bshad do/ /zhes bden gnyis zung 'jug dang / gzung ba dang ni 'dzin par zhes/ rnam gnyis blo ni yod min te/ /gang du mi phyed blo yod pa/ /de ni zung 'jug ces byar bshad/ /ces zung 'jug gnyis med kyi don dang / de —310—

yang gzung 'dzin spangs shing ye shes yod pa la 'jog pa ni gnyis med zung 'jug ste/ mtshan nyid kyi rnam grangs 'di gnyis kyang rags bshad kyi tshe'ang nges par dgos pa'o/ /zung 'jug go 'phang la gnas pa/ slob bzhin pa yi rnal 'byor che/ /zung du 'jug pa bsgom gyur pas/ /spyod pa'ang de dang gnyis su med/ /ces pas slob pa'i zung 'jug ste/ dbye na 'phags lam gyi sa bcu'am bcu gnyis so/ /ga d+ma'i klung gi bye snyed kyi/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis 'di nyid dag /thugs chud yod med phyogs spangs pas/ /phyag rgya chen por bdag nyid grub/ /ces pa 'di mi slob pa'i zung 'jug ste/ dbye ba ni/ sku bzhi ye shes lnga/ zung 'jug rim pa la gnas nas/ /slar zhing gang la'ang mi slob bo/ /zhes pa'i mi slob ces pas mi slob pa'i zung 'jug ston pa ma yin/ zung 'jug thob nas lam rigs mi mthun la bslab mi dgos/ zhes slob mi slob kyi zung 'jug gnyis kar la 'jug go /lam gyi bogs 'byin rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa'i spros bcas spros med shin tu spros med kyi sprod pa'i rnam gzhag rnams/ spyod bsdus sgron me las shes par bya la/ zur tsam zhig 'og tu ston to/ /gsum pa rnam gzhag g.yin rnams de la tshang tshul la/ rgyud sbyang ba/rnal 'byor bzhi/ ting nge 'dzin gsum/ bsnyen sgrub bzhi/ sbyor ba yan lag drugaphyag rgya bzhi/ gzhan yang tha snyad sna tshogs pa'i mtshone tshul la/ dang po ni/ byang chub sems ldan bla ma dang / /zhes te/ thog mar don 'dir pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam ma lus sam/ bla ma rten tshul yang ji lta bu snyam na/ lam bskyed rdzogs 'di —311—

dag kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems brtse ba snying rje chen po dang rtag tu ldan par sgrub dgos/ don dam byang chub kyi sems bdag med gnyis ldan gyi stong nyid du shes pas rtag tu zin dgos te/ stong nyid snying rje der lam gyi rnam grangs gzhan thams cad 'dus so/ /phyogs tsam mtshon na byams pa dang snying rje ni kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi rgyu yin/ las 'bras kyi blang dor ni dad pa yin/ dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bsam pa ni/nges 'byung sgrub byed yin/ dad pa dang nges 'byung gi bsam pa yang / byang chub kyi sems kyi cha lag tsam yin zhing / byams snying rje'i rgyu rkyen tsam yin pas/ de thams cad kun rdzob byang sems su 'dus / nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims thams cad kyang las 'bras kyi blang dor du 'dus/ phung khams skye mched rten 'brel sogs mkhas par bya ba'i dngos po drug la mkhas pa thams cad dang /bden bzhi mi rtag la sogs bcu drug gi rnam pa sgom pa'i lam rnams kyang stong nyid du 'dus pas// byang chub kyi sems gnyis bsgoms pas theg pa gzhan gyi lam thams cad kyang 'dir 'dus/ byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba bla ma rdo rje slob dpon yin na/ rgyud las gsungs pa'i sten tshul ma nor ba dang / rtag tu bla ma'i mos gus kyis lam 'khrid pa yin no/ /sems bskyed dang mos gus bshad pas thun mong dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro thams cad bstan pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ lhag pa'i lha yi rnal 'byor dang / khren tu rnal 'byor rnal 'byor che/ /rjes su rnal 'byor bcas pa dag /ces pa'i rjes su rnal 'byor zhes pa yan chad de/ lhag pa'i lha yi zhes pa dngos grub ster ba'i yi dam lha —312—

tshogs kyi ting nge 'dzin sgom pa ste/ rnal 'byor bzhi ma zad ting nge 'dzin gsum dang / yan lag bzhi rnams la'ang sbyar ro/ /skabs 'dir 'phags skor nyid dang sbyar na/ srung 'khor dang lhag mos sogs sngon 'gro tsam yin/ dngos gzhi las/ mngon byang dang po gnyis rnal 'byor/ phyi ma gsum rjes su rnal 'byor/rdor sems longs sku sprul skur bsgyur ba dang / lus dkyil shin tu rnal 'byor/sku gsung thugs byin rlabs/ sems dpa' gsum brtsegs/ rgyas btab/ rjes chags kyi mchog pa'i bar du rnal 'byor chen po'o/ /gzhung tshig 'di la rjes su rnal 'byor tha mar byung ba ni/ tshig bcad sbyor ba'i dbang tsam yin no/ /de ltar rnal 'byor bzhi'i bskyed rim ni/ phal cher gyis rdzogs rim gyi sngon du 'bad pas sgom dgos pa'ang yin mod kyi/ rdzogs rim nyid la'ang de dag tshang ste/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa ni rnal 'byor/ snang ba gsum ni rjes su rnal 'byor/ sgyu lus ni shin tu rnal 'byor/ 'od gsal ni rnal 'byor chen po'o/ /gsum pa ni/ sngar dwangs pa yi bcas pa dag /ces pa'i rjes su/ ting 'dzin rim par ldan pa nyid/ /ces pa ste/ de yang dang po sbyor ba dang / dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog dang / las rgyal mchog ni/ ting nge 'dzin gsum gyi rim pa ste/ lugs 'di'i dkyil 'khor rgyas pa zhig cho ga rgyas pas bsgom na/ rim pa de dang ldan par bsgom dgos so/ /des mtshon nas lha bsdus pa gtso bo yab yum tsam zhig cho ga rgyas pas bsgom na/ dang por dngos gzhi tsam zhig bsgom/dkyil 'khor rgyas pa cho ga bsdus pas bsgom na/ skad cig gis bskyed pa dang /sa bon dang phyag mtshan tsam gyis bskyed nas/ cho ga lhag ma cung zad sbyar ba'o//—313—

gnyis ka bsdus pa ni/ lha re re skad cig gis bskyed pa sogs te/bskyed chog bsdus pa 'di rnams lhag mos kyi rigs yin no/ /'dir bcas pa dag ces pa ni/ rnal 'byor bzhi ni dang po sbyor ba'i dbye ba yin pas/ ting 'dzin gsum bsgom na shugs la rnal 'byor bzhi dang bcas par 'gyur zhes rtse/ /des na rnal 'byor bzhi po dang sbyor ba yin la/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs spro ba ni dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog dang / bzlas pa dang zhu ba glus bskul dang / mchod bstod la sogs pa ni las rgyal mchog go de dag kyang sngar gyi 'phros la sbyar na/ zung 'jug gi man ngag tu rgyal mchog gnyis 'dus zhes kyang brjod rgyu yin la/ yang rnam pa gcig tu na/ dben gsum dang sbyor rgyu lus dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog 'od gsal zung 'jug las rgyal mchog go /bzhi pa ni/ bsnyen pa nyer sgrub sgrub pa che/ /sgrub pa'i ngo bo'i khyad par du/ /zhes pa'i ngo bo'i zhes pa yan chad de/ mngon byang dang po stong nyid la dmigs pa bsnyen pa/ de nas lus dkyil rdzogs kyi bar nyer sgrub/ de nas rjes chags kyi bar sgrub pa/ de nas dkyil 'khor nyer bsdu'i bar sgrub chen du bzhed do/ /'dir mnyam bzhag lus dben bsnyen pa/ rjes thob lus dben dang ngag dben nyer sgrub/ sems dmigs sgrub pa/ sgyu lus 'od gsal/ zung 'jug gsum sgrub chen no/ /'dir yang sgrub pa'i zhes sgrub pa ston byed rjes su byung ba yang sdeb sbyor gyi dbang las so/ /rdo rje 'phreng ba las/ rnal 'byor rjes su rnal 'byor dang / khren tu rnal 'byor rnal 'byor che/ /dang po sbyor ba mdor bsdus pa'o/ /de bzhin dkyil 'khor rgyal po mchog /las kyi rgyal po rnal —314—

'byor mchog /ces gsungs pas/ dang sbyor la rnal 'byor bzhir phye nas/dkyil 'khor rgyas pa cho ga rgyas pas bsgom pa'i tshe/ rnal 'byor bzhi dang /rgyal mchog gnyis te yan lag drug nyid kyis 'ching ba yin no/ /lugs 'di'i rnal 'byor bzhi tsam gyis dkyil 'khor rgyas pa'i rim pa 'ching mi thub pas nye tshe ba yin la/ yan lag bzhi yang tshang tshul rtsi ba tsam yin gyi/ don tshan ha cang mang nyung ches pa sogs shin tu 'grig pa ma yin pas/ chings kyi gtso bo yan lag drug yin no/ /'dir rdzogs rim gyi dbang du byas te/ rim pa lnga po'i ye shes rjes mthun pa skyed na lta smos kyang ci dgos/ rim lnga'i gzhi 'dings byed kyi sgrub pa/ mos pa lam byed kyi dmigs pa rnams bsgoms pas kyang / bskyed rim gyi lam de dag gis/ dri ma gang dag par byed pa dang / yon tan gang zhig 'grub par 'gyur ba'i phan yon thams cad rdzogs par 'gyur pa yin zhing /dbang po rnon po rnams la/ bskyed rim gyi de dang de'i dod thams cad 'dis thub par bzhed pa'o/ /gzhung dngos bstan ltar na/ gong gi bskyed rim gyi rgyas bshad kyang yin no/ /lnga pa ni/ khyad par du/ zhes pa'i rjes su/ so sor sdud dang bsam gtan dang / /srog rtsol de bzhin 'dzin pa dang / /rjes su dran dang ting nge 'dzin/ /spyor ba drug ldan khyad par ro/ /zhes te/ skabs 'dir rgyud phyi ma'i sbyor drug gi gzhung tshig rnams blo la nges pa gal che/ de la lus dben gyi rtogs pa 'go ma rnams shar ba'i gnas skabs na/ mnyam bzhag tu rang bzhin kho na lus dben gyi lha sku la sems gnas shing / rjes thob tu dbang yul thams cad —315—

la bde bas rgyas btab pa na/ gzugs sogs lus snang thams cad bde stong du 'gyur 'gro tsam ni/ so sor sdud pa 'o/ /lus dben gyi rnal 'byor la brtan pa thob nas/ mnyam bzhag tu ni rang du ma zad/ rang la gang snang ba thams cad lha skur 'char thub/ rjes thob tu yang bde ba dang lha skus snang ba la rgyas btab pa na/ tshur rang gi lus sems la bde ba 'phel zhing / snang ba yang lha skur 'char ba ni bsam gtan yin zhing / de'i yan lag lnga ni/ yul dbang shes pa gsum bde stong dang lha skur snang ba ni rtogs pa de nyid stong par mos pa ni dpyod pa/ stong par myong la khad pas yid bde skyes pa ni dga' ba/ stong pa myong bas lus la shin sbyangs kyi bde ba skyes pa ni bde ba/ mnyam gzhag tu gnyis snang rags pa 'gags pa ni rtse gcig pa'i yan lag go /de ltar na lus dben gyi rim pa la yan lag dang po gnyis su bzhag ste/ sor bsam gnyis ka la mnyam rjes gnyis ka yod do/ /gdong gi sna rtse dang / snying ga'i sna rtse dang /gsang ba'i sna rtser sgom pa'i ngag dben thams cad srog rtsol gyi yan lag go /sems rnam par dben pa ni 'dzin pa'i yan lag go /rgyud las/ sems ni 'gog pa'i rdo rjer 'gyur/ /zhes pa/ sems dben mthar thug gi 'od gsal dang / 'bar snang lugs 'byung lugs zlog rnams bstan pa yin no/ /sgyu lus kyi rim pa ni rjes dran gyi yan lag ste/ skabs 'dir rgyu lus thob nas gong 'phel du song ba'i skabs/ rjes dran bcu drug gi rnam par dbye ba dag byed do/ /'od gsal gyi rim pa ni/ ting nge 'dzin gyi yan lag ste/ sgyu lus kyi lha sku de 'od gsal du ldang 'jug yang yang byed pa'o/ /'dir rgyud las/ yud kyis —316—

ye shes rdzogs byed pa/ /zhes pa ste/ 'od gsal las sgyu lus su yang yang ldang ba'i don no/ /drug pa ni/ rim pa bzhi ldan phyag rgyar bcas/ /dbang bzhi sku bzhi rang byung bas/ /mngon par byang chub tshul lnga las/ /skyed dang sdud cing gnas pa dag /lam gyur rim pa lnga ldan pa/ /byang chub phyogs chos mdo don dang / /sbas pa rnam gsum mthar thug bcas/ /sna tshogs sgra ni mtsho ni pa'o/ /zhes pa ste/phyag rgyar bcas pa'i lam rim pa bzhi ste/ phyag rgya bzhi'i lam yang rim lnga 'di la ldan zhing tshang ste/ bskyed rim dang lus dben la phyag rgya bzhi car gyi cha shas ni yod kyang lam gyi gzhi 'dings pa tsam yin dngos ma yin/ rdor bzlas dang sems dmigs kyi mnyam bzhag ni las rgya/ rjes thob ni cho se rgya/ sgyu lus dam rgya/ 'od gsal phyag chen/ zung 'jug bzhi car gyi 'bras bu'o/ /zhes gong ma rnams gsung la/ don 'di cung zad zhib par gzhan du smra bar 'dod do/ /dbang bzhi'i lam yang 'di la tshang ste/ lus dben du bum dbang gi lam dang /ngag dben du gsang dbang gi lam dang / sems dmigs sgyu lus su sher dbang gi lam dang / 'od gsal zung 'jug tu bzhi pa'i lam thams cad 'dus so/ /sku bzhi lam byed kyang tshang ste/ 'chad par 'gyur ba bsre ba gsum sku gsum lam du byed tshul gyi gtso bo yin zhing / rnam grangs gzhan yang bshad na/ lus ngag dben pa sprul sku dang / sems dben chos sku dang / sgyu lus longs sku dang /'od gsal ngo bo nyid kyi sku dang / zung 'jug bzhi car lam du byed pa'o/ /mngon par byang chub pa lnga las/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku dang por skyed cing —317—

'jug tu slar bsdu ba dang / bar du gnas pa dag kyang lam 'di la tshang ba yin te/ stong nyid bsgom pa mnyam bzhag lus dben gyi cha shas ni de bzhin nyid las byang chub pa/ lus dben dngos ni zla ba las byang chub pa/ ngag dben ni yig 'khru las byang chub pa/ sems dben ni phyag mtshan las byang chub pa/ sgyu lus ni sku yongs rdzogs las byang chub pa'am/ yang 'od gsal ni byang chub snga ma bzhi dang / zung 'jug ni sku yongs rdzogs las byang chub pa yin la/ de yang mnyam bzhag zung 'jug dang po ni/ mngon byang lnga las bskyed pa zhes bya la/ de nas sprul sku zung 'jug la sogs pa sna tshogs pa 'byung ba ni zung 'jug la gnas pa zhes bya zhing / spyir zung 'jug gi sku rgyun 'gags pa mi srid kyang /lan 'ga' thugs bde stong snang med la mnyam par 'jog pa ni sdud pa zhes bya ste/ 'di ni 'bras dus kyi mngon byang lnga las sku 'grub pa dang gnas pa dang /sdud pa rnams rim lnga'i lam 'dis thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyu byas nas/ nges par 'grub ces pa'i don yin/ bskyed rim gyi mngon byang lnga las lha sku skyed pa dang /'khor tshogs spro bas gnas pa dang / dkyil 'khor nyer bsdus sdud pa rnams ni rdzogs rim 'di'i sngon 'gro rgyud sbyong ba'i thabs su sbyor ba yin no/ /'dir rang byung bas zhes pa ni/ sku bzhi dang mngon byang lngas mtshon pa'i ye shes lnga ni/rang bzhin gdod ma nas rang byung lhun gyis grub pa de/ lam rim lnga bsgom pas mngon du byed ces pa'i don no/ /lam mchog tu gyur pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa 'di la ni/ mdo sde'i don byang chub phyogs chos sum cu rtsa bdun yang tshang ste/de yang dpal nā ro pa nas brgyud pa'i 'dus pa'i gdams ngag rnams na gsal —318—

por sbyar ba med kyang / 'khor lo sdom pa'i man ngag rnams su ni bshad pa ltar/'dir yang sbyor shes dgos so/ /de yang chos mngon par mdzod las/ ming gi sgo nas rdzas su bcu/ /dad dang brtson 'grus dran pa dang / /shes rab ting 'dzin btang snyoms dga'/ /rtog dang tshul khrims shin tu sbyangs/ /zhes gang zag cig gi rgyud la byang phyogs so bdun yod na/ ming gi sgo nas so bdun yin gyi/ rdzas rigs bcu ru 'dus so/ /de yang dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi/ shes rab kyi dbang stobs gnyis/ chos rab tu rnam 'byed byang chub kyi yan lag yang dag pa'i lta ba ste/ brgyad po de ni shes rab gcig tu 'dus la/ yang dag spong ba bzhi/ brtson 'grus kyi dbang po stobs byang chub kyi yan lag ste gsum/ yang dag pa'i rtsol ba ste brgyad po de ni/ brtson 'grus kyi rdzas gcig la 'dus rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po stobs byang chub yan lag gsum/ yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin te brgyad ni/ ting nge 'dzin gcig la 'dus so/ /dad pa'i dbang stobs gnyis rdzas gcig dran pa'i dbang stobs kyang rdzas gcig go /byang chub yan lag las/ btang snyoms dang / dga' ba dang / shin sbyangs te gsum/ 'phags lam la rtog pa ste/ bzhi po de re re ba yin la/ yang dag pa'i ngag dang / las kyis tha' dang / 'tsho ba gsum po ni ngo bo tshul khrims kyi rdzas su gcig go /de ltar na gong du smos pa ltar/ rim pa lnga gar stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug byang chub kyi sems yin pas mdo sngags thun mong gi byang phyogs so bdun ni de ka la tshang ba yin/ gsang sngags kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i de rnams ngos bzung na/ dran pa ni lha sku dang bde stong / skad cig snga ma snga ma la —319

shar ba des/ snang ba da ltar ba la rgyas 'debs pa de yin/ dad pa ni bla ma'i mos gus kyi lam 'khrid pa yang yin la/ lha sku dang rtsa rlung thig le bde ba sogs dmigs pa la sems dwangs zhing dga' bas rang shugs kyis gnas pa la zer/ brtson 'grus ni de dag la spro ba yang yin mod kyi/ gtso bor rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa'am sngags kyi spyod pa la zer/ ting nge 'dzin ni srog dbu mar 'gags pa'i mi rtogs pa dang / shes rab ni rang bzhin lhan skyes dang / zhu bde lhan skyes gang la yang bde bas stong nyid rtogs shing stong pas kyang bde ba rtogs pa'o/ /btang snyoms ni ye shes de dag la rtsol ba dang bral bas ngang gis 'jug pa'o/ /dga' ba ni rtsa dbu mar thig le'i 'gro 'ong gi dga' bzhi nyid do/ /rtog pa ni gsal stong bde ba de thams cad kyi rang bzhin lta zhing shes pa las sems can rnams kyang der sbyar ba'o/ /tshul khrims ni zhu bde'i thig le 'gyur med do/ khren tu sbyang ba ni rnam rtog gi bzhon pa'i rlung dbu mar 'gags pas/ bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin la bkol du btub pa ste/gzhan bsam gtan yan lag lnga'i shin sbyangs kyi bde ba yang yin no/ /yang rgyud kyi don tshul bzhi las/ yig don la nges po med pas 'di ltar sbyor mi dgos/ spyi don lam thun mong ba dang bskyed rim la zer/ dben gsum rang lus thabs ldan rnams snang ba sems kyis sbas pa yin/ gzhan lus shes rab rnams 'dod chags chos kyis sbas pa yin/ sgyu lus kun rdzob bden pas sbas pa ste/ sbas don gsum po de ltar yin/ 'od gsal dang zung 'jug ni mthar thug gi don no/ /de bzhin du bden pa gnyis dang / rig pa bzhi dang /—320—

mtha' drug la sogs pa dang / skye ba med pa dang / 'gag pa med pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la sogs pa sna tshogs pa'i sgra rnams ni/ rim pa lnga po 'di nyid ma rdzo par byed pa'o/ /bzhi pa don tshan thor bu sna tshogs pa bstan pas/ gtum mo'i don pond/ bsre 'phos don mund/ 'tshang rgya ba'i dus bshad/ rdor bzlas dang snang gsum gyi 'phros bshad/ brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa bstan/ don phra mo gzhan ci rigs pa dag sbyor tshul zugad pa ste drug las dang po ni/ gtum mo'i rnal 'byor rlung gis te/ bde chen sems la dmigs pas so/ /gtum mo ni rnam pa gnyis te/ rang lus thabs ldan rnal 'byor gyi gtum mo dang / gzhan lus shes rab las kyi gtum mo'o/ /de yang me 'bar ba dang / ha yig zhu ba'i rnam pa dmigs pas yid la byed pa'i mi dmigs kyi gtum mor grags pa ni/ dgyes rdor sogs ma rgyud kun las shin tu gsal mod/ 'phags skor gyi gzhung man ngag thun mong ba rnams la mi gsal yang / kha 'gengs kyi tshul gyis bsgoms na/shin tu bogs che ba'ang yin no/ /rgyu mtshan snying ga'i thig le bsgom pa dang / rtsa rlung sbyang ba'i rdor bzlas bsgom pa la 'bar 'dzag gi dmigs pa mang kyang /goms pa mthar phyin pa na/ rdo rje'i lus la dngos su 'bar 'dzag ni 'byung ngo //'di yi rigs la 'bar 'dzag gi dmigs pa ma bsgoms na/ lo tsam song ba na dngos su 'bar 'dzag yong rgyu cig la/ 'bar 'dzag gi dmigs pa 'dis bogs phyung na/ dbang po'i rim pas zla ba gcig nas zla drug tshun la dngos su 'bar 'dzag 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /spyir dngos su 'bar 'dzag 'byung phyin de —321—

lta bu'i dmigs pa bsgom pa yang / gdams ngag 'di la shin tu 'brel ba yin gyi ma 'brel ba ma yin no/ /des na srog rtsol la brten nas gtum mo bsgoms pa dang / ma rgyud yang snying gi man ngag 'di yang / rim lnga mar lugs kyi khyad yin zhing / spyir 'thad cing 'thad par ma zad rjes mar pa'i bzhed pas ni/ klu sgrub kyi rim lnga'i yang phyed dgyes rdor la brten par bzhed do/ /des na 'bar 'dzag gi gtum mo'i rnal 'byor ni/ spyir rim pa thams cad dang 'brel mod kyi/gtso bor rlung gi rnal 'byor ngag dben dang 'brel lo/ /las kyi gtum mo'am/bde chen las rgya'i rnal 'byor chags can 'og sgo la brten nas bde ba lam du blang ba yang / spyir rim lnga thams cad dang 'brel mod kyi/ gtso bor sems la dmigs pa'i sgo nas lam du byed pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rmi lam sgyu ma gcig tu sbyangs/ bar do rnam gsum bsre ba nyid/ /nyon mongs ye shes lam du bsgyur/ /lam myur gcod pa 'pho ba ste/ /grong du 'jug pa yan lag go /zhes te/ de la bsre ba'i man ngag gi rtsa ba ni/ rmi lam dang sgyu ma gcig tu spyod pa'o/ /rmi lam sgyu lus dang bsre thub na/ bar do yang sgyu lus dang bsre nus/ gnyid 'thug po 'od gsal dang bsre ba la yang tshegs med cing / de 'od gsal du chug na/ 'chi ba 'od gsal 'bad med du zin par 'gyur bas so/ /'o na rmi lam sgyu lus su 'byongs ba de/ sad dus kyi sgyu lus 'byong pa la rag las pas/ rtsa ba sad dus kyi de ma yin nam snyam na/phyogs gcig nas de bzhin bden mod kyang / nyams kyi sna 'dren pa la ni phal cher la sad dus kyi sgyu ma 'byongs pa pas rmi lam gyi de 'byongs pa bla bas/ rmi —322—

lam gyi dge sbyor la brten nas nyin par gyi dge sbyor ma skyes pa skyed pa dang /skyes pa bogs 'byin pa gnyis kar yong ba shas che'o/ /gzhan yang srid pa bar do ste bar do dngos dang / rmi lam bar do dang / skye shi bar do'i gnas skabs rnam pa gsum po/ sgyu lus lha'i sku dang bsre ba nyid yin te/ de ltar bshad pas 'od gsal gyi bsre ba gsum po yang shugs la bstan to/ /der ma zad rim pa lnga po dug lnga dag byed du sbyor ba'am/ yang na 'dod chags dbang gis ye shes dang bsre/ zhe sdang sgyu lus dang bsre/ gti mug 'od gsal dang bsre zhes pa'i tshul gyis/ nyon mong pa la lam gyi ye shes su bsgyur bar byed de/ de yang 'di snyam du nyon mongs pas sems rgyud rab tu ma zhi zhing ma rung bar byed pa'i cha ni/lam du mi 'gyur la/ rang bzhin spros bral rtogs na lam du 'gyur mod kyang /de nyon mongs ma yin pas/ nyon mongs lam du ji ltar 'gyur zhe na/ spyir ma rung par byed pa'i cha de yang / thabs khyad par can gzhan gyis zin na/ lam du mi 'gyur ba yang ma yin la/ 'on kyang nyon mongs kyi rang bzhin shes pa zhes pa 'di/ rang bzhin ni sno dam stong nyid kho na la 'jog mi dgos kyi/ 'dir rang gzugs la rang bzhin zhes bya bas/ nyon mongs pa'i shes pa de rnams nyid kyi shes pa'i rdzas gsal rig tsam de la zer ba yin/ gsal rig tsam gyi ngo bo la khyad med kyang / mdangs chags sdang rmongs sogs su shar ba'i grogs kyi khyad par las/ lam du byed tshul 'jug pa bde mi bde la khyad par yod de/ bde bas 'dod chags dang gsal bas zhe sdang dang stong pas gti mug lam du byed pa bla ba yin/ de las zlog na nyams kyi sne rnyed cung zad dka' bas dbye ba shes ——323—

par bya'o/ /smras pa/ nyon mongs lam du byed ces kun la grags/ /bshad pa smra 'dod lkugs pa'i rmi lam 'dra/ /de de lam du byed pa'i rnal 'byor la/ /bsre ba zhes bya'i tha snyad grags pa yin/ /bsre ba'i rnam gzhag ni gnyis te/ /gzhi dang lam du bsre ba dang / /lam dang 'bras bur bsre ba'o/ /dang po ni/ gnyid 'od gsal du bsre/ rmi lam sgyu lus su bsre/ 'chi kha ma 'od gsal du bsre/ bar do zung 'jug tu bsre/ 'dod chags lhan skyes su bsre/ longs spyod bde stong du bsre/ zhes bsre ba drug tu snga ma rnams bzhed do/ /gnyis pa bsre ba dgu ni/ 'od gsal cho se sku dang bsre/ sgyu lus la gnyis kyi mnyam bzhag longs sku dang bsre/ rjes thob sprul sku dang bsre/ gnyid 'thug 'od gsal dang bsre/ rmi lam ldongs sku dang bsre/ gnyid sad sprul sku dang bsre/ 'chi ba chos sku dang bsre/ bar do longs sku dang bsre/ skye ba sprul sku dang bsre/ zhes pa rnams so/ /yang bsre ba gsum ni/ bde ba chos sku dang bsre/ gsal snang longs sku dang bsre/ las snang sprul sku dang bsre ba'ang yin no/ /de'i dang po ni/ gtum mo/las rgya/ 'od gsal gsum mo/ /gnyis pa ni/ sad dus dang / rmi lam dang /bar do gsum gyi mnyam bzhag dang rjes thob la'o/ /gsum pa ni de'i rjes so//'pho ba la/ gong du 'pho ba dang grong du 'jug pa gnyis te/ de dag ni gtso bor ma rgyud pa la grags che de yang sad dus dang gnyid dus su/ dpe'i 'od gsal 'bad med du sgom nus pa gcig la/ gong du 'pho ba mi dgos kyang de ltar mi —324—

nus na dgos shing / de smon lam gyis mtshams sbyar bas/ skye ba mang po brgyud mi dgos par/ lam thams cad myur du gcod pa ste/ phyi ma'i skye ba gcig nyid la grol ba'o/ /grong du 'jug pa ni thun mong gi dngos grub tsam yin/ rdzogs rim gyi khrid kyi sde min yang / gong du 'pho ba'i yan lag 'phros don du bshad pa'o/ /de'i phyir 'pho ba ni 'od gsal gyi gdams ngag dang 'brel ba dang /grong 'jug kyang de dang 'brel bas 'dir ma 'brel ba min no/ /gsum pa ni/ 'od gsal gnas thob mngon 'tshang rgya/ /brtson 'grus can ni tshe 'di nyid/ /le lo can ni 'chi kha ste/ /tha ma srid pa bar ma dor/ /mchog thob skus ni gzhan don byed/ /ces pa la/ 'od gsal gyi gnas te rim pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor ba ni/ lus rten de la mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ste/ gson pa'i rten la 'od kyi rim pa thob na/ 'chi ba'i mngon rol tu 'tshang rgya/'chi ba 'od gsal gyi dus 'od gsal gyi rim pa thob na bar dor rtsol med du sangs rgya/ bar do nyid du 'od gsal gyi rim pa thob na bar do de nyid du rtsol ba dang bcas te sangs rgya'o/ /de ltar na/ brtson 'grus can ni tshe 'di nyid la sangs rgya/ le lo can rtogs pa mthon po ni/ rab 'chi kha ste 'chi ba 'od gsal las langs ma thag pa'am/ tha ma srid pa bar ma do shar mod kyang / skye srid med par rten de la rim pas sangs rgya ba'o/ /'dir sangs rgyas zhes pa zung 'jug thob pa'i ming yin/ slob pa'i zung 'jug thob phyin go/ rten ma 'phos pa nyid la mi slob pa'i zung 'jug thob nges pa ni yin no/ /gong du mngon sangs rgya zhes pa'i don/ 'dir mchog thob ces pas gsal bar byas te/ mchog gi dngos —325—

grub ni zung 'jug la zer/ de thob nas sku'i sprul pa sna tshogs kyis sems can gyi don byed do/ /gzhan yang bar do'i rten la sgyu lus kyi rim pa thob pa ni/dbang po rno na rten de la zung 'jug thob pa'ang srid/ phal cher skye ba sprul sku'i rnal 'byor gyi/ skye ba gcig len no/ /gson pa'i tshe la sgyu lus kyi rim pa thob na/ bar do tshun la mchog 'grub pas/ las nyon gyi skye ba las grol bar bshad/'chi ba'i sngon rol tu mched pa'i rtogs pa thob na bar dor sgyu lus kyi rim pa thob nges pa yin zhing / snang ba'i sa thob tsam man chad la nges pa med do/ skye ba brgyud nas sangs rgyas pa cig gzhan las bshad de/ tshe 'di la ltos na dngos grub thob pa'i grangs su mi 'gro zhing / phyi ma'i rang dus la ltos na gson tshe dang / 'chi kha dang / bar do gsum gang rung du 'dus pas 'dir ma bshad do/ /bzhi pa la gnyis/ ngag dben gyi 'phros dang / sems dben gyi 'phros so/ /dang po ni/ ngo bo rgyu tshul 'byung ba khams/ /las dang dbye ba de nyid rlung / /'byung 'jug gnas pa rnam par brtag /'bru gsum sngags kyi ngo bo nyid/ /ā li kā li sbyor dbus gnas/ /brtag pa grangs ldan bzlas pa nyid/ /sbyor der khyad par thabs ldan pas/ /ngag dben rlud gi rnal 'byor bstan/ /zhes pa ste/gong du ngag dben bstan pa rnams la rgyab brten go ba 'di ltar dgos zhes pa ste/ rlung brgya brgyad dam/ rlung bcu po rnams kyi ngo bo dang / phyi nang du rgyu ba'i tshul dang / 'byung ba che chung gi khams kyi dbye ba dang / rlung bcu'i byed las dang /gnas la sogs pa'i dbye ba dang bcas pa'i rlung de rnams nyid/ 'byung ba dang /'jug pa dang / gnas pa'i sgo nas dbye ba du mar rnam par brtag go /de dag ni —326—

rlung gi de kho na nyid kyi skabs su dgos/ yi ge 'bru gsum po'i sngags kyi ngo bo nyid de/ phyi bskyed rim gyi sngags rnams 'dus pa'i tshul dang / nang rdo rje lus kyi sngags btu ba dang / de kho na ye shes kyi mtshon don sogs kyis brtag pa ste/don gyi rab dbye dang ldan pas/ grangs nyi khri chig stong drug brgya bzlas pa nyid dang / ā li kā li sbyar ba ste/ ngag tshig kun gyi dbus na a yig srog gi tshul du gnas pa sogs sngags kyi de kho na nyid kyi rnam gzhag rgyas par shes dgos shing dgang ba dang / dbyung ba dang / bum pa can la sogs pa'i sbyor ba dang / rtsa a wa dh+wa ting 'dus pa dang / 'ching ba'i khyad par gyi thabs dang ldan pas/ ngag dben rjeng gi rnal 'byor brtan zhing bshad par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rgyu dang 'bras bu sbyor ba gang / /snang ba gsum po 'char tshul te/ /zhes pa ste/ snang mched thob gsum dang skad cig bzhi pa'i 'od gsal zhes lugs 'byung gi rim pa ni/ thim rim gyi snang ba gsum po rgyu dang /'od gsal 'bras bur sbyong ba gang yin pa dang / 'od gsal las thob mched snang gsum zhes lugs zlog gi rim pa ni/ snang gsum skye ba'i rim pa ste/ 'od gsal rgyu dang snang ba gsum 'bras bu la sbyor ro/ /'dir sgyu lus kyi sku bdag byin brlab pa'i rim pa dang por 'char ba dang / zung 'jug gi sku 'grub pa'i dus la rgya bod phal cher lugs zlog gi snang ba'i rjes su 'byung bar bzhed pa dang / kha cig 'od gsal las langs pa dang / sku de 'grub pa srang mda'i mtho dman bzhin dus mnyam pas/ lugs zlog gi thob pa 'go shar tsa na/ sku de nyid 'grub par 'dod pa dag yod na/ snga ma 'thad de/ rnam shes gsum po slar —327

yang ni/ zhes slar lugs zlog tu byung ba'i snang ba gsum gyi rgyu las sku de sgrub dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /lugs 'byung lugs zlog gi rim pa phra mo dag snga rol nas kyang 'gyung mod kyi/ de dag las gsal snang can tsam gyi lha sku 'char ba'i dus la ni nges pa med de/ sku dngos ma yin par blo ngor shar ba tsam yin pa'i phyir ro/ /skabs 'dir rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rnam rtog la sogs pa'i rnam gzhag kyang rgyas par shes dgos shing / snang ba gsum mam bzhi la yang don dam chos nyid kyi snang gsum dang / kun rdzob rten 'brel gyi snang ba gsum du dbye/ dang po snang gsum dngos ma yin chos nyid do/ /phyi ma la dbye na rang bzhi dang bcas pa dang / rang bzhin dang bral ba gnyis/ rang bzhin dang bcas pa la dbye na/ gzhi dus dang / lam dus gnyis/ gzhi dus la dbye na/ rgyun chags pa rtsa ba'i snang ba gsum yin la/ khyad par gyi dus su 'byung ba la dbye na/ 'chi ba'i dus kyi snang ba gsum/ gnyid dus kyi snang ba gsum/ chags pa'i dus kyi snang ba gsum/ tshogs drug thams cad dang 'grogs pa'i snang ba gsum ste/gzhi dus la 'jog mtshams lnga'o/ /lam dus kyi snang ba gsum la/ smin byed dbang gi dus kyi dang / bskyed rim dang / lus dben dang / sems dben dang /sgyu lus dang 'od gsal gyi rim pa'i bar te/ gnas skabs bdun po de la skad cig mas bsdus pa'i snang ba gsum mam/ snang bzhi sgrub/ sa re re yod/ sas bsdus pa'i snang bzhi ni/ sems dben du snang ba gsum gyis thob pa dang / 'od gsal gyi rim pa'i mtha' 'od gsal gyi sa thob pa'o/ /rang bzhin dang bral ba'i snang gsum ni/ slob pa'i zung 'jug ni yod do/ /de ltar na snang bzhi la —328—

'jog mtshams bco lnga'o/ /zhes zur tsam mo/ /snang ba gsum dang / stong pa gsum dang / sems gsum dang / ye shes gsum dang / rnam shes gsum zhes pa rnams don gcig stong pa bzhi dang snang ba bzhi yang don gcig sems bzhi dang / ye shes bzhi dang / rnam shes bzhi tha snyad mi byed/ snang bzhi dga' bzhi don gcig kyang / snang ba gsum la dga' ba gsum gyi tha snyad mi byed do/ /lnga pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa bshad pa ni/ dus dang 'byung 'gyur thabs khyad par/ /dbyer med ye shes gnas thob pas/ /spyod pa ye shes mngon du byed/ /slob dang mi slob der spyod pa'o/ /rang bzhin shes pa'i lam gyur pa//rnam shes sgyu mar mtshon pa'i chos/ khyad par lus dang spyod pa gang / /dngos grub thob phyir bdag byin brlab/ /phyi nang mngon par byang chub tshul/ /rnal 'byor thob pa'i bsam gtan gnas/ /'byung dang 'jug pa ma brtags par/ /spyod tshul ye shes des thob pa'o/ /lha dang nyams myong lus dang ngag /bsam gtan mnyam rjes sbyong ba dang / /slob dang mi slob gnyis med cing / /rab tu mi gnas zung du 'jug /ces so/ /spyir rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa spyod pa la/bskyed rim mthar phyin pa zhig gis/ 'phral du mchog thob par 'dod na/ de dus rig brtul gyi spyod pa mi byed par/ rdzogs rim sgoms/ de brtan na spyod pa la 'jug re zhig mchog mi 'dod par/ thun mong gi dngos grub sgrub na/bskyed rim nyid kyi rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa spyod dgos te/ de la yang spros bcas spros med shin tu spros med gsum ka yod do/ /lus dben gyi rim pa la gnas pa'i skabs dang / ngag dben gyi rim pa'i skabs su ni/ spyir btang —329—

la spyod pa mi spyod de/ rdzogs rim gyi spyod pa ma ran pas so/ /'on kyang bskyed rim la bstan pa thob nas de dag sgom pa yin na/ blo'i khyad par gyis thun mong gi dngos grub la 'dod pa skyes nas/ bskyed rim la ltos pa'i spyod pa byed pa ni srid par mngon zhing / des dngos grub 'grub pa'ang yin no/ /phyis rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa'i rgyur/ las dang po pa nyid nas de'i bar du/ 'dod 'jug gi spyod pa dang / brten pa bslab pa'i spyod pa la bslab bo/ /gzhung 'dir rdzogs rim gyi spyod pa'i dbang du byas nas sems dben dang / sgyu lus dang / 'od gsal dang / /zung 'jug gi spyod pa ste bzhi bshad do/ /de la dus ni/ nyin re bzhin nam/ zla re'am lo re la sogs pa spros bcas kyi khyad par rnams spros bcas kyi spyod pa la dgos pa yin/ gzhan gnyis la dus nges pa med do/ /bkres skom dang / tsha grang la sogs pa'i gnod pa med pa dang /bsam pa tsam gyis gzhan la phan gnod la sogs pa 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i nus pa'am drod thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ thabs kyi khyad par spros bcas la tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor rgyas bsdus gang yin yang / glu gar brda sogs cho ga'i rol pa rgyas pa spyod pa dang / spros med la dkyil 'khor rgyas bsdus gang yin yang / spros pa'i rol pa mdor bsdus dang / shin tu spros med la rol pa spangs te bsam gtan kho nas sgrub pa rnams yin la/ spyod tshul ni/ bde stong gi ye shes mchog tu brtan pa de/ rjes chags gtso bor gyur pa'i 'dod yon gyis spel nas/ de'i steng du bde sdug mtho dman bar gsum gyi rkyen thams cad dbyer med ro mnyam du bsres pas/ bde sdug gi rgyu thams cad bde stong gi ye —330—

shes 'bar ba'i gnas thob par byed pa'o/ /spyod pa des ye shes gsum gyi sa mngon du byed ces pa ni/ snang ba'i sa ma thob kyi bar du rdzogs rim gyi spyod pa byar mi rung la/ de nas spro zhing 'dod na/ mched pa'i sa thob pa'i phyir dang de rjes thob pa'i sa mngon du byed pa la'ang spyod pa spyod pa yod mod/ nges par dgos pa ni ma yin no/ /thob pa'i sa tsam po de grub nas/ sems dben mthar thug gi 'od gsal dang / sgyu lus kyi rim pa thob pa'i phyir/ skabs der nges par spyod pa dgos so/ /spros bcas spros med la/ grub pa phyag rgya kho na'am/ de 'dra ji ltar 'os pa gtso bor gyur pa'i las rgya la slob pa rtag tu nges par dgos la/ shin tu spros med du ni/ las rgya la mi slob par/ ye rgya kho na dang / las rgya'i dkyil 'khor gyi dod gnyid kyi 'od gsal gyis sgrub pa ste/ skabs der de ltar spyad do/ /sgyu lus kyi rim pa thob nas ni/ rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rnam rtog sgyu ma lta bur shes pa'i lam mngon du gyur pa ni/ rnam shes gsum yang sgyu ma lta bur mtshon nus pa'i chos/ lha sku snang stong dang zhu bde la mnyam par 'jog cing /khyad par las dge sdig gi rgyur 'gyur pa'i rigs/ dge mi dge lung ma bstan gyi rnam rtog thams cad ro snyam pa dang / dbye ba spyod pa gsum po gang dgadangos kyi 'bras bu phra yang la sogs pa yon tan brgyad kyi dngos grub thob pa'i phyir sgrub pa ni bdag byin brlab pa'i rim pa'i spyod pa'o/ /'o na snyu lus kyi rim pa mthar phyin tshad kyis/ yon tan brgyad thob par 'gyur ram snyam nas/ de tsam la ma nges kyang / zung 'jug 'grub pa'i sngon rol zla ba drug nas thob par —331—

bshad pas/ de 'od gsal kyi rim pa'i mgo sgang la 'byung bas/ sgyu lus kyi spyod pa'i 'bras bu thun mong ma yin par gyur pa la dgongs so/ /'od gsal gyi rim pa thob zin pa'i spyod pa ni/ zhu bde la brten nas rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa shin tu gsal bar mtshon nus/ rnam rtog rlung dang bcas pa'i cha shas 'ga' zhig mngon 'gyur gtan nas 'gags pa las byung ba'i bde stong gi rnal 'byor thob pas/ spyod pa gsum po gang rung gi cho ga dang sbyar nas/ ril gzhig gi bsam gtan gnyis po gang rung re la gnas pas snang bzhi'i rim pas 'od gsal du 'jug pa dang / slar yang de las snang gsum lugs zlog dang sgyu lus su ldang ba ni/ blo rnam rtog gis ma brtags par/ phyag rgya'i ye shes kho nas 'byung ste/ spyod pa spyod tshul gyi ye shes de lta bu ni/ 'od gsal gyi rim pa la gnas pa'i gang zag des thob bo/ /'od gsal gyi rim pa 'di'i mthar thug pa phyi nang gi mngon byang gnyis sbyar ba las/ don gyi 'od gsal mthong lam thob pa ni spyod pa khyad par can yin la/ der ma zad 'od gsal gyi rim pa'i spyod pa thams cad/ phyi nang gi mngon par byang chub pa gnyis kyi tshul te 'dra 'bag tu 'byung ba'o/ /des rjes su zung 'jug gi spyod pa la ni/ spros bcas spros med shin tu spros med la sogs pa'i tha snyad tsam 'jog pa ni/ gnas skabs yul dus de dang der gdong thug tu gdul bya gzhan snang ba ji ltar snang ba'am/ rnam par 'phrul ba de dang der bstan pa la/ spros bcas la sogs pa'i ming so sor 'dogs par zad kyi snga ma rnams kyi skabs dang mi 'dra'o/ /dngos su ni mtshan dpe thams cad rdzogs pa'i ye shes kyi sku las sku'i snang ba chad pa med pa 'byung —332—

ba dang / grag stong nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i gsung las sgra dbyangs rgya mtsho dang / bde stong lhan cig skyes pa'i thugs kyis rten 'brel ji snyed pa mkhyen pa ste/ rdo rje gsum rnal 'byor mi rtog pa'i ngang las ma g.yos bzhin du bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam par 'phrul pas sems can gyi don mdzad pa ni/ zung 'jug gi ye shes yin la/ rim lnga las/ zung du 'jug pa sgoms gyur pas/ /spyod pa'ang de dang gnyis su med/ /ces gsungs pa ltar zung 'jug gi ye shes nyid las gzhan pa'i rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa ni med la/ 'on kyang mnyam bzhag tu lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes bde stong nyid kyi nyams myong de rjes thob sems can gyi don spyod pa'i gnas skabs su/ brtan g.yo snod bcud thams cad la rgyas btab pas/ de rnams lhan skyes gcig pu'i ngo bor ro mnyam du thim par 'gyur pa'i ldog cha nas ni/ rig brtul zhes bya la/ 'di ye shes kyi rnam rol 'ba' zhig yin yang / rnam pa rjes chags kyi rol pa'i dkyil 'khor du shar ba dang / gnyis snang gi 'khrul ba rnams zhu bde phra mos rgyas btab pa'i rkyen gyi don dam pa'i dbyings su bsre pa'i byed las kyi mtshan nyid dang ldan pa ni dgos so/ /de ltar na mnyam bzhag tu yod med yin min rtag chad 'gro 'ong skyes 'gag 'phel 'grib sogs gnyis snang dang spros pa gang la yang rab tu mi gnas shing / rjes thob tu gzung 'dzin gnyis snang tsam cig yod kyang / mnyam bzhag gi shugs kyis so sor blos 'dzin pa la rab tu mi gnas pa ni zung 'jug gi spyod pa'o/ /de yang lha'i sku dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dang / bde stong gi nyams myong gnyis dbyer med ngo bo gcig pa dang / lus dang ngag dang yid —333—

gsum tha dad med de/ sku dang gsung yang thugs ye shes gcig gi rnam rol yin pa dang / ril 'dzin dang rjes gzhig gi bsam gto gnyis kyi 'od gsal du ldang 'jug byed pa'i dbye ba med pa dang / mnyam bzhag dang rjes thob kyi spyod pa tha dad pa med pa dang / slob pa dang mi slob pa ste las kyi phyag rgya sogs rjes chags kyi rol pa la slob par snang zhing nges par sgrub dgos pa dang / skabs 'gar de bkag ste mi slob pa'i blang dor gyi dbye ba gnyis med pa'o/ /sa brgyad pa yan chad mnyam rjes so so'i mtshan nyid med la/ 'on kyang 'dir mnyam rjes tha dad med pa ni de gnyis la nyams len mi 'dra ba med/bogs che chung med ces pa'o/ /'dir zung 'jug gi ye shes la kha spyor sogs yan lag bdun ldan gyi rnam gzhag byed pa ni spyir shin tu bzang zhing dngos po'i gnas tshul la shin tu zhugs pa yin yang / yan lag bdun ldan gyi rnam gzhag 'di ni/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyi bzhed pa yin gyi/ rim lnga spyod bsdus sgron gsal sogs 'phags lugs kyi rtsa ba'i gzhung 'grel gang nas kyang bshad pa med do/ /bod kyi 'phags skor ba mang po yan lag bdun ldan gyi bshad pa/ yang skyor byed kyin 'phags lugs rang gi chos skad yin pa skad ngom ngom byed pa ni gzhung gang dang gang las/ chos skad de dang de byung ba ma shes pa'o/ /gzhan yang spyod pa'i skabs 'dir go dgos la/ spros bcas spros med shin tu spros med gsum po la/ cho ga la ltos pa'i spros bcas sogs gsum/ dus la ltos pa'i gsum/ sgom bsam la ltos pa'i gsum ste dgur phye nas/ ming gsal med pa rnams phal cher cho ga'i dbang du byas pa'o/ kha cig —334—

gzhan lus sam/ 'og sgo'i lam ste chags lam bye brag pa dang / rig brtul kyi spyod pa gcig par 'dod pa ni ma sbyangs pa'i blun gtam yin te chags lam bye brag pa de ni/ zhu bde lhan cig skyes pa'i nyams ma thob pa thob pa'i phyir sgrub pa dang / skyes pa brtan pa'i phyir sgrub pa yod cing / de yi dang po la yang ring pa'i rgyu rlud dbu ma'i sgor bsdu ba dang / bar pa dbu mar gzhug pa dang / thim pa tsam po byed pa dang / gtum mo rags pa sbar bar byed pa sogs yod cing /nye bar rgyu rjes chags kyi gtum mo phra ba sbar ba'o/ /phyi ma la yang gtum mo sbar ba brtan par byed pa dang / thig le'i bgrod pa brtan par byed pa'i phyir du sgom pa sogs rigs du ma yod kyang / de thams cad rig brtul gyi spyod par mi 'gro ba sha stag dang / ye shes brtan zin pa bogs 'byin byed pa la yang brtul zhugs gyi spyod pas ma khyab cing / spyod pa la yang gzhan lus yin pas ma khyab pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du rigs spyod ni bde ba sgrub byed tsam dang / 'dod yon lam byed tsam dang rig ma'i kha sbyor gyis 'dod chags lam byed tsam dang / rkyen ngan lam 'byer tsam dang / nyon mongs glo bur du sbyong byed tsam dang / nyon mongs bag la zha ba rnams mngon gyur du ston nas sbyong byed tsam du 'dod pa sogs legs par ma sbyangs pa'i mkhas par 'dod pa rnams la rig brtul ji bzhin ngos ma zin pa'i bla rdol nges med sna tshogs pa byung ngo / /drug pa don phra mo ci rigs dang sbyar ba la/ yi ge'i don dang spyi yi don//sbas pa mthar thug nyid yin te/ /zhes 'byung ste/ gong gi sbas pa rnam gsum sogs dang don gcig theg pa sna tshogs pha rol phyin/ /srid pa skye dang gnas —335—

la sogs/ /dus kyi dbye ba khyad par gyi/ /stan gcig steng du bsgom par bya//zhes 'byung ste/ don 'og tu 'chad 'gyur dang gcig des na tshig 'di rnams dpe phal cher la 'dug kyang / gzhung 'di nyid kyi dkyus yin na/ brjod bya zlog pa'i skyon du 'gyur bas/ gzhung 'dra min gcig nas tshur blangs par zad do//'dir gnas la sogs zhes pa gong du bsgom pa'i/ gnas dang / sgrub pa po dang / grogs dang / nyams su blang pa'i gdams pa ste/ rtsis mgo bzhi byed pa la bsams par 'dug cing / dus ni gong du bshad pa'i gnad bzhi'i nang tshan no/ /'di dag zlos skyon du song gi dogs nas/ 'di nyid yang dag rtogs pa'i phyir/ /zhes pa bcug ste/ snga ma'i theg pa sna tshogs sogs bsgom par gdams pa dang / phyi mas sgom pa'i phyir du go ba dogs pas/ theg pa sna tshogs sogs dang sbyar te bshad par bya'o byas na legs par 'ong ngo bsam pa'o/ /des na yi ge'i don dang bcas pa nas/ rtogs pa'i phyir zhes pa'i bar gyi tshig rkang bdun po 'di snga phyi dang zlog pa yin la/ gdan rdzogs kyi yig rnying rnams la lung drangs pa la ni/ theg pa sna tshogs sogs snga ma 'di mi 'byung / 'chad 'gyur gyi tshig bcad gcig po 'di 'byung bas/ dkyus kyi gzhung tshig ni 'di yin no/ /de yang / lam mchog rim pa lnga pa nyid/ /pha rol phyin dang theg sna tshogs/ /srid pa skye dang nyin zhag gcig /stan gcig steng du sbyar te bshad/ /ces te/ lam rim pa lnga po 'di ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo don gyi dgongs pa yang yin te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gdan seng ge'i khri bshams te/ sku lus drang por bsrangs/ zhes sogs kyis lus dben bstan/ de nas bcom ldan —336—

'das kyi zhabs kyi mthil gnyis las 'od zer bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong drug cu drug cu byung / zhes sogs kyis rdor bzlas bstan/ nang stong pa nyid la sogs pa stong nyid bco brgyad rgyas bshad kyis sems dben bstan/ gzugs sgyu ma lta bu sogs kyis sgyu lus bstan/ gzugs kyi rang bzhin ni rang bzhin med pa ste/gang la rang bzhin med pa de ni brjod du med pa'o/ /zhes sogs kyis 'od gsal bstan/ gnyis su med gnyis su byar med/ so so ma yin tha mi dad do zhes pas zung 'jug bstan to/ /de yang sher phyin gyi mdo'i dngos bstan ni rdzogs rim rnams dang don phyogs 'dra ba de tsam ka gsungs pa yin yang /phugs kyi dgongs pa'i brtad so rim lnga la dgongs te/ gsungs pa yin pas/mthar thug gi dgongs don ni 'di kho na'o/ /sher phyin gyi mdo ni theg chen gyi mdo sde phal gyi rtsa ba yin pas/ smos par zad kyi/ des mtshon nas mdo g.yin kun la'ang go bar bya'o/ /de bzhin du theg pa dang / grub mtha' sna tshogs pa'i nyams rtogs rnams kyang 'di la 'dus pa yin te/ nyan thos kyi lam bsgom pa rnams la/ kun rdzob rags pa'i snang ba mi 'gog cing / rdul phran la mngon zhen dang bcas mod/ lhag ma bdag med rtog pa'i shes rab ni/ bskyed rim lus dben dang bcas pa'i gzugs can phra rags su snang ba ma 'gags pa la gzhi sgyur pa'i rnam pa can de dang chos mtshungs pa'i sgo nas/ nyan thos kyi de 'dir 'dus pa yin te/ 'di bsgoms pa'i nyan thos kyi spang rtogs de dag mtha' dag rdzogs pa'i rten 'brel byed do/ /rdor bzlas su rang rgyal gyi theg pa 'dus te/de'i lam gyi gtso bo rten 'brel bcu gnyis bsgoms pa yin la/ rlung 'pho ba —337—

bcu gnyis ni rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi rlung yin/ de la rdor bzlas byas pas rten 'brel bcu gnyis rtogs par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /nyan thos sde gnyis kyi grub mtha' rnam dag gi nyams thams cad nyan rang 'phags pa'i rtogs pa la 'dus so/ /sems tsam gyi lta ba phyi don du snang ba'i bkod pa thams cad kyang /sems kyi rnam 'gyur du shes pa dang / sems dmigs kyi rim par yang / rdo rje 'phreng ba las/ snying por gyur pa rang srog las/ khams gsum na ni gzhan med de/ /sgyu ba rlud gi khams gsum po/ /rmi lam rmi ba bzhin du snang / /zhes chos thams cad rlung sems kyi rtsa ba can du shes shing / rlung yang sems las gzhan du med par rtogs pa/ rtogs rigs mthun pa'i phyir de 'dir 'dus so/ /dbu ma sgyu ma lta bur smra ba'i rtogs pa yang sgyu lus su 'dus te/ snang grag sgyu ma lta bur rtogs par 'dra bas so/ /dbu mar rab tu mi gnas pa'i rtogs pa ni 'od gsal du 'dus te/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin stong pa brjod bral du de dag 'dod cing 'dis myong ba'i phyir ro/ /dbu ma 'di gnyis thal rang gi ming gi rnam grangs su 'dod pa ni mi legs te/ thal rang gnyis ma yin pa'i dbu ma de gnyis du ma yod cing / de gnyis la yang gnyis kyis ma khyab pa'i phyir ro/ /sngags kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i lta ba thams cad zung 'jug tu 'dus te/ gsang sngags rgyud sde thams cad kyi gnas lugs dgongs pa'i mthar thug bde stong dang dkyil 'khor zung du 'jug pa gdod ma'i ngo bo de kho na yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar na rim lnga bsgoms pas theg pa mtha' dag gi lam bsgom par 'gyur ro/ /srid pa skye ba'i rim pa dang sbyar na/ lus grub pa tsam lus dben/—338—

dbugs rgyu ba ngag dben/ gnyid dang snyoms 'jug gi dus snang gsum 'char ba ni sems dben/ rmi lam gyi lus ni sgyu lus/ 'chi dus kyi stong pa bzhi ni 'od gsal/ bar do'i lus ni longs sku zung 'jug slar yang skye ba'i lus blangs pa ni sprul sku zung 'jug ste/ 'di dag ni sbyang bya ngos gzung ba'am/ gang la gnad du bsnun pa'i gzhi chen yang yin no/ /yang na yul snang skad cig re re dang /gnyid dang / snyoms 'jug dang / 'chi ba'i dus kyi thim rim thams cad/sems dben 'od gsal gnyis kyi thun mong dang / gnyid dang sad dus kyi snang ba shar ba dang / rmi lam dang bar do thams cad sgyu lus zung 'jug thun mong du sbyar yang rung ngo / /nyin zhag phrugs gcig dang sbyar na/ phung po lnga sangs rgyas lnga'i rang bzhin ni lus dben/ rlung nyi khri chig stong drug brgya rgyu ba ni rdor bzlas/ gnyid la 'jug pa ni sems dben/ rmi lam ni sgyu lus/ gnyid 'thug po ni 'od gsal/ gnyid sad pa ni zung 'jug dang sbyar ro/ /zhes pa 'di yang sbyang bya nyid dang / gnas skabs der dag sbyor gang zhig 'jug pa'i tshul lo/ /de ltar na rim lnga stan thog gcig tu bsgoms pas/ srid pa skye ba dang / nyin zhag gcig gi bya ba rnams/ ye shes kyi rten du 'gyur zhing / mdo don sna tshogs dang theg pa thams cad stan thog gcig tu rdzogs pa'o/ /rgyas bshad rtsa ba'i gsum pa ni/ 'di ltar/ 'bras bu skye ba'i rim pa nyid/ /tshe 'di nyid du sangs rgyas pa/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug dam pa ste/ /sku lnga rab rdzogs gyur pa'o/ /zhes te/ 'bras bu skye ba'i rim pa ni/ sa dang por slob pa'i zung 'jug thob/ de 'dra'i gang zag de tshe 'di nyid du 'chi srid kyis bar ma —339—

chod par sangs rgyas pa zhes bya/ sa gnyis pa nas bcu pa'i bar du bgrod pa ni rnal 'byor can gyi dbang phyug dam pa'am mchog ces bya ste/ de'i rjes su mi slob pa'i zung 'jug sku lnga dang / ye shes lnga dang / dbang phyug brgyad la sogs gzhal du med pa'i yon tan thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa yin te/sku lnga ni ngo bo nyid sku dang / ye shes chos sku dang / longs spyod rdzogs pa dang /sprul pa dang / bde ba chen po'i sku rnams yin la/ de'i mdzad pa 'phrin las kyang lhun gyis grub cing phyogs dus kun tu khyab pa'o/ /gsum pa man ngag gi che ba bstan pa ni/ dpal ldan gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud/ /'phags pa yab sras rim bshad pa/ /de nyid dgongs pa na ros rnyed/ /'grel pa mkhan gyis mi shes pas/ /rgyud rkyang snying po bstus pa nyid//byin rlabs lam 'di thun mong min/ /zhes pa la/ rgyud ces pa ni rgyud don no//rim zhes pa ni zhal gyi gdams pa'i rim pa'o/ /'grel pa mkhan de/ rje mar pa'i gsung gis/ da sa tha ga na dang / dza ya na/ snyim pa'i me tog gsum thos te/bla ma'i man ngag can ma yin gsungs nas mi 'chad/ ces 'byung ba ltar paṇ+ḍi ta'i rtsal bshad rnams la zer ba yin gyi/ sgron gsal la zur za min mod/mkhas pa 'ga' zhig der dogs nas tshig 'di la thugs shin tu snyung ngo / /rje btsun mar los bod du sgron gsal bshad bka' mtshungs zer yang mi bden te/sgron gsal gyi yig sna mar lugs 'dug pa'i phyir ro/ /rgyud rkyang gi bshad pa de yang sgron gsal gyi snying po bsdus pa ka yin pas sgron gsal gyi pho rus su bsams nas phyir 'bud byed mi dgos so/ /thun mong min pa ni snying ga'i —340—

sngags 'khor la sogs pa'i man ngag dang / bsre 'pho la sogs kyi rnam gzhag dang man ngag ste/ 'phags skor ba gzhan la'ang ma grags pa'o/ /byin rlabs lam zhes pa rim pa lnga car gyi man ngag la nyams myong phyin ci ma log par shar ba'i rgyun yod pas/ slob ma la yang nyams myong 'phral du skye ba'i nus pa yod pa'o/ /gzhung gi mthar mtshan smos pa ni/ rim pa lnga'i don bsdus pa gsal ba zhes bya ba/ dpal nā ro pas mdzad pa'i gsang ba'i man ngag bla ma'i zhal las rtogs par bya ba rdzogs so/ /zhes pa'o/ /dpe 'ga' zhig las/ rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po de nyid dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba mar ba chos kyi blo gros kyis bsgyur zhing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o/ /zhes pa'i 'gyur byang yang yod do/ /'dir smras pa/ rgyud sde kun gyi bzhugs tshul cha tsam rig khyad par gsang pa 'dus par cung zad sbyangs/ /'phags skor gzhung la'ang ngal ba bag tsam bsten/ /mar lugs phyogs kyi gzhung bshad phal cher mthong zab mo'i gzhung mchog 'di nyid ni/ /tshig nyung don ni shin tu rgyas/ /gzhan gyi 'grel pa ma mthong mod/ /gzhung la zhib mor brtag pas go /sbyangs shing go nas bshad pa yin/ /slob long med par mkhas grags 'dod/ /blun po mgu byed kho nar zad/ /rgyu med 'bras bu mi 'byung ngo / /rgyal ba dgyes pa'i lam gyi mchog /cung zad bshad pa'i dge bas kyang / /nam mkha' mthas gshugs sems can rnams/ /rdo rje 'dzin dang mnyam par shog /ces pa/ rim lnga bsdus gsal gyi 'grel pa 'di ni/ 'jig rten mgon po stag lung thang pas sku gsung thugs la —341—

byin gyis brlabs shing / rigs mchog gser gyi ri bo'i rtse mor bsngags par 'os pa'i yon tan gyi nyin byed brgya phrag rtag tu 'char ba'i skyes mchog dam pa/rje ngag dbang bkra shis dpal grub kyi gsung gis bskul nas/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas sbyar ba'o/ /gzhung 'di sdom gyi tshul du snang bas 'khru bshig pa tsam gyis don mthong ba dga' bar 'dug pas/ don cha tshang ba zur smos kyis brjod pa yin no// //zhus dag ma ṅga la/'dir 'bad dge ba rnam par dkar ba'i mthus/ /bdag lus bor tshe dpal ldan sham+bha lar/ /rigs ldan rgyal po'i 'khor du legs skyes nas/ /dus 'khor bstan la bya ba byed par shog /ces pa 'di ni chos rje phyogs las rnam rgyal gyis smon lam btab pa'o/ /dge ba 'di yis glo bur dri ma'i tshogs/ /srog dang thur sel rtsa dang lhan cig du/ /'joms par nus pa'i thabs zab la brten nas/ /gzhan mchog bde gshegs snying po myur thob shog /ces pa 'di ni rton pa bzhi ldan gyis smon lam mdzad pa'o/ /dus kyi 'khor lo bla ma dbyer med la/ /gus pas skyabs gsol 'dir bsags rab dkar mthus/ /sham+bha la ru rigs ldan sras gyur te/ /bstan 'gro yongs la rlabs chen phan thogs shog /ces pa'ang ma tis so/ /bsod nams bsags dges bdag sogs 'gro/ /'di phyi kun tu yang dag gi /chos mthun kho nas legs 'tsho zhing / /rkyen ngan gang gis bsgyur med shog /ces pa'ang ma tis so// //—342—

dpe sgrig 'gan 'khur pa/ tshangs po/mdun shog mdzes 'god pa/ 'gro 'dul rdo rje/spe5 gu ni/skodzo / la8'a ni ni/la5/deb nga gcig pa/ ༄༅/ /jo nang tā ra na tha'i gsung 'bum/(9(45)dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis bsgrigs/— : —krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang gis bskrun te bkram/pe cin ma'o rin tshon khra par 'debs kung sis dpar btab/sbyi ༵ /0༷re~Xṭā / dro~Xr ༵rngo thengs sdo nga dho btab//dpar grangs/ 0 01———1500152sku978—7—80253—013—3(2 51gsung 'bum cha tshang (deb 1—45yod )la rin sgor/ 9 10 00

thob nas nyes pa'i dgra rnams pham byas nas//skye rga na 'chi'i rba rlabs 'khru / gas pa yi//srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro ba sgrol bar shog/'khu pho༈ 4la pa za1ṣ+kazi /rnge’ wim41thro/khyo4zi 4ri4hrang chi mi ste 4 lko3rna4tsho khu mi ba / 402〉༈smo 1 bya smo1'u1༈bang tshi〉71tshi༈༈tshi 1 2 010111bya010smo0khu khri lo8snro ༈pu'u rtokhu'i༈༈khri'u khus khyab3〉spong0'apyi sku01smo tha stu10sa1༈khri'u bya༈0(sgoge〉spo tshi5khu bya0rto61tshakhri01sku'i tha0 ci10smi1khu bya ci skyas sku sku0skyasmosmo0so1༈sku khu00khu'i sa0sha bya'i pas bya'i pa'i pa1skya skya/60khu'i1160smoḥ8

nged dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gi las sgrub mi snar lo bstud mar 'tsho ba'i yon spyor gnang mkhan mchog sprul pad+ma dbang rgyal rin po che la snying thag pa nas thugs rje zhu ba dang /krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dpe bsdur ma par skrun thad la rgyab skyor dang mnyam las gnang bar snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu ba yin/dpar yone zhal 'debs gnang mkhan/rang re'i spun zla rnams kyi mtshan tho/ ka mad kyi go rim ltar lags/gdung sras phrin las nor bu rin po che/ bla ma mthar phyin rin po che/ bla ma yon tan/sman pa rig 'dzin lags/ las rab gling pa rin po che/ bsod nams bde skyid/
